"""
planner_agent.py - Planner Agent for AutoDev

Responsible for taking high-level project metadata (name, description,
tech stack, and development duration) and generating a structured, day-by-day
development roadmap exported as JSON.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List


def _generate_day_phase(
    day: int,
    total_days: int,
    project_name: str,
    project_description: str,
    tech_stack: str,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Generates a realistic, structured phase definition for a given day
    based on the project's development timeline.
    """
    progress_ratio = day / total_days

    # Single-day quick prototype
    if total_days == 1:
        return {
            "day": 1,
            "phase_name": "Full Prototype & End-to-End Validation",
            "goals": [
                f"Initialize repository structure for {project_name}",
                f"Implement core functionality using {tech_stack}",
                "Write baseline tests and verify end-to-end execution",
            ],
            "tasks": [
                f"Set up project workspace, dependencies, and config for {tech_stack}",
                f"Build core components to address: {project_description}",
                "Add test suite, documentation, and execution guide",
            ],
            "deliverables": [
                "Working prototype codebase",
                "Automated test suite",
                "README and setup instructions",
            ],
            "testing_focus": "Unit tests for core functions and smoke testing",
            "git_commit_message": "feat: initial release of complete prototype",
        }

    # Two-day project
    if total_days == 2:
        if day == 1:
            return {
                "day": 1,
                "phase_name": "Project Setup & Core Feature Implementation",
                "goals": [
                    f"Scaffold project architecture with {tech_stack}",
                    f"Implement foundational logic for {project_name}",
                ],
                "tasks": [
                    "Configure project directory, dependencies, and environment",
                    f"Develop primary data models and business logic for: {project_description}",
                    "Write initial unit tests for data structures",
                ],
                "deliverables": [
                    "Project skeleton and build configuration",
                    "Core business logic modules",
                ],
                "testing_focus": "Unit tests for core logic and data validation",
                "git_commit_message": "feat(core): setup architecture and implement core logic",
            }
        else:
            return {
                "day": 2,
                "phase_name": "Integration, Testing & Final Polish",
                "goals": [
                    "Connect all sub-modules and complete user-facing interfaces",
                    "Achieve high test coverage and finalize documentation",
                ],
                "tasks": [
                    "Implement edge case handling and error boundaries",
                    "Write integration and regression test suites",
                    "Create comprehensive README and finalize release packaging",
                ],
                "deliverables": [
                    "Fully integrated codebase",
                    "Complete automated test suite",
                    "Documentation and setup instructions",
                ],
                "testing_focus": "Integration testing, boundary conditions, and performance sanity",
                "git_commit_message": "chore(release): complete integration, testing, and documentation",
            }

    # Multi-day project (3+ days)
    if day == 1:
        # Day 1: Initialization & Architecture
        return {
            "day": 1,
            "phase_name": "Project Setup & Architectural Skeleton",
            "goals": [
                f"Initialize repository structure for {project_name}",
                f"Configure development environment and tooling for {tech_stack}",
                "Establish base architectural patterns and configuration loading",
            ],
            "tasks": [
                f"Create directory structure and initialize dependency management for {tech_stack}",
                "Implement configuration management and environment variables handling",
                "Create base application entry point with health check / status verification",
            ],
            "deliverables": [
                "Project repository scaffold",
                "Dependency configuration file",
                "Base entry point and architecture blueprint",
            ],
            "testing_focus": "Environment sanity checks and initial boot-up test",
            "git_commit_message": "chore(setup): scaffold project architecture and dependencies",
        }

    if day == total_days:
        # Final Day: Hardening, Polish, Docs & Release
        return {
            "day": day,
            "phase_name": "Final Hardening, Documentation & Release Readiness",
            "goals": [
                f"Perform comprehensive quality assurance on {project_name}",
                "Complete full documentation, setup guides, and code cleanup",
                "Verify end-to-end user workflows and package for distribution",
            ],
            "tasks": [
                "Execute complete test suite (unit, integration, and edge-case verification)",
                "Refactor codebase for readability, performance, and style consistency",
                "Write comprehensive README.md, API/usage documentation, and license",
            ],
            "deliverables": [
                "Production-ready codebase",
                "Complete documentation and usage examples",
                "Verified passing test suite report",
            ],
            "testing_focus": "End-to-end regression testing, stress testing, and edge case coverage",
            "git_commit_message": "chore(release): finalize documentation, polish code, and prepare release",
        }

    # Intermediate days (Days 2 to total_days - 1)
    if progress_ratio <= 0.4:
        return {
            "day": day,
            "phase_name": "Data Architecture & Core Domain Models",
            "goals": [
                "Design and implement data schemas, domain entities, and storage layer",
                f"Establish persistence and data validation logic using {tech_stack}",
            ],
            "tasks": [
                "Define domain models and type definitions",
                "Implement database schemas, migrations, or data storage adapters",
                "Write unit tests for data validation and schema integrity",
            ],
            "deliverables": [
                "Domain models and data schemas",
                "Data access layer and repository interfaces",
                "Model unit test suite",
            ],
            "testing_focus": "Schema validation, serialization/deserialization, and boundary checks",
            "git_commit_message": f"feat(models): implement domain data models and storage layer (Day {day})",
        }
    elif progress_ratio <= 0.7:
        return {
            "day": day,
            "phase_name": "Core Business Logic & Service Implementation",
            "goals": [
                f"Implement main business logic algorithms for: {project_description}",
                "Develop service handlers, controllers, and core computational components",
            ],
            "tasks": [
                "Implement primary business workflows and service interfaces",
                "Integrate domain models with core application logic",
                "Add granular unit tests for service methods and business rules",
            ],
            "deliverables": [
                "Core service modules and business handlers",
                "Service-level unit tests",
            ],
            "testing_focus": "Business logic branching, edge conditions, and error states",
            "git_commit_message": f"feat(services): implement core business logic workflows (Day {day})",
        }
    else:
        return {
            "day": day,
            "phase_name": "API Layer, UI/Interface & System Integration",
            "goals": [
                "Expose business features through public interfaces (API/CLI/UI)",
                "Integrate cross-cutting concerns (logging, error handling, validation)",
            ],
            "tasks": [
                f"Build interface endpoints/commands using {tech_stack}",
                "Wire frontend/interface layer with backend services",
                "Implement structured error handling and operational logging",
            ],
            "deliverables": [
                "API routes or interface components",
                "Integration wiring and middleware",
                "Integration test suite",
            ],
            "testing_focus": "Interface contract testing, integration tests, and error responses",
            "git_commit_message": f"feat(api): implement interface endpoints and system integration (Day {day})",
        }


def generate_project_plan(
    project_name: str,
    project_description: str,
    tech_stack: str,
    days: int,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Generates a complete structured project plan dictionary.

    Args:
        project_name: Name of the project.
        project_description: Brief summary of the project goals.
        tech_stack: Comma-separated or descriptive list of technologies.
        days: Total number of development days.

    Returns:
        Structured plan dictionary ready for JSON serialization.
    """
    if days < 1:
        raise ValueError("Number of development days must be at least 1.")

    clean_name = project_name.strip()
    clean_desc = project_description.strip()
    clean_stack = tech_stack.strip()

    phases: List[Dict[str, Any]] = [
        _generate_day_phase(
            day=day_idx,
            total_days=days,
            project_name=clean_name,
            project_description=clean_desc,
            tech_stack=clean_stack,
        )
        for day_idx in range(1, days + 1)
    ]

    plan: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "project_name": clean_name,
        "project_description": clean_desc,
        "technology_stack": clean_stack,
        "total_days": days,
        "created_at": datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "phases": phases,
    }

    return plan


def save_project_plan(
    plan: Dict[str, Any],
    filepath: str | Path = "memory/project_plan.json",
) -> Path:
    """
    Saves a project plan dictionary to a formatted JSON file.

    Args:
        plan: The plan dictionary.
        filepath: Target file path (defaults to memory/project_plan.json).

    Returns:
        The Path object of the saved file.
    """
    path = Path(filepath)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(plan, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    return path


def load_project_plan(
    filepath: str | Path = "memory/project_plan.json",
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Loads and parses an existing project plan JSON file.

    Args:
        filepath: Path to the JSON file.

    Returns:
        The loaded plan dictionary.
    """
    path = Path(filepath)
    if not path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Project plan file '{filepath}' was not found.")

    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)

"""
portfolio_director.py - Enterprise Portfolio Director Agent (AutoDev Version 3.5)

Directs cross-company multi-project portfolios at enterprise scale:
- Evaluates strategic alignment, estimated ROI, and delivery risk
- Prioritizes capital and engineering resources across hundreds of projects
- Continuously rebalances portfolio priorities based on real-time milestones
- 100% Python Standard Library.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

logger = logging.getLogger("AutoDev.Agents.PortfolioDirector")


class PortfolioDirectorAgent:
    """
    Enterprise Portfolio Director Agent.
    Authority Level 4 (Director).
    """

    def __init__(self, name: str = "Elena Rostova") -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.role = "PortfolioDirector"
        self.authority_level = 4

    def score_initiative(
        self,
        title: str,
        business_value: float,
        strategic_alignment: float,
        estimated_roi: float,
        risk_score: float,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Calculates normalized ranking score for an enterprise initiative."""
        risk_discount = max(0.1, (100.0 - risk_score) / 100.0)
        composite_score = round(
            (business_value * 0.4 + strategic_alignment * 0.4 + (estimated_roi * 10.0) * 0.2) * risk_discount,
            2,
        )
        return {
            "title": title,
            "composite_score": composite_score,
            "recommended_priority": "P0_CRITICAL" if composite_score >= 80.0 else ("P1_HIGH" if composite_score >= 60.0 else "P2_STANDARD"),
            "evaluated_by": self.name,
            "timestamp": time.time(),
        }

    def evaluate_portfolio_health(
        self,
        active_projects: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Assesses overall portfolio risk and delivery confidence."""
        if not active_projects:
            return {"status": "HEALTHY", "delivery_confidence": 1.0, "projects_at_risk": 0}

        at_risk = [p for p in active_projects if p.get("delivery_confidence", 1.0) < 0.60]
        avg_conf = sum(p.get("delivery_confidence", 1.0) for p in active_projects) / len(active_projects)

        return {
            "total_projects": len(active_projects),
            "projects_at_risk": len(at_risk),
            "average_delivery_confidence": round(avg_conf, 3),
            "status": "REQUIRES_ATTENTION" if len(at_risk) > 0 else "HEALTHY",
            "evaluated_by": self.name,
            "timestamp": time.time(),
        }


# Convenient alias
PortfolioDirector = PortfolioDirectorAgent

    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:

            statement=statement,
            rationale=rationale,
            priority=priority,
            author=self.name,
        )
        return hypothesis.to_dict()

    def identify_literature_gap(self, domain: str, existing_approaches: List[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        approaches = list(existing_approaches)
        return {
            "domain": domain,
            "existing_approaches": approaches,
            "opportunity": (
                f"Investigate approaches beyond {', '.join(approaches)} in {domain}."
                if approaches
                else f"Establish baseline research coverage for {domain}."
            ),
        }

    def formulate_speedup_hypothesis(
        self,
        module_name: str,
        current_algo: str,
        proposed_algo: str,
        expected_gain_pct: float = 30.0,
    ) -> ResearchHypothesis:
        """Formulates a new algorithmic speedup research hypothesis."""
        hyp = self.lab.hypothesis_engine.generate_algorithmic_speedup_hypothesis(
            module_name=module_name,
            current_algorithm=current_algo,
            proposed_algorithm=proposed_algo,
            expected_latency_reduction_pct=expected_gain_pct,
        )
        hyp.author = self.name
        return hyp

    def formulate_compression_hypothesis(
        self,
        module_name: str,
        compression_technique: str,
        target_token_reduction_pct: float = 35.0,
    ) -> ResearchHypothesis:
        """Formulates a prompt compression hypothesis."""
        hyp = self.lab.hypothesis_engine.generate_prompt_compression_hypothesis(
            module_name=module_name,
            compression_technique=compression_technique,
            target_token_reduction_pct=target_token_reduction_pct,
        )
        hyp.author = self.name
        return hyp

    def conduct_literature_gap_analysis(self, domain: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Analyzes active hypotheses and algorithm registrations to find research voids."""
        hypotheses = self.lab.hypothesis_engine.list_hypotheses(module=domain)
        algs = self.lab.algorithm_registry.list_algorithms()

        has_coverage = len(hypotheses) > 0 or len(algs) > 0

            f"Sufficient initial coverage for {domain} with {len(hypotheses)} hypotheses."
            if has_coverage
            else f"Opportunity for exploratory breakthrough: {domain} has no registered algorithms."
        )

        return {
            "domain": domain,
            "existing_hypotheses_count": len(hypotheses),
            "registered_algorithms_count": len(algs),
            "recommendation": recommendation,
            "analyzed_by": self.name,
        }

"""
product_manager.py - Product Manager Agent (AutoDev Version 3.4)

Directs product roadmap, sprint goals, and customer value:
- Product Roadmap and strategic release milestones
- Sprint Goal definition and backlog prioritization
- Customer Value Score and Business Impact estimation
- Feature dependency mapping and delivery sequencing
- Customer requirement intake and satisfaction alignment
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from core.communication_bus import CommunicationBus, MessagePriority, OrgMessage, OrgMessageType
from core.organization_state import OrganizationState

logger = logging.getLogger("AutoDev.Org.ProductManager")


class ProductManagerAgent:
    """
    Autonomous Product Manager AI Agent.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str = "ProductManager",
        bus: Optional[CommunicationBus] = None,
        state: Optional[OrganizationState] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.bus = bus
        self.state = state
        self.authority_level = 3  # Managerial Product
        self.roadmap_milestones: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

        if self.bus:
            self.bus.register_entity(self.name)

    def prioritize_backlog(self, features: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        Ranks backlog features by RICE-inspired Customer Value Score:
        Score = (Reach * Impact * Confidence) / Effort
        """
        scored_features = []
        for feat in features:
            reach = feat.get("reach", 10.0)
            impact = feat.get("impact", 3.0)  # 1 to 5
            conf = feat.get("confidence", 0.8)
            effort = max(1.0, feat.get("effort_days", 2.0))

            score = round((reach * impact * conf) / effort, 2)
            item = dict(feat)
            item["customer_value_score"] = score
            scored_features.append(item)

        scored_features.sort(key=lambda x: -x["customer_value_score"])
        return scored_features

    def define_sprint_goal(self, selected_features: List[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Formulates a concise, measurable sprint goal."""
        joined = ", ".join(selected_features[:3])
        goal = f"Deliver production-ready capability for: {joined}"

        result = {
            "sprint_goal": goal,
            "features_committed": selected_features,
            "target_completion_days": 14,
            "customer_value_score": 92.5,
            "timestamp": time.time(),
        }

        logger.info("Sprint Goal defined: '%s'", goal)
        return result

    def update_roadmap(self, quarter: str, milestones: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Updates official quarterly product roadmap."""
        self.roadmap_milestones.extend(milestones)
        if self.state:
            self.state.update_roadmap(quarter, milestones)

        return {
            "quarter": quarter,
            "milestones_count": len(milestones),
            "status": "ROADMAP_UPDATED",
        }

        user_stories = feature_spec.get("user_stories", [feature_name])

        cases = []
        for us in user_stories:
            cases.append(f"test_happy_path_{us.replace(' ', '_').lower()}")
            cases.append(f"test_boundary_conditions_{us.replace(' ', '_').lower()}")
            cases.append(f"test_error_handling_{us.replace(' ', '_').lower()}")

        return {
            "feature": feature_name,
            "test_cases": cases,
            "total_cases_planned": len(cases),
            "estimated_execution_time_s": len(cases) * 0.15,
            "target_coverage_pct": self.min_coverage_threshold,
        }

    def evaluate_quality_gate(
        self,
        test_results: Dict[str, Any],
        coverage_pct: float = 94.0,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Evaluates formal Go/No-Go quality gate."""
        passed = test_results.get("passed", 0)
        failed = test_results.get("failed", 0)
        total = passed + failed

        pass_rate = (passed / max(1, total)) * 100.0
        meets_coverage = coverage_pct >= self.min_coverage_threshold
        zero_failures = failed == 0

        gate_passed = meets_coverage and zero_failures
        status = "PASSED" if gate_passed else "REJECTED"

        rationale = (
            f"Quality gate PASSED: {passed}/{total} tests passed ({pass_rate:.1f}%), coverage {coverage_pct:.1f}% meets {self.min_coverage_threshold}% threshold."
            if gate_passed
            else f"Quality gate REJECTED: {failed} test failure(s) or coverage {coverage_pct:.1f}% below {self.min_coverage_threshold}% threshold."
        )

        return {
            "quality_gate_status": status,
            "tests_passed": passed,
            "tests_failed": failed,
            "test_pass_rate_pct": pass_rate,
            "coverage_pct": coverage_pct,
            "rationale": rationale,
            "timestamp": time.time(),
        }

    def build_risk_matrix(self, features: List[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Constructs a defect risk matrix classifying features by risk tier."""
        matrix = {"CRITICAL_RISK": [], "MEDIUM_RISK": [], "LOW_RISK": []}
        for f in features:
            f_lower = f.lower()
            if any(k in f_lower for k in ["payment", "auth", "crypto", "database", "security"]):
                matrix["CRITICAL_RISK"].append(f)
            elif any(k in f_lower for k in ["api", "sync", "export", "cache"]):
                matrix["MEDIUM_RISK"].append(f)
            else:
                matrix["LOW_RISK"].append(f)

        return matrix

"""
AutoDev Specialized Agent - ReleaseAgent (v2.8)
==============================================
Specialized autonomous agent responsible for:
- Semantic versioning (SemVer) and release tagging
- CHANGELOG.md generation and release notes
- Packaging, artifacts, and pre-release synchronization validation
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from core.collaboration.collaboration_models import AgentRole, MessageType, TaskAssignment
from .specialized_agent import SpecializedAgent

logger = logging.getLogger("autodev.agents.release")


class ReleaseAgent(SpecializedAgent):
    """
    Lead Release & DevOps Engineer agent coordinating release milestones,
    version bumps, changelogs, and release gate validations.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str = "ReleaseAgent",
        llm_client: Optional[Any] = None,
        bus: Optional[Any] = None,
        workspace: Optional[Any] = None,
    ):
        super().__init__(
            name=name,
            role=AgentRole.RELEASE,
            llm_client=llm_client,
            bus=bus,
            workspace=workspace,
        )

    def bump_version(self, current_version: str, bump_type: str = "minor") -> str:
        """Calculate next semantic version."""
        parts = [int(p) for p in current_version.split(".")]
        while len(parts) < 3:
            parts.append(0)

        if bump_type == "major":
            parts[0] += 1
            parts[1] = 0
            parts[2] = 0
        elif bump_type == "minor":
            parts[1] += 1
            parts[2] = 0
        else:
            parts[2] += 1

        return f"{parts[0]}.{parts[1]}.{parts[2]}"

    def generate_changelog_entry(self, version: str, changes: List[str]) -> str:
        """Format markdown changelog section."""
        bullets = "\n".join(f"- {c}" for c in changes)
        return f"## [{version}]\n{bullets}\n"

    def execute_task(
        self,
        task: TaskAssignment,
        context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Execute release packaging, changelog update, or versioning."""
        logger.info("ReleaseAgent executing: %s", task.title)

        staged_files = {}
        for fpath in task.estimated_files:
            self.acquire_lock(fpath, is_exclusive=True)
            content = (
                f"# Release Manifest: {task.title}\n"
                f"# Packaged by {self.name} (v2.8)\n\n"
                f"VERSION = '2.8.0'\n"
                f"STATUS = 'STABLE'\n"
            )
            staged_files[fpath] = content
            self.stage_code(fpath, content, f"Prepare release manifest for {task.title}")
            self.release_lock(fpath)

        if self.bus:
            self.send_message(
                receiver="*",
                message_type=MessageType.NOTIFICATION,
                payload={
                    "event": "release_prepared",
                    "task_id": task.task_id,
                    "version": "2.8.0",
                },
                task_id=task.task_id,
            )

        return {
            "agent": self.name,
            "role": self.role.value,
            "task_id": task.task_id,
            "action": "release_packaging",
            "staged_files": staged_files,
            "summary": f"Prepared release validation, changelog, and packaging for '{task.title}'.",
        }

"""
release_manager.py - Release Manager Agent (AutoDev Version 3.4)

Directs corporate release trains and release gate verification:
- Collects formal release approvals across departments
- Verifies Go/No-Go quality gates (QA, Security, Docs, DevOps)
- Generates official Release Notes and Changelogs
- Triggers production deployment and publishes release manifest
- Enforces release governance and audit compliance
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from core.communication_bus import CommunicationBus, MessagePriority, OrgMessage, OrgMessageType
from core.organization_state import OrganizationState

logger = logging.getLogger("AutoDev.Org.ReleaseManager")


class ReleaseManagerAgent:
    """
    Autonomous Release Manager AI Agent.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str = "ReleaseManager",
        bus: Optional[CommunicationBus] = None,
        state: Optional[OrganizationState] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.bus = bus
        self.state = state
        self.authority_level = 3  # Managerial Release
        self.mandatory_approvals: List[str] = ["CEO", "CTO", "QA", "Security"]
        self.collected_approvals: Dict[str, bool] = {}

        if self.bus:
            self.bus.register_entity(self.name)

    def collect_release_approvals(self, approvals_map: Dict[str, bool]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Collects departmental sign-offs for upcoming release."""
        self.collected_approvals.update(approvals_map)
        missing = [dept for dept in self.mandatory_approvals if not self.collected_approvals.get(dept, False)]

        all_approved = len(missing) == 0
        return {
            "all_mandatory_approvals_gathered": all_approved,
            "approved_by": [k for k, v in self.collected_approvals.items() if v],
            "missing_approvals": missing,
            "status": "APPROVED_FOR_RELEASE" if all_approved else "PENDING_APPROVALS",
        }

    def evaluate_release_readiness(
        self,
        qa_gate_passed: bool,
        security_score: float,
        docs_complete: bool,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Evaluates whether all technical release criteria are satisfied."""
        sec_ok = security_score >= 85.0
        ready = qa_gate_passed and sec_ok and docs_complete

        return {
            "release_ready": ready,
            "qa_passed": qa_gate_passed,
            "security_passed": sec_ok,
            "docs_complete": docs_complete,
            "decision": "GO" if ready else "NO_GO",
            "timestamp": time.time(),
        }

    def generate_release_notes(self, version: str, features: List[str], fixes: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> str:
        """Synthesizes formal markdown release notes."""
        feats_str = "\n".join(f"- {f}" for f in features) if features else "- Core performance optimizations"
        fixes_str = "\n".join(f"- {fx}" for fx in (fixes or [])) if fixes else "- Zero known defects"

        notes = (
            f"# AutoDev Version {version} Release Notes\n\n"
            f"### Highlights & New Features\n{feats_str}\n\n"
            f"### Defect Remediations & Bug Fixes\n{fixes_str}\n\n"
            f"### Quality Verification\n- 100% Backward Compatibility Maintained\n- Zero Prohibited Frameworks\n"
        )
        return notes

    def execute_release(
        self,
        version: str,
        features: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Executes official release and archives record."""
        release_notes = self.generate_release_notes(version, features or ["Enterprise Organization Multi-Agent Delivery"])
        record = {
            "version": version,
            "release_status": "DEPLOYED_TO_PRODUCTION",
            "approvals": list(self.mandatory_approvals),
            "release_notes": release_notes,
            "released_at": time.time(),
        }

        if self.state:
            self.state.record_release(record)

        if self.bus:
            self.bus.broadcast(
                sender=self.name,
                message_type=OrgMessageType.RELEASE_APPROVAL,
                payload=record,
                priority=MessagePriority.CRITICAL,
            )

        logger.info("AutoDev Version %s released successfully.", version)
        return record

"""
reviewer_agent.py - AI-Powered Code Review Agent for AutoDev

Responsible for analyzing code generated by CoderAgent alongside test execution metrics
from TesterAgent against project context, evaluating quality, detecting issues,
scoring overall codebase quality, and determining if regeneration is required.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import re
import sys
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Union

# Ensure project root is available on sys.path for direct execution
if __name__ == "__main__" and __package__ is None:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from agents.coder_agent import GeneratedFile, GeneratedResult
from agents.tester_agent import TestResult
from core.llm import BaseLLM, MockLLM

# Module logger
logger = logging.getLogger("AutoDev.ReviewerAgent")


class ReviewValidationError(ValueError):
    """
    Raised when an LLM review response fails validation against the required schema.
    """
    pass


VALID_SEVERITIES = {"LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH", "CRITICAL"}


@dataclass
class Issue:
    """
    Represents an individual code quality, architectural, or security finding.
    """
    severity: str
    category: str
    file: str
    line: Optional[int]
    description: str
    recommendation: str

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Converts issue to dictionary representation."""
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class ReviewResult:
    """
    Structured outcome of the AI code review pipeline.
    """
    success: bool
    summary: str
    overall_quality_score: int
    issues: List[Issue] = field(default_factory=list)
    strengths: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    recommendations: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    should_regenerate: bool = False
    explanation: str = ""

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Converts review result to dictionary representation."""
        return {
            "success": self.success,
            "summary": self.summary,
            "overall_quality_score": self.overall_quality_score,
            "issues": [i.to_dict() for i in self.issues],
            "strengths": self.strengths,
            "recommendations": self.recommendations,
            "should_regenerate": self.should_regenerate,
            "explanation": self.explanation,
        }


def _create_default_mock_review_response() -> str:
    """Creates a valid JSON mock review response string for offline dry runs."""
    payload = {
        "success": True,
        "summary": "The generated modules are well-structured, follow SOLID principles, and pass all automated tests.",
        "overall_quality_score": 92,
        "issues": [
            {
                "severity": "LOW",
                "category": "Documentation",
                "file": "src/main.py",
                "line": 1,
                "description": "Consider adding more detailed module-level docstrings.",
                "recommendation": "Expand module docstring with usage examples.",
            }
        ],
        "strengths": [
            "Clean separation of concerns",
            "Full type annotations included",
            "All unit tests executing successfully",
        ],
        "recommendations": [
            "Add integration test coverage in future phase",
        ],
        "should_regenerate": False,
        "explanation": "Code meets production standards. No blocking issues detected.",
    }
    return json.dumps(payload, indent=2)


class ReviewPromptBuilder:
    """
    Constructs comprehensive code review prompts combining project context,
    generated code files, and test runner telemetry.
    """

    def build_prompt(
        self,
        context: Dict[str, Any],
        generated_result: GeneratedResult,
        test_result: Optional[TestResult] = None,
    ) -> str:
        """
        Synthesizes a structured review prompt.

        Args:
            context: Project context dictionary from ContextBuilder.
            generated_result: GeneratedResult from CoderAgent.
            test_result: Optional TestResult from TesterAgent.

        Returns:
            Complete review prompt string.
        """
        project_name = context.get("project_name", "AutoDev Project")
        description = context.get("description", "No description provided.")
        tech_stack = context.get("technology_stack", "Standard Library")
        current_day = context.get("current_day", 1)
        current_phase = context.get("current_phase", {}) or {}
        phase_name = current_phase.get("phase_name", f"Day {current_day} Phase")

        # Format generated files
        files_section_parts: List[str] = []
        for file in generated_result.files:
            files_section_parts.append(
                f"--- File: {file.path} ---\n{file.content}\n--- End of File ---"
            )
        files_text = "\n\n".join(files_section_parts) if files_section_parts else "(No files generated)"

        # Format test execution telemetry
        if test_result is not None:
            test_telemetry = (
                f"Test Suite Success  : {test_result.success}\n"
                f"Total Tests Run     : {test_result.total_tests}\n"
                f"Passed Tests        : {test_result.passed}\n"
                f"Failed Tests        : {test_result.failed}\n"
                f"Skipped Tests       : {test_result.skipped}\n"
                f"Execution Duration  : {test_result.duration}s\n"
                f"Exit Code           : {test_result.exit_code}\n"
                f"Test Summary        : {test_result.message}\n"
                f"Stdout Preview      : {test_result.stdout[:500] if test_result.stdout else 'None'}\n"
                f"Stderr Preview      : {test_result.stderr[:500] if test_result.stderr else 'None'}"
            )
        else:
            test_telemetry = "(No automated test telemetry available for this review cycle)"

        prompt = f"""================================================================================
1. SYSTEM ROLE: PRINCIPAL CODE REVIEWER & ARCHITECT
================================================================================
You are the Lead Code Reviewer and Principal Architect in the AutoDev autonomous platform.
Your responsibility is to critically evaluate newly generated code against project
requirements, architecture standards, SOLID principles, security guidelines, and test results.

================================================================================
2. PROJECT & PHASE CONTEXT
================================================================================
Project Name  : {project_name}
Description   : {description}
Tech Stack    : {tech_stack}
Active Day    : Day {current_day}
Active Phase  : {phase_name}

================================================================================
3. CODER AGENT GENERATION SUMMARY
================================================================================
Summary       : {generated_result.summary}
Explanation   : {generated_result.explanation}

================================================================================
4. GENERATED SOURCE CODE FILES
================================================================================
{files_text}

================================================================================
5. TEST RUNNER TELEMETRY
================================================================================
{test_telemetry}

================================================================================
6. REVIEW CRITERIA
================================================================================
1. Requirement Alignment : Does the code fulfill the phase goals and task requirements?
2. Architectural Design  : Does it follow clean modular structure and SOLID principles?
3. Reliability & Tests   : Are edge cases handled, and are test failures addressed?
4. Security & Safety     : Are there obvious security risks, injections, or resource leaks?
5. Code Quality          : Are there clear type annotations, docstrings, and robust error handling?
6. Regeneration Decision : Set 'should_regenerate' to true ONLY if there are critical, blocking defects.

================================================================================
7. REQUIRED JSON OUTPUT FORMAT
================================================================================
You MUST respond with a single valid JSON object strictly matching this schema:

{{
  "success": true,
  "summary": "Concise summary of the code review findings",
  "overall_quality_score": 90,
  "issues": [
    {{
      "severity": "LOW",
      "category": "Documentation",
      "file": "src/main.py",
      "line": 1,
      "description": "Detailed explanation of the issue found",
      "recommendation": "Actionable recommendation to resolve the issue"
    }}
  ],
  "strengths": [
    "List of strong architectural decisions and well-written components"
  ],
  "recommendations": [
    "List of future improvement suggestions"
  ],
  "should_regenerate": false,
  "explanation": "Comprehensive overall architectural rationale for the review outcome"
}}

Severity levels MUST be one of: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL.
Overall quality score MUST be an integer between 0 and 100.
Do NOT wrap the JSON in markdown fences. Return pure JSON only."""
        return prompt


class ReviewerAgent:
    """
    AI-driven Code Review Agent that analyzes code deliverables and test outcomes.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        llm: Optional[BaseLLM] = None,
        prompt_builder: Optional[ReviewPromptBuilder] = None,
    ) -> None:
        """
        Initializes the ReviewerAgent.

        Args:
            llm: BaseLLM provider instance (defaults to MockLLM with valid review output).
            prompt_builder: ReviewPromptBuilder instance.
        """
        self.llm: BaseLLM = llm or MockLLM(default_response=_create_default_mock_review_response())
        self.prompt_builder: ReviewPromptBuilder = prompt_builder or ReviewPromptBuilder()

    def _extract_json(self, raw_response: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Extracts and parses JSON from raw LLM text, stripping markdown code fences if present.

        Args:
            raw_response: Raw text returned by language model.

        Returns:
            Parsed dictionary payload.

        Raises:
            ReviewValidationError: If parsing fails or output is not a JSON object.
        """
        cleaned = raw_response.strip()

        # Remove markdown fences (```json ... ``` or ``` ... ```)
        if cleaned.startswith("```"):
            cleaned = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?\s*", "", cleaned, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
            cleaned = re.sub(r"\s*```$", "", cleaned)
            cleaned = cleaned.strip()

        try:
            parsed = json.loads(cleaned)
        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
            logger.error("Failed to parse review response as JSON: %s", exc)
            raise ReviewValidationError(
                f"Reviewer LLM response is not valid JSON: {exc}\nRaw Response Preview: {raw_response[:300]}"
            ) from exc

        if not isinstance(parsed, dict):
            raise ReviewValidationError(
                f"Expected top-level JSON object (dict), but received {type(parsed).__name__}."
            )

        return parsed

    def _validate_payload(self, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> ReviewResult:
        """
        Validates the parsed review payload against the ReviewResult schema.

        Args:
            data: Parsed dictionary from LLM response.

        Returns:
            Validated ReviewResult instance.

        Raises:
            ReviewValidationError: If schema rules or field requirements are violated.
        """
        # Validate summary
        if "summary" not in data:
            raise ReviewValidationError("Missing required field 'summary' in review output.")
        if not isinstance(data["summary"], str) or not data["summary"].strip():
            raise ReviewValidationError("Field 'summary' must be a non-empty string.")

        # Validate overall_quality_score
        if "overall_quality_score" not in data:
            raise ReviewValidationError("Missing required field 'overall_quality_score' in review output.")
        score = data["overall_quality_score"]
        if isinstance(score, bool) or not isinstance(score, int):
            raise ReviewValidationError(
                f"Field 'overall_quality_score' must be an integer (0-100), got {type(score).__name__}."
            )
        if not (0 <= score <= 100):
            raise ReviewValidationError(
                f"Field 'overall_quality_score' must be between 0 and 100, got {score}."
            )

        # Validate should_regenerate
        if "should_regenerate" not in data:
            raise ReviewValidationError("Missing required field 'should_regenerate' in review output.")
        if not isinstance(data["should_regenerate"], bool):
            raise ReviewValidationError(
                f"Field 'should_regenerate' must be a boolean (True/False), got {type(data['should_regenerate']).__name__}."
            )

        # Validate explanation
        if "explanation" not in data:
            raise ReviewValidationError("Missing required field 'explanation' in review output.")
        if not isinstance(data["explanation"], str):
            raise ReviewValidationError("Field 'explanation' must be a string.")

        # Validate strengths
        strengths_raw = data.get("strengths", [])
        if not isinstance(strengths_raw, list):
            raise ReviewValidationError("Field 'strengths' must be a list of strings.")
        strengths = [str(s) for s in strengths_raw]

        # Validate recommendations
        recs_raw = data.get("recommendations", [])
        if not isinstance(recs_raw, list):
            raise ReviewValidationError("Field 'recommendations' must be a list of strings.")
        recommendations = [str(r) for r in recs_raw]

        # Validate issues
        issues_raw = data.get("issues", [])
        if not isinstance(issues_raw, list):
            raise ReviewValidationError("Field 'issues' must be a list of issue objects.")

        validated_issues: List[Issue] = []
        for index, item in enumerate(issues_raw):
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                raise ReviewValidationError(
                    f"Item at issues[{index}] must be a dict object, got {type(item).__name__}."
                )

            severity = str(item.get("severity", "LOW")).strip().upper()
            if severity not in VALID_SEVERITIES:
                valid_str = ", ".join(sorted(VALID_SEVERITIES))
                raise ReviewValidationError(
                    f"Issue at index {index} has invalid severity '{severity}'. Must be one of: {valid_str}."
                )

            category = str(item.get("category", "General")).strip()
            file_path = str(item.get("file", "unknown")).strip()
            description = str(item.get("description", "")).strip()
            recommendation = str(item.get("recommendation", "")).strip()
            line_val = item.get("line")
            line_num: Optional[int] = int(line_val) if line_val is not None and not isinstance(line_val, bool) and str(line_val).isdigit() else None

            if not description:
                raise ReviewValidationError(f"Issue at index {index} must contain a non-empty 'description'.")

            validated_issues.append(
                Issue(
                    severity=severity,
                    category=category,
                    file=file_path,
                    line=line_num,
                    description=description,
                    recommendation=recommendation,
                )
            )

        success = data.get("success", True)
        if not isinstance(success, bool):
            success = True

        return ReviewResult(
            success=success,
            summary=data["summary"].strip(),
            overall_quality_score=score,
            issues=validated_issues,
            strengths=strengths,
            recommendations=recommendations,
            should_regenerate=data["should_regenerate"],
            explanation=data["explanation"].strip(),
        )

    def review(
        self,
        context: Dict[str, Any],
        generated_result: GeneratedResult,
        test_result: Optional[TestResult] = None,
    ) -> ReviewResult:
        """
        Executes code review by synthesizing the prompt, querying LLM, and validating output.

        Args:
            context: Project context dictionary.
            generated_result: GeneratedResult output from CoderAgent.
            test_result: Optional TestResult output from TesterAgent.

        Returns:
            Validated ReviewResult object.
        """
        logger.info("ReviewerAgent starting review of %d generated file(s)...", len(generated_result.files))

        # Step 1: Synthesize review prompt
        prompt = self.prompt_builder.build_prompt(
            context=context,
            generated_result=generated_result,
            test_result=test_result,
        )

        # Step 2: Query BaseLLM
        logger.info("Dispatching review prompt to %s...", type(self.llm).__name__)
        raw_response = self.llm.generate(prompt)

        # Step 3 & 4: Extract and validate JSON
        logger.info("Validating structured review response...")
        parsed_data = self._extract_json(raw_response)
        review_result = self._validate_payload(parsed_data)

        logger.info(
            "Review completed. Quality Score: %d/100, Issues: %d, Regenerate: %s",
            review_result.overall_quality_score,
            len(review_result.issues),
            review_result.should_regenerate,
        )

        return review_result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)-5s] %(message)s")

    from core.context_builder import build_context

    ctx = build_context()
    dummy_gen = GeneratedResult(
        summary="Implemented project starter modules",
        files=[
            GeneratedFile(path="src/main.py", content="def main(): print('Hello AutoDev')\n"),
            GeneratedFile(path="src/config.py", content="DEBUG = True\n"),
        ],
        explanation="Created entry point and config files.",
    )
    dummy_test = TestResult(
        success=True,

"""
AutoDev Specialized Agent - SecurityAgent (v2.8)
==============================================
Specialized autonomous agent responsible for:
- Vulnerability scanning, AST taint analysis, and OWASP Top 10 mitigation
- Dependency vulnerability auditing and CVE checks
- Security policy enforcement and security-first consensus vetoes
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from core.collaboration.collaboration_models import AgentRole, MessageType, TaskAssignment
from .specialized_agent import SpecializedAgent

logger = logging.getLogger("autodev.agents.security")


class SecurityAgent(SpecializedAgent):
    """
    Lead Security Architect agent ensuring application security, zero hardcoded
    secrets, OWASP compliance, and safe cryptographic primitives.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str = "SecurityAgent",
        llm_client: Optional[Any] = None,
        bus: Optional[Any] = None,
        workspace: Optional[Any] = None,
    ):
        super().__init__(
            name=name,
            role=AgentRole.SECURITY,
            llm_client=llm_client,
            bus=bus,
            workspace=workspace,
        )

    def audit_security(self, code_snippets: Dict[str, str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Perform automated security scanning on provided source files."""
        findings = []
        for path, code in code_snippets.items():
            if "eval(" in code or "exec(" in code:
                findings.append({
                    "file": path,
                    "severity": "CRITICAL",
                    "cve": "OWASP-A03:Injection",
                    "issue": "Insecure dynamic code execution (eval/exec) detected.",
                })
            if "password = " in code.lower() or "secret = " in code.lower():
                findings.append({
                    "file": path,
                    "severity": "HIGH",
                    "cve": "OWASP-A07:Identification-Failures",
                    "issue": "Potential hardcoded credential or secret detected.",
                })

        return {
            "passed": len(findings) == 0,
            "findings_count": len(findings),
            "findings": findings,
        }

    def execute_task(
        self,
        task: TaskAssignment,
        context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Execute security vulnerability scan, audit, or remediation."""
        logger.info("SecurityAgent executing: %s", task.title)

        staged_files = {}
        for fpath in task.estimated_files:
            self.acquire_lock(fpath, is_exclusive=True)
            content = (
                f"# Security Policy & Audit Specification: {task.title}\n"
                f"# Verified by {self.name} (v2.8)\n\n"
                f"SECURITY_POLICY = {{\n"
                f"    'sanitize_inputs': True,\n"
                f"    'jwt_algorithm': 'RS256',\n"
                f"    'enforce_cors': True,\n"
                f"    'rate_limit': '100/minute',\n"
                f"}}\n"
            )
            staged_files[fpath] = content
            self.stage_code(fpath, content, f"Add security policy for {task.title}")
            self.release_lock(fpath)

        if self.bus:
            self.send_message(
                receiver="*",
                message_type=MessageType.NOTIFICATION,
                payload={
                    "event": "security_audit_completed",
                    "task_id": task.task_id,
                    "status": "PASS",
                },
                task_id=task.task_id,
            )

        return {
            "agent": self.name,
            "role": self.role.value,
            "task_id": task.task_id,
            "action": "security_audit_and_hardening",
            "staged_files": staged_files,
            "summary": f"Completed security auditing and hardening for '{task.title}'.",
        }

"""
security_manager.py - Security Manager Agent (AutoDev Version 3.4)

Directs corporate cybersecurity, vulnerability auditing, and policy enforcement:
- Static Application Security Testing (SAST) & OWASP Top 10 auditing
- Hardcoded secrets and credential leakage detection
- Dependency vulnerability and CVE risk scoring
- Cryptographic hash verification and permissions auditing
- Security Score calculation & Veto authority over releases
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from core.communication_bus import CommunicationBus, MessagePriority, OrgMessage, OrgMessageType
from core.organization_state import OrganizationState

logger = logging.getLogger("AutoDev.Org.SecurityManager")


class SecurityManagerAgent:
    """
    Autonomous Security Manager AI Agent.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str = "Security",
        bus: Optional[CommunicationBus] = None,
        state: Optional[OrganizationState] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.bus = bus
        self.state = state
        self.authority_level = 4  # Director Security (High Veto Authority)

        if self.bus:
            self.bus.register_entity(self.name)

    def audit_code_security(self, code_snippets: List[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Scans code for common OWASP security vulnerabilities."""
        findings = []

        patterns = [
            (r"eval\(", "Use of dangerous eval() statement (Remote Code Execution risk)"),
            (r"exec\(", "Use of dangerous exec() statement (Remote Code Execution risk)"),
            (r"subprocess\.call\(.*shell=True", "Unsanitized shell=True invocation (Command Injection risk)"),
            (r"md5\(", "Weak cryptographic hash algorithm MD5 detected. Use SHA-256 or SHA-512"),
            (r"password\s*=\s*['\"][^'\"]+['\"]", "Possible hardcoded plaintext password detected"),
        ]

        for snippet in code_snippets:
            for pat, desc in patterns:
                if re.search(pat, snippet, re.IGNORECASE):
                    findings.append(desc)

        clean = len(findings) == 0
        score = 100.0 if clean else max(20.0, 100.0 - (len(findings) * 30.0))

        result = {
            "vulnerabilities_found": len(findings),
            "findings": findings,
            "security_score": score,
            "security_gate_status": "APPROVED" if clean else "BLOCKED",
            "timestamp": time.time(),
        }

        if not clean and self.bus:
            self.bus.broadcast(
                sender=self.name,
                message_type=OrgMessageType.SECURITY_FINDING,
                payload=result,
                priority=MessagePriority.CRITICAL,
            )

        logger.info("Security audit completed: Score=%.1f, Findings=%d", score, len(findings))
        return result

    def scan_dependencies(self, dependencies: List[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Audits third-party dependency list against vulnerability database."""
        vulnerable = []
        for dep in dependencies:
            if any(bad in dep.lower() for bad in ["vulnerable", "insecure", "deprecated-pkg"]):
                vulnerable.append(f"Known CVE alert for dependency: {dep}")

        clean = len(vulnerable) == 0
        return {
            "clean": clean,
            "vulnerable_dependencies": vulnerable,
            "approved": clean,
        }

    def calculate_security_score(self, findings_count: int, critical_cves: int = 0) -> float:
        """Computes standardized corporate security score (0.0 to 100.0)."""
        penalty = (critical_cves * 35.0) + (findings_count * 10.0)
        return max(10.0, min(100.0, round(100.0 - penalty, 1)))

"""
AutoDev Collaboration Framework - Base Specialized Engineering Agent (v2.8)
============================================================================
Abstract base foundation for all specialized engineering agents in the
collaborative multi-agent software engineering organization.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import time
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from core.collaboration.collaboration_models import (
    AgentMessage,
    AgentRole,
    MessageType,
    Proposal,
    TaskAssignment,
)

logger = logging.getLogger("autodev.agents.specialized")


class SpecializedAgent(ABC):
    """
    Base autonomous engineering agent with full multi-agent collaboration,
    messaging, workspace locking, code staging, review, and consensus capabilities.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        role: AgentRole,
        llm_client: Optional[Any] = None,
        bus: Optional[Any] = None,
        workspace: Optional[Any] = None,
    ):
        self.name = name
        self.role = role
        self.llm_client = llm_client
        self.bus = bus
        self.workspace = workspace
        self.collaboration_manager: Optional[Any] = None
        self._assigned_tasks: List[TaskAssignment] = []
        self._completed_tasks: List[TaskAssignment] = []

    def bind_collaboration_manager(self, manager: Any) -> None:
        """Connect this agent to the central CollaborationManager."""
        self.collaboration_manager = manager
        if hasattr(manager, "bus"):
            self.bus = manager.bus
        if hasattr(manager, "workspace"):
            self.workspace = manager.workspace

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Inter-Agent Messaging Protocols
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def send_message(
        self,
        receiver: str,
        message_type: MessageType,
        payload: Dict[str, Any],
        task_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> AgentMessage:
        """Send a structured collaboration message across the bus."""
        if not self.bus:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Agent '{self.name}' has no communication bus bound.")

        msg = AgentMessage(
            sender=self.name,
            receiver=receiver,
            message_type=message_type,
            payload=payload,
            task_id=task_id,
        )
        return self.bus.publish(msg)

    def request(
        self,
        receiver: str,
        payload: Dict[str, Any],
        task_id: Optional[str] = None,
        timeout: float = 10.0,
    ) -> Optional[AgentMessage]:
        """Send a synchronous direct REQUEST and wait for RESPONSE."""
        if not self.bus:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Agent '{self.name}' has no communication bus bound.")
        return self.bus.send_request(
            sender=self.name,
            receiver=receiver,
            payload=payload,
            task_id=task_id,
            timeout=timeout,
        )

    def receive_messages(self, filter_type: Optional[MessageType] = None) -> List[AgentMessage]:
        """Fetch all pending messages from this agent's mailbox."""
        if not self.bus:
            return []
        return self.bus.get_mailbox(self.name, filter_type=filter_type)

    def report_blocker(self, task_id: str, reason: str) -> None:
        """Broadcast a task blocker to the entire organization."""
        if self.bus:
            self.bus.report_blocker(self.name, task_id, reason)

    def resolve_blocker(self, task_id: str, resolution_notes: str) -> None:
        """Resolve a previously declared blocker."""
        if self.bus:
            self.bus.resolve_blocker(self.name, task_id, resolution_notes)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Workspace & Lock Management
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def acquire_lock(self, file_path: str, is_exclusive: bool = True, ttl: float = 60.0) -> bool:
        """Acquire an atomic read/write lock on a file in shared workspace."""
        if not self.workspace:
            return True
        lock = self.workspace.acquire_lock(
            file_path=file_path,
            holder=self.name,
            role=self.role,
            is_exclusive=is_exclusive,
            ttl=ttl,
        )
        return lock is not None

    def release_lock(self, file_path: str) -> bool:
        """Release a held lock on a workspace file."""
        if not self.workspace:
            return True
        return self.workspace.release_lock(file_path=file_path, holder=self.name)

    def stage_code(self, file_path: str, content: str, commit_message: str = "") -> None:
        """Stage modified or generated file content into shared workspace memory."""
        if self.workspace:
            self.workspace.stage_change(
                file_path=file_path,
                author_id=self.name,
                role=self.role,
                content=content,
                commit_message=commit_message,
            )

    def submit_review(
        self,
        file_path: str,
        comment: str,
        is_approved: bool = True,
        severity: str = "INFO",
    ) -> None:
        """Submit a formal review or approval for a staged change."""
        if self.workspace:
            self.workspace.add_review_comment(
                file_path=file_path,
                author_id=self.name,
                role=self.role,
                comment=comment,
                severity=severity,
                is_blocking=not is_approved,
            )
            if is_approved:
                self.workspace.approve_staged_change(file_path, reviewer_id=self.name)
            else:
                self.workspace.reject_staged_change(file_path, reviewer_id=self.name, reason=comment)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Proposals & Consensus
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def create_proposal(
        self,
        title: str,
        description: str,
        confidence: float = 0.90,
        tradeoffs: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        spec: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Proposal:
        """Create a structured engineering proposal for consensus voting."""
        return Proposal(
            proposer=self.name,
            role=self.role,
            title=title,
            description=description,
            confidence=confidence,
            tradeoffs=tradeoffs or [],
            spec=spec or {},
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Task Execution Interface
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    @abstractmethod
    def execute_task(
        self,
        task: TaskAssignment,
        context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Execute domain-specific engineering task.
        Must return execution summary dictionary with actions, artifacts, and staged files.
        """
        pass

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<{self.__class__.__name__} name='{self.name}' role='{self.role.value}'>"

"""
agents/statistical_analyst.py - Statistical Analyst Agent (AutoDev Version 3.6)
Strictly 100% Python Standard Library. Zero external dependencies.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from core.communication_bus import CommunicationBus
from core.research_lab import ResearchLab
from core.statistical_analyzer import DescriptiveStatistics, HypothesisTestResult, StatisticalAnalyzer

logger = logging.getLogger("AutoDev.Research.StatisticalAnalyst")


class StatisticalAnalystAgent:
    """
    Statistical Analyst Agent - Arbiter of Mathematical & Inferential Rigor:
    - Computes descriptive metrics, standard deviations, and percentiles
    - Conducts Welch's t-tests, Mann-Whitney U tests, and ANOVA
    - Evaluates Cohen's d effect sizes and statistical power
    - Identifies spurious correlations and confirms statistical significance
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str = "StatisticalAnalyst",
        lab: Optional[ResearchLab] = None,
        bus: Optional[CommunicationBus] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.lab = lab or ResearchLab()
        self.bus = bus
        self.authority_level = 3

        if self.bus:
            self.bus.register_entity(self.name)

    @property
    def role(self) -> str:
        return "Statistical Analyst"

    def analyze_comparative_data(
        self, sample_a: List[float], sample_b: List[float], alpha: float = 0.05
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        result = StatisticalAnalyzer.t_test_two_sample(sample_a, sample_b, alpha)
        return {
            "is_significant": result.is_significant,
            "p_value": result.p_value,
            "t_statistic": result.statistic,
            "effect_size": result.effect_size,
            "alpha": alpha,
        }

    def analyze_dataset(self, data: List[float]) -> DescriptiveStatistics:
        """Computes comprehensive summary statistics for a sample dataset."""
        return StatisticalAnalyzer.summarize(data)

    def compare_treatment_arms(
        self,
        variant_data: List[float],
        control_data: List[float],
        alpha: float = 0.05,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Performs parametric and non-parametric two-sample hypothesis testing."""
        t_res = StatisticalAnalyzer.t_test_two_sample(variant_data, control_data, alpha)
        u_res = StatisticalAnalyzer.mann_whitney_u(variant_data, control_data, alpha)
        norm_var = StatisticalAnalyzer.shapiro_wilk_normality_approx(variant_data)
        norm_ctrl = StatisticalAnalyzer.shapiro_wilk_normality_approx(control_data)

        # Consensus validation
        both_agree = t_res.is_significant == u_res.is_significant
        confidence = "HIGH" if both_agree else "MODERATE"

        return {
            "welch_t_test": t_res.to_dict(),
            "mann_whitney_u": u_res.to_dict(),
            "normality_check": {"variant_normal": norm_var, "control_normal": norm_ctrl},
            "statistical_consensus": confidence,
            "effect_size_cohens_d": t_res.effect_size,
            "analyzed_by": self.name,
        }

    def evaluate_multiple_groups(self, groups: List[List[float]], alpha: float = 0.05) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Conducts one-way Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) across multiple experimental arms."""
        anova_res = StatisticalAnalyzer.one_way_anova(groups, alpha)
        return anova_res.to_dict()

"""
task_planner_agent.py - Task Planner Agent for AutoDev (Version 1)

Responsible for converting the current day's phase from the project context
into an ordered list of atomic implementation tasks saved to memory/tasks.json.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

# Add parent directory to sys.path if run directly as script
if __name__ == "__main__" and __package__ is None:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from core.llm import BaseLLM


@dataclass
class Task:
    """
    Represents an atomic, actionable implementation task.
    """
    id: str
    title: str
    description: str
    priority: int = 1
    status: str = "pending"
    dependencies: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    estimated_files: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    estimated_duration: str = "15 min"

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Converts task instance to a serializable dictionary."""
        return asdict(self)

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Task:
        """Creates a Task instance from a dictionary."""
        return cls(
            id=data["id"],
            title=data["title"],
            description=data.get("description", ""),
            priority=data.get("priority", 1),
            status=data.get("status", "pending"),
            dependencies=data.get("dependencies", []),
            estimated_files=data.get("estimated_files", []),
            estimated_duration=data.get("estimated_duration", "15 min"),
        )


class TaskPlannerAgent:
    """
    Breaks down the active development phase into atomic engineering tasks.
    Supports deterministic synthesis for Version 1 and future LLM integration.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        llm: Optional[BaseLLM] = None,
        output_path: str | Path = "memory/tasks.json",
    ) -> None:
        """
        Initializes the TaskPlannerAgent.

        Args:
            llm: Optional LLM provider instance for future model-driven planning.
            output_path: Target path for saving generated tasks (default: memory/tasks.json).
        """
        self.llm = llm
        self.output_path = Path(output_path)

    def plan_tasks(self, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[Task]:
        """
        Decomposes the current phase within the context into a list of Task objects.

        Args:
            context: Context dictionary produced by ContextBuilder.

        Returns:
            List of structured Task instances.
        """
        if self.llm is not None:
            return self._plan_tasks_with_llm(context)
        return self._plan_tasks_deterministic(context)

    def _plan_tasks_deterministic(self, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[Task]:
        """
        Deterministic task generator for Version 1. Converts phase goals,
        tasks, and deliverables into ordered atomic tasks with dependencies.
        """
        current_day = context.get("current_day", 1)
        current_phase = context.get("current_phase", {}) or {}
        project_name = context.get("project_name", "Project")
        phase_name = current_phase.get("phase_name", f"Day {current_day} Execution")

        raw_tasks = current_phase.get("tasks", [])
        deliverables = current_phase.get("deliverables", [])
        testing_focus = current_phase.get("testing_focus", "Unit and integration tests")

        # Fallback if phase tasks are unspecified
        if not raw_tasks:
            raw_tasks = [
                f"Initialize and configure components for {phase_name}",
                f"Implement core logic for {phase_name}",
                f"Write tests and verify deliverables for {phase_name}",
            ]

        tasks: List[Task] = []
        previous_task_id: Optional[str] = None

        for idx, task_text in enumerate(raw_tasks, start=1):
            task_id = f"DAY{current_day}-TASK{idx:02d}"
            dependencies = [previous_task_id] if previous_task_id else []

            # Estimate files relevant to this atomic step
            est_files: List[str] = []
            if idx <= len(deliverables):
                est_files.append(deliverables[idx - 1])

            tasks.append(
                Task(
                    id=task_id,
                    title=task_text,
                    description=f"Execute: {task_text} as part of {phase_name} on {project_name}.",
                    priority=idx,
                    status="pending",
                    dependencies=dependencies,
                    estimated_files=est_files,
                    estimated_duration=f"{15 + (idx * 5)} min",
                )
            )
            previous_task_id = task_id

        # Append validation / testing task
        test_task_id = f"DAY{current_day}-TASK{len(raw_tasks) + 1:02d}"
        tasks.append(
            Task(
                id=test_task_id,
                title=f"Execute automated validation & {testing_focus}",
                description=f"Verify all Day {current_day} deliverables pass test suite and quality checks.",
                priority=len(raw_tasks) + 1,
                status="pending",
                dependencies=[previous_task_id] if previous_task_id else [],
                estimated_files=["tests/"],
                estimated_duration="20 min",
            )
        )

        return tasks

    def _plan_tasks_with_llm(self, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[Task]:
        """
        Placeholder for future LLM-driven task decomposition.

        Args:
            context: Project context dictionary.

        Returns:
            List of Task instances synthesized by the LLM.
        """
        # In future versions, this will prompt self.llm to produce JSON tasks
        # and parse them into Task instances.
        return self._plan_tasks_deterministic(context)

    def save_tasks(
        self,
        tasks: List[Task],
        output_path: Optional[str | Path] = None,
    ) -> Path:
        """
        Serializes and saves tasks to a JSON file.

        Args:
            tasks: List of Task objects.
            output_path: Target file path override.

        Returns:
            Path object of the saved tasks file.
        """
        target_path = Path(output_path) if output_path else self.output_path
        target_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        serializable = [task.to_dict() for task in tasks]

        with open(target_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(serializable, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

        return target_path

    def load_tasks(self, path: Optional[str | Path] = None) -> List[Task]:
        """
        Loads tasks from a JSON file into Task objects.

        Args:
            path: Optional file path override.

        Returns:
            List of Task objects.
        """
        target_path = Path(path) if path else self.output_path
        if not target_path.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Tasks file not found at '{target_path}'.")

        with open(target_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            data = json.load(f)

        return [Task.from_dict(item) for item in data]

    def execute(self, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[Task]:
        """
        Orchestrates planning and saving tasks from context.

        Args:
            context: Context dictionary produced by ContextBuilder.

        Returns:
            List of generated Task objects.
        """
        tasks = self.plan_tasks(context)
        self.save_tasks(tasks)
        return tasks


if __name__ == "__main__":
    from core.context_builder import build_context

    ctx = build_context()
    planner = TaskPlannerAgent()
    generated_tasks = planner.execute(ctx)

    print(f"Generated {len(generated_tasks)} atomic tasks saved to '{planner.output_path}'.")
    for t in generated_tasks:
        print(f"[{t.id}] (Priority {t.priority}) {t.title} -> {t.status} ({t.estimated_duration})")
