"""
company_brain.py - Central Enterprise Knowledge Brain & Institutional Memory for AutoDev (v3.0)

Provides a centralized, searchable corporate institutional memory covering 10 distinct
knowledge categories: Business Vision, Architecture ADRs, Customer Insights, Product Roadmaps,
Engineering Standards, Financial Metrics, Legal & Compliance, Support KB, Meeting Notes, and Postmortems.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import collections
import copy
import logging
import threading
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple

from core.enterprise.enterprise_models import (
    DepartmentType,
    KnowledgeCategory,
    KnowledgeItem,
)

logger = logging.getLogger("AutoDev.Enterprise.CompanyBrain")


class CompanyBrain:
    """
    Autonomous Enterprise Knowledge & Institutional Memory Engine.
    Stores, indexes, versions, and retrieves cross-departmental documentation, ADRs, and postmortems.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._items: Dict[str, KnowledgeItem] = {}  # knowledge_id -> KnowledgeItem
        self._tag_index: Dict[str, Set[str]] = collections.defaultdict(set)
        self._category_index: Dict[KnowledgeCategory, Set[str]] = collections.defaultdict(set)
        self._links: Dict[str, Set[str]] = collections.defaultdict(set)  # source_id -> set of target_ids

        self._seed_default_knowledge()

    def _seed_default_knowledge(self) -> None:
        """Seeds foundational corporate documentation."""
        seeds = [
            (
                "KB-CORP-01",
                "AutoDev 3.0 Corporate Vision & Operating Principles",
                KnowledgeCategory.BUSINESS_VISION,
                "AutoDev is an autonomous AI software company delivering world-class engineering through deterministic AI agents.",
                ["vision", "principles", "c-suite"],
                "Elena Rostova (CEO)",
                DepartmentType.EXECUTIVE,
            ),
            (
                "KB-ARCH-01",
                "ADR-001: Pure Native Python Standard Library Architecture",
                KnowledgeCategory.ARCHITECTURE_ADR,
                "Strict architectural prohibition on heavy external orchestrators (LangGraph, Ray, Celery). Pure standard library ensures zero bloat.",
                ["architecture", "adr", "python", "standard-library"],
                "Marcus Vance (CTO)",
                DepartmentType.ARCHITECTURE,
            ),
            (
                "KB-ENG-01",
                "Enterprise Engineering Code Quality and TDD Guidelines",
                KnowledgeCategory.ENGINEERING_STANDARDS,
                "All code changes must have 100% backward compatibility, comprehensive pytest suites, strict type annotations, and thread safety.",
                ["engineering", "standards", "tdd", "testing"],
                "David Kim (VP Engineering)",
                DepartmentType.ENGINEERING,
            ),
        ]

        for kid, title, cat, content, tags, author, dept in seeds:
            item = KnowledgeItem(
                knowledge_id=kid,
                title=title,
                category=cat,
                content=content,
                tags=tags,
                author=author,
                source_department=dept,
                version=1,
                created_at=time.time(),
                updated_at=time.time(),
            )
            self._items[kid] = item
            self._category_index[cat].add(kid)
            for t in tags:
                self._tag_index[t.lower()].add(kid)

    def store_knowledge(
        self,
        title: str,
        category: KnowledgeCategory,
        content: str,
        tags: List[str],
        author: str,
        department: DepartmentType,
        knowledge_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> KnowledgeItem:
        """
        Stores or updates a knowledge document with automatic indexing and versioning.
        """
        with self._lock:
            now = time.time()
            if knowledge_id and knowledge_id in self._items:
                existing = self._items[knowledge_id]
                existing.title = title
                existing.category = category
                existing.content = content
                existing.tags = list(tags)
                existing.author = author
                existing.source_department = department
                existing.version += 1
                existing.updated_at = now
                item = existing
            else:
                kid = knowledge_id or f"KB-{category.value[:4]}-{int(now * 1000)}-{len(self._items) + 1:04d}"
                item = KnowledgeItem(
                    knowledge_id=kid,
                    title=title,
                    category=category,
                    content=content,
                    tags=list(tags),
                    author=author,
                    source_department=department,
                    version=1,
                    created_at=now,
                    updated_at=now,
                )
                self._items[kid] = item

            # Update indices
            self._category_index[category].add(item.knowledge_id)
            for t in tags:
                self._tag_index[t.lower()].add(item.knowledge_id)

            logger.info(f"Stored knowledge item [{item.knowledge_id}] v{item.version} under {category.value}")
            return copy.deepcopy(item)

    def link_knowledge(self, source_id: str, target_id: str) -> None:
        """Creates a bidirectional conceptual link between two knowledge entities."""
        with self._lock:
            if source_id in self._items and target_id in self._items:
                self._links[source_id].add(target_id)
                self._links[target_id].add(source_id)

    def search_knowledge(
        self,
        query: str = "",
        category: Optional[KnowledgeCategory] = None,
        tags: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        limit: int = 20,
    ) -> List[KnowledgeItem]:
        """
        Performs full-text keyword, tag, and category search across company institutional knowledge.
        """
        with self._lock:
            candidates: Set[str] = set(self._items.keys())

            if category:
                candidates &= self._category_index.get(category, set())

            if tags:
                for t in tags:
                    tag_matches = self._tag_index.get(t.lower(), set())
                    candidates &= tag_matches

            results: List[KnowledgeItem] = []
            q_lower = query.lower().strip()

            for kid in candidates:
                item = self._items[kid]
                if not q_lower or (
                    q_lower in item.title.lower()
                    or q_lower in item.content.lower()
                    or any(q_lower in t.lower() for t in item.tags)
                ):
                    results.append(item)

            results.sort(key=lambda x: x.updated_at, reverse=True)
            return [copy.deepcopy(x) for x in results[:limit]]

    def get_knowledge(self, knowledge_id: str) -> Optional[KnowledgeItem]:
        """Retrieves a single knowledge item by ID."""
        with self._lock:
            return copy.deepcopy(self._items.get(knowledge_id))

    def get_related_knowledge(self, knowledge_id: str) -> List[KnowledgeItem]:
        """Returns all knowledge items linked to a given entity."""
        with self._lock:
            linked_ids = self._links.get(knowledge_id, set())
            return [copy.deepcopy(self._items[kid]) for kid in linked_ids if kid in self._items]

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Serializes knowledge repository overview."""
        with self._lock:
            return {
                "total_items": len(self._items),
                "categories": {cat.value: len(ids) for cat, ids in self._category_index.items()},
                "tags_count": len(self._tag_index),
                "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self._items.values()],
            }

"""
company_simulator.py - Autonomous Discrete-Event Company Simulator for AutoDev (v3.0)

Simulates the entire autonomous corporate lifecycle across discrete temporal horizons:
- One Workday
- One Sprint (14 Days)
- One Release Cycle
- One Quarter (Q1-Q4)
- Full Operating Year

Executes cross-functional operations: C-suite decisions, product grooming, sprint ceremonies,
architecture reviews, engineering tasks, QA automation, security scans, customer support,
financial accounting, release deployment, and business intelligence reporting.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import logging
import random
import threading
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

from core.enterprise.architecture_board import ArchitectureBoard
from core.enterprise.business_analytics import BusinessAnalytics
from core.enterprise.company_brain import CompanyBrain
from core.enterprise.engineering_manager import EngineeringManager
from core.enterprise.enterprise_models import (
    ArchProposal,
    ArchReviewStatus,
    ComplianceStandard,
    DecisionStatus,
    DepartmentType,
    Epic,
    ExecutiveRole,
    ExpenseCategory,
    GovernancePolicy,
    KnowledgeCategory,
    PriorityLevel,
    ProductFeature,
    ReleaseStage,
    TeamType,
    TicketPriority,
    TicketType,
    UserStory,
)
from core.enterprise.executive_dashboard import ExecutiveDashboard
from core.enterprise.executive_engine import ExecutiveDecisionEngine
from core.enterprise.finance_manager import FinanceManager
from core.enterprise.governance_manager import GovernanceManager
from core.enterprise.hiring_manager import HiringManager
from core.enterprise.organization_graph import OrganizationGraph
from core.enterprise.product_manager import ProductManager
from core.enterprise.release_train import ReleaseTrain
from core.enterprise.sprint_manager import SprintManager
from core.enterprise.support_center import SupportCenter

logger = logging.getLogger("AutoDev.Enterprise.CompanySimulator")


class CompanySimulator:
    """
    Autonomous Enterprise Corporate Lifecycle Simulator.
    Coordinates all autonomous corporate subsystems to simulate realistic enterprise operations.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        executive_engine: Optional[ExecutiveDecisionEngine] = None,
        org_graph: Optional[OrganizationGraph] = None,
        product_mgr: Optional[ProductManager] = None,
        sprint_mgr: Optional[SprintManager] = None,
        arch_board: Optional[ArchitectureBoard] = None,
        eng_mgr: Optional[EngineeringManager] = None,
        hiring_mgr: Optional[HiringManager] = None,
        finance_mgr: Optional[FinanceManager] = None,
        support_center: Optional[SupportCenter] = None,
        analytics: Optional[BusinessAnalytics] = None,
        dashboard: Optional[ExecutiveDashboard] = None,
        release_train: Optional[ReleaseTrain] = None,
        governance_mgr: Optional[GovernanceManager] = None,
        company_brain: Optional[CompanyBrain] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self.executive_engine = executive_engine or ExecutiveDecisionEngine()
        self.org_graph = org_graph or OrganizationGraph()
        self.product_mgr = product_mgr or ProductManager()
        self.sprint_mgr = sprint_mgr or SprintManager()
        self.arch_board = arch_board or ArchitectureBoard()
        self.eng_mgr = eng_mgr or EngineeringManager()
        self.hiring_mgr = hiring_mgr or HiringManager()
        self.finance_mgr = finance_mgr or FinanceManager()
        self.support_center = support_center or SupportCenter()
        self.analytics = analytics or BusinessAnalytics()
        self.dashboard = dashboard or ExecutiveDashboard()
        self.release_train = release_train or ReleaseTrain()
        self.governance_mgr = governance_mgr or GovernanceManager()
        self.company_brain = company_brain or CompanyBrain()

        self._simulation_history: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

    def simulate_workday(self, day_index: int = 1) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Simulates one full autonomous business workday (8 hours):
        - Daily executive sync & decision review
        - Engineering standups & task progress
        - Support ticket triage & resolution
        - Infrastructure & LLM token expense recording
        - Quality assurance & daily briefing generation
        """
        with self._lock:
            start_ts = time.time()
            events: List[str] = []

            # 1. Executive Sync
            events.append(f"Day {day_index}: C-Suite morning alignment meeting conducted.")
            
            # 2. Engineering Standups & Task progress
            active_sprint = self.sprint_mgr.get_active_sprint()
            points_completed_today = 0
            if active_sprint:
                standup = self.sprint_mgr.conduct_daily_standup(day_index=day_index, blocked_story_ids=[])
                events.append(f"Day {day_index}: Standup completed with {len(active_sprint.stories)} stories in flight.")
                
                # Advance some stories
                for story in active_sprint.stories:
                    if story.status in ("IN_PROGRESS", "BACKLOG", "PLANNING"):
                        story.status = "DONE"
                        points_completed_today += story.story_points
                        events.append(f"Day {day_index}: Story [{story.story_id}] completed ({story.story_points} pts).")
                        break
            else:
                events.append(f"Day {day_index}: Engineering maintenance tasks executed across teams.")

            # 3. Customer Support Triage
            ticket = self.support_center.submit_ticket(
                customer_id=f"cust_sim_{day_index}",
                ticket_type=TicketType.BUG_REPORT if day_index % 3 == 0 else TicketType.INQUIRY,
                priority=TicketPriority.P2_MEDIUM,
                title=f"Customer request day {day_index}",
                description=f"Automated customer interaction log for simulation day {day_index}.",
            )
            # Resolve ticket
            self.support_center.resolve_ticket(ticket.ticket_id, "Resolved via automated resolution engine", csat_score=5)
            events.append(f"Day {day_index}: Processed customer ticket [{ticket.ticket_id}] with CSAT 5/5.")

            # 4. Record Daily Operating Expenses
            self.finance_mgr.record_expense(
                category=ExpenseCategory.LLM_API_TOKENS,
                amount_usd=1200.0,
                description=f"LLM API inference tokens for Day {day_index}",
                department=DepartmentType.ENGINEERING,
            )
            self.finance_mgr.record_expense(
                category=ExpenseCategory.INFRASTRUCTURE_CLOUD,
                amount_usd=850.0,
                description=f"Cloud cluster compute for Day {day_index}",
                department=DepartmentType.DEVOPS,
            )
            events.append(f"Day {day_index}: Recorded operational cloud and LLM token expenses.")

            # 5. Audit Logging
            self.governance_mgr.log_audit_event(
                action="WORKDAY_COMPLETED",
                actor="System/CompanySimulator",
                target_entity=f"Day-{day_index}",
                department=DepartmentType.EXECUTIVE,
                details={"day_index": day_index, "points_completed": points_completed_today},
            )

            # 6. Executive Daily Briefing
            briefing = self.dashboard.generate_daily_briefing(
                engineering_kpis={"active_sprints": 1 if active_sprint else 0, "deployments_today": 2, "open_bugs": 0},
                finance_kpis={"cash_reserve_usd": self.finance_mgr.get_cash_reserve_usd(), "runway_months": self.finance_mgr.calculate_runway_months()},
                support_kpis=self.support_center.get_metrics(),
                security_kpis={"open_cves": 0, "compliance_score": 100.0},
            )

            summary = {
                "day_index": day_index,
                "events_count": len(events),
                "events": events,
                "briefing": briefing,
                "duration_ms": round((time.time() - start_ts) * 1000, 2),
            }
            self._simulation_history.append(summary)
            return summary

    def simulate_sprint(self, sprint_number: int = 1, duration_days: int = 14) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Simulates a full 2-week engineering sprint (14 days):
        - Sprint planning & backlog grooming
        - Daily workday cycles
        - Architecture reviews
        - Sprint completion & Retrospective
        """
        with self._lock:
            start_ts = time.time()
            sprint_id = f"SPRINT-{sprint_number:03d}"

            # 1. Product Management grooming
            feature = self.product_mgr.create_feature(
                epic_id="EPIC-CORE",
                name=f"Sprint {sprint_number} Core Feature",
                description="Core platform enhancement delivery.",
                business_value=150.0,
            )
            story = self.product_mgr.create_user_story(
                feature_id=feature.feature_id,
                title=f"Platform Service v{sprint_number}",
                user_role="Developer",
                action="execute high-speed operations",
                benefit="achieve optimal cluster throughput",
                story_points=8,
                priority=PriorityLevel.HIGH,
            )

            # 2. Sprint Planning
            sprint = self.sprint_mgr.plan_sprint(
                sprint_id=sprint_id,
                sprint_number=sprint_number,
                goal=f"Deliver v{sprint_number} Platform Capabilities",
                candidate_stories=[story],
                capacity_points=40,
            )
            self.sprint_mgr.start_sprint(sprint_id)

            # 3. Architecture Review Board
            proposal = self.arch_board.submit_proposal(
                title=f"Architecture for Sprint {sprint_number}",
                author="Marcus Vance (CTO)",
                system_component="CoreEngine",
                changes_summary="Upgraded modular interface and subagent routing.",
                adr_markdown="# ADR: Sprint Evolution\n\nApproved standard library architecture.",
            )

            # 4. Simulate Daily Cycles
            daily_summaries = []
            for d in range(1, duration_days + 1):
                daily_summaries.append(self.simulate_workday(day_index=d))

            # Mark stories done
            for st in sprint.stories:
                st.status = "DONE"

            # 5. Complete Sprint
            completed_sprint = self.sprint_mgr.complete_sprint(
                sprint_id=sprint_id,
                retrospective_notes=[
                    f"Sprint {sprint_number} delivered all committed story points on schedule.",
                    "Zero defect escapes detected in staging QA.",
                ],
            )

            # 6. Analytics Update
            self.analytics.record_sprint_velocity(
                sprint_id=sprint_id,
                points_completed=completed_sprint.completed_points,
                cycle_time_hours=18.5,
            )

            res = {
                "sprint_id": sprint_id,
                "sprint_number": sprint_number,
                "velocity_achieved": completed_sprint.velocity,
                "days_simulated": duration_days,
                "architecture_score": proposal.scorecard.composite_architecture_score,
                "daily_summaries_count": len(daily_summaries),
                "duration_ms": round((time.time() - start_ts) * 1000, 2),
            }
            return res

    def simulate_release(self, target_version: str = "3.0.0") -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Simulates a complete enterprise release lifecycle:
        - Release Candidate creation
        - Automated quality gate execution (Unit tests, Integration, Security, Docs)
        - Multi-executive signoff (CTO, VP Engineering, Director QA, Director Security)
        - Deployment to General Availability (GA)
        - DORA metrics recording
        """
        with self._lock:
            start_ts = time.time()
            rc = self.release_train.create_release_candidate(
                target_version=target_version,
                stage=ReleaseStage.RELEASE_CANDIDATE,
                epics=["EPIC-ENTERPRISE-3.0"],
                features=["Complete Autonomous Organization"],
                bugs=["BUG-001-FIXED"],
            )

            # Validate all gates
            self.release_train.set_gate_status(rc.release_id, "unit_tests_pass", True)
            self.release_train.set_gate_status(rc.release_id, "integration_tests_pass", True)
            self.release_train.set_gate_status(rc.release_id, "security_scan_clean", True)
            self.release_train.set_gate_status(rc.release_id, "performance_sla_met", True)
            self.release_train.set_gate_status(rc.release_id, "docs_updated", True)

            # Executive approvals
            self.release_train.signoff_release(rc.release_id, ExecutiveRole.CTO)
            self.release_train.signoff_release(rc.release_id, ExecutiveRole.VP_ENGINEERING)
            self.release_train.signoff_release(rc.release_id, ExecutiveRole.DIRECTOR_QA)

            # Promote to GA
            ga_release = self.release_train.promote_to_general_availability(rc.release_id)

            # Update DORA deployment analytics
            self.analytics.record_deployment(lead_time_hours=2.1, success=True)

            # Store release notes in Company Brain
            self.company_brain.store_knowledge(
                title=f"Release Notes {target_version}",
                category=KnowledgeCategory.PRODUCT_ROADMAP,
                content=f"AutoDev Version {target_version} successfully deployed to production.",
                tags=["release", "changelog", target_version],
                author="Release Train Automator",
                department=DepartmentType.DEVOPS,
            )

            return {
                "release_id": ga_release.release_id,
                "version": ga_release.version,
                "stage": ga_release.stage.value,
                "status": ga_release.status,
                "approvers": [r.value for r in ga_release.approved_by],
                "duration_ms": round((time.time() - start_ts) * 1000, 2),
            }

    def simulate_quarter(self, quarter: str = "Q1", year: int = 2026) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Simulates an entire business quarter (6 sprints / 90 days):
        - Strategic goal formulation & budget setup
        - Execution of 6 sprints
        - Quarterly release delivery
        - Hiring & headcount expansion
        - QBR report generation
        """
        with self._lock:
            start_ts = time.time()
            
            # 1. Strategic Goals
            goal = self.executive_engine.create_strategic_goal(
                goal_id=f"GOAL-{year}-{quarter}-01",
                title=f"{quarter} ARR Target",
                description=f"Achieve enterprise software delivery milestones for {quarter} {year}",
                target_quarter=quarter,
                target_year=year,
                target_metric="ARR_USD",
                target_value=2500000.0,
            )

            # 2. Hiring Requisition
            posting = self.hiring_mgr.create_job_posting(
                title=f"Senior AI Systems Engineer ({quarter})",
                department=DepartmentType.ENGINEERING,
                team=TeamType.AI_ML,
                required_skills=["Python", "Distributed Systems", "LLM Orchestration"],
                salary_range_usd=(160000.0, 200000.0),
                headcount=2,
            )
            cand = self.hiring_mgr.apply_candidate(
                job_id=posting.job_id,
                name="Dr. Jane Doe",
                skills=["Python", "Distributed Systems", "LLM Orchestration"],
                experience_years=8.0,
            )
            self.hiring_mgr.conduct_interview(cand.candidate_id, interview_score=94.0)
            emp = self.hiring_mgr.extend_offer_and_hire(cand.candidate_id, salary_usd=185000.0)

            # 3. Simulate Sprints
            sprint_results = []
            for s in range(1, 4):  # 3 major sprints simulated for test efficiency
                sprint_results.append(self.simulate_sprint(sprint_number=s, duration_days=5))

            # 4. Deliver Quarterly Release
            rel_result = self.simulate_release(target_version=f"3.{quarter.lower().replace('q','')}.0")

            # 5. QBR Executive Review
            qbr = self.dashboard.generate_quarterly_business_review(
                strategic_goals_progress=[goal.to_dict()],
                finance_summary=self.finance_mgr.to_dict(),
                product_summary=self.product_mgr.to_dict(),
                dora_summary=self.analytics.get_dora_metrics().to_dict(),
            )

            return {
                "quarter": quarter,
                "year": year,
                "goal_progress_pct": goal.progress_pct,
                "hired_employees": [emp.name],
                "sprints_completed": len(sprint_results),
                "release": rel_result,
                "qbr": qbr,
                "duration_ms": round((time.time() - start_ts) * 1000, 2),
            }

    def simulate_year(self, year: int = 2026) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Simulates an entire operating year across Q1, Q2, Q3, and Q4.
        """
        with self._lock:
            start_ts = time.time()
            quarter_results = {}
            for q in ["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"]:
                quarter_results[q] = self.simulate_quarter(quarter=q, year=year)

            return {
                "simulation_year": year,
                "quarters": quarter_results,
                "final_cash_reserve_usd": self.finance_mgr.get_cash_reserve_usd(),
                "final_headcount": len(self.hiring_mgr.list_employees()),
                "dora_tier": self.analytics.get_dora_metrics().dora_tier,
                "total_releases": len(self.release_train.list_releases()),
                "total_duration_ms": round((time.time() - start_ts) * 1000, 2),
            }

"""
engineering_manager.py - Engineering Department & Cross-Team Workload Allocation for AutoDev (v3.0)

Supervises specialized engineering teams (Backend, Frontend, Mobile, AI/ML, Infrastructure, Database,
QA Automation, Platform), allocates user stories, and tracks team productivity metrics.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import logging
import threading
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple

from core.enterprise.enterprise_models import (
    EmployeeProfile,
    TeamType,
    UserStory,
)

logger = logging.getLogger("AutoDev.Enterprise.Engineering")


@dataclass
class EngineeringTeam:
    team_type: TeamType
    name: str
    lead_id: str
    members: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)  # employee_ids
    assigned_tasks: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    active_stories: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    current_workload_points: int = 0
    capacity_points: int = 40
    velocity_points: float = 35.0
    defect_density_per_kloc: float = 0.5

    @property
    def is_overloaded(self) -> bool:
        return self.current_workload_points > self.capacity_points

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "team_type": self.team_type.value,
            "name": self.name,
            "lead_id": self.lead_id,
            "members": self.members,
            "assigned_tasks": self.assigned_tasks,
            "current_workload_points": self.current_workload_points,
            "capacity_points": self.capacity_points,
            "velocity_points": self.velocity_points,
            "is_overloaded": self.is_overloaded,
        }


class EngineeringManager:
    """
    Engineering Department Management Engine.
    Coordinates specialized engineering teams, balances sprint workloads, and tracks team output.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._teams: Dict[TeamType, EngineeringTeam] = {}
        self._story_assignments: Dict[str, TeamType] = {}
        self._tasks: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}

        self._init_default_teams()

    def _init_default_teams(self) -> None:
        """Constructs standard engineering team matrix."""
        team_specs = [
            (TeamType.BACKEND, "Core Backend & Distributed Systems", "lead_backend", ["emp_b1", "emp_b2", "emp_b3"]),
            (TeamType.FRONTEND, "Web & Client Interfaces", "lead_frontend", ["emp_f1", "emp_f2"]),
            (TeamType.MOBILE, "Mobile Client Applications", "lead_mobile", ["emp_m1"]),
            (TeamType.AI_ML, "AI Agent Synthesis & ML Systems", "lead_ai", ["emp_ai1", "emp_ai2"]),
            (TeamType.INFRASTRUCTURE, "Cloud Infra & Cluster Fabric", "lead_infra", ["emp_i1", "emp_i2"]),
            (TeamType.DATABASE, "Storage & Data Architectures", "lead_db", ["emp_db1"]),
            (TeamType.QA_AUTOMATION, "Test Automation & Quality Gates", "lead_qa", ["emp_qa1", "emp_qa2"]),
            (TeamType.PLATFORM, "Developer Platform & CI/CD Tooling", "lead_plat", ["emp_p1"]),
            (TeamType.PRODUCT_OPS, "Product Operations & Release QA", "lead_prodops", ["emp_po1"]),
            (TeamType.SECURITY_OPS, "Security Operations & Vulnerability Response", "lead_sec", ["emp_sec1"]),
            (TeamType.CORE_SERVICES, "Core Shared Services & Messaging Bus", "lead_core", ["emp_cs1"]),
        ]

        for tt, name, lead, members in team_specs:
            self._teams[tt] = EngineeringTeam(
                team_type=tt,
                name=name,
                lead_id=lead,
                members=members,
            )

    def assign_task(
        self,
        task_id: str,
        team: TeamType,
        title: str,
        story_points: int = 3,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Assigns an engineering task to a team."""
        with self._lock:
            if team not in self._teams:
                team = TeamType.BACKEND

            t_obj = self._teams[team]
            t_obj.assigned_tasks.append(task_id)
            t_obj.current_workload_points += story_points

            task_rec = {
                "task_id": task_id,
                "team": team.value,
                "title": title,
                "story_points": story_points,
                "status": "ASSIGNED",
            }
            self._tasks[task_id] = task_rec
            logger.info("Assigned task %s ('%s', %d pts) to team %s", task_id, title, story_points, team.value)
            return task_rec

    def record_work_completed(self, team: TeamType, points: int) -> None:
        """Records completed engineering story points for a team."""
        with self._lock:
            if team in self._teams:
                t_obj = self._teams[team]
                t_obj.current_workload_points = max(0, t_obj.current_workload_points - points)
                t_obj.velocity_points += float(points)

    def get_overloaded_teams(self) -> List[EngineeringTeam]:
        """Returns teams where active workload exceeds capacity."""
        with self._lock:
            return [copy.deepcopy(t) for t in self._teams.values() if t.is_overloaded]

    def allocate_story_to_team(self, story: UserStory, target_team: Optional[TeamType] = None) -> TeamType:
        """
        Allocates a user story to the optimal engineering team based on skills or explicit team target.
        """
        with self._lock:
            if target_team and target_team in self._teams:
                team_type = target_team
            else:
                title_lower = (story.title + " " + story.action).lower()
                if "front" in title_lower or "ui" in title_lower or "dashboard" in title_lower:
                    team_type = TeamType.FRONTEND
                elif "ai" in title_lower or "llm" in title_lower or "model" in title_lower:
                    team_type = TeamType.AI_ML
                elif "qa" in title_lower or "test" in title_lower or "verify" in title_lower:
                    team_type = TeamType.QA_AUTOMATION
                elif "infra" in title_lower or "cluster" in title_lower or "cloud" in title_lower:
                    team_type = TeamType.INFRASTRUCTURE
                elif "db" in title_lower or "database" in title_lower or "storage" in title_lower:
                    team_type = TeamType.DATABASE
                else:
                    team_type = TeamType.BACKEND

            team = self._teams[team_type]
            team.active_stories.append(story.story_id)
            team.current_workload_points += story.story_points
            self._story_assignments[story.story_id] = team_type
            logger.debug("Allocated story %s ('%s') to %s", story.story_id, story.title, team_type.value)
            return team_type

    def get_team(self, team_type: TeamType) -> Optional[EngineeringTeam]:
        with self._lock:
            t = self._teams.get(team_type)
            return copy.deepcopy(t) if t else None

    def list_teams(self) -> List[EngineeringTeam]:
        with self._lock:
            return [copy.deepcopy(t) for t in self._teams.values()]

    def get_metrics(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Calculates aggregate engineering department metrics."""
        with self._lock:
            total_engineers = sum(len(t.members) + 1 for t in self._teams.values())
            total_active_workload = sum(t.current_workload_points for t in self._teams.values())
            total_velocity = sum(t.velocity_points for t in self._teams.values())

            return {
                "total_teams": len(self._teams),
                "total_headcount": total_engineers,
                "total_active_workload_points": total_active_workload,
                "total_velocity_points": round(total_velocity, 2),
                "teams": {t.team_type.value: t.to_dict() for t in self._teams.values()}
            }

    get_engineering_metrics = get_metrics

enterprise_models.py - Enterprise Domain Models & Data Contracts for AutoDev (v3.0)

Defines data contracts, enumerations, DTOs, and schemas across all corporate departments
including Executive, Product, Sprint, Architecture, Engineering, HR, Finance, Support,
Analytics, Release Train, Governance, Company Brain, and Simulation.

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field

@dataclass

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> ExecutiveProfile:
        d = dict(data)
        d["role"] = ExecutiveRole(d["role"]) if isinstance(d["role"], str) else d["role"]
        d["department"] = DepartmentType(d["department"]) if isinstance(d["department"], str) else d["department"]
        return cls(**d)


@dataclass
class ExecutiveDecision:
    decision_id: str

    description: str
    proposer_role: ExecutiveRole
    required_signoffs: List[ExecutiveRole]
    signoffs_received: Dict[str, bool] = field(default_factory=dict)  # role -> approved

    strategic_alignment_score: float = 100.0  # 0-100

        d["required_signoffs"] = [r.value for r in self.required_signoffs]
        d["veto_role"] = self.veto_role.value if self.veto_role else None
        d["status"] = self.status.value
        return d

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> ExecutiveDecision:
        d = dict(data)
        d["proposer_role"] = ExecutiveRole(d["proposer_role"]) if isinstance(d["proposer_role"], str) else d["proposer_role"]
        d["required_signoffs"] = [ExecutiveRole(r) if isinstance(r, str) else r for r in d.get("required_signoffs", [])]
        d["veto_role"] = ExecutiveRole(d["veto_role"]) if d.get("veto_role") else None
        d["status"] = DecisionStatus(d["status"]) if isinstance(d["status"], str) else d["status"]
        return cls(**d)


@dataclass

    goal_id: str

    description: str

    target_value: float = 1000000.0
    current_value: float = 0.0
    status: str = "IN_PROGRESS"

    @property
    def progress_pct(self) -> float:
        if self.target_value == 0:
            return 100.0
        return min(100.0, max(0.0, (self.current_value / self.target_value) * 100.0))

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        d = asdict(self)
        d["owner_role"] = self.owner_role.value
        d["progress_pct"] = round(self.progress_pct, 2)

    impact: float = 2.0        # RICE Impact (0.5 to 3.0)
    confidence: float = 0.8    # RICE Confidence (0.0 to 1.0)
    effort: float = 5.0        # RICE Effort (story points or weeks)
    user_stories: List[UserStory] = field(default_factory=list)
    target_release: str = "v1.0.0"
    dependencies: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    status: str = "PLANNED"

    @property
    def rice_score(self) -> float:
        eff = max(0.1, self.effort)
        return (self.reach * self.impact * self.confidence) / eff

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        d = asdict(self)
        d["rice_score"] = round(self.rice_score, 2)
        d["user_stories"] = [s.to_dict() for s in self.user_stories]
        return d

class ArchitectureScorecard:
    solid_score: float = 90.0        # 0-100
    ddd_score: float = 85.0          # 0-100
    layering_score: float = 95.0     # 0-100
    scalability_score: float = 90.0  # 0-100
    security_score: float = 95.0     # 0-100
    performance_score: float = 88.0  # 0-100
    maintainability_score: float = 92.0 # 0-100
    complexity_penalty: float = 10.0 # 0-100
    testability_score: float = 90.0  # 0-100

    @property
    def composite_architecture_score(self) -> float:
        base = (
            self.solid_score * 0.15 +
            self.ddd_score * 0.10 +
            self.layering_score * 0.15 +
            self.scalability_score * 0.15 +
            self.security_score * 0.15 +
            self.performance_score * 0.10 +
            self.maintainability_score * 0.10 +
            self.testability_score * 0.10
        )
        final_score = max(0.0, min(100.0, base - (self.complexity_penalty * 0.2)))
        return round(final_score, 2)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        d = asdict(self)
        d["composite_architecture_score"] = self.composite_architecture_score
        return d

"""
enterprise_orchestrator.py - Enterprise Company Orchestrator for AutoDev (v3.0)

Provides the master EnterpriseCompany orchestrator that unites all corporate departments:
C-Suite, Product Management, Sprint Management, Architecture Review Board, Engineering Teams,
HR/Hiring, Finance, Customer Support, Business Analytics, Executive Dashboards, Release Train,
Corporate Governance, and the Company Knowledge Brain.

Implements the end-to-end autonomous corporate lifecycle:
CEO Vision -> Product Roadmap -> Sprint Planning -> Architecture Review -> Engineering Allocation ->
Code Review & Testing -> Security Review -> Release Approval -> Deployment -> Customer Feedback ->
Analytics & DORA -> Executive QBR Reporting.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import json
import logging
import threading
import time

logger = logging.getLogger("AutoDev.Enterprise.Orchestrator")


class EnterpriseCompany:
    """
    Complete Autonomous AI Software Company (Version 3.0).
    Orchestrates all corporate departments, workflows, governance, and business lifecycles.
    """

    def __init__(self, company_name: str = "AutoDev Autonomous Technologies Inc.") -> None:
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self.company_name = company_name
        self.started_at = time.time()

        # Instantiate corporate subsystems
        self.executive_engine = ExecutiveDecisionEngine()
        self.org_graph = OrganizationGraph()
        self.product_mgr = ProductManager()
        self.sprint_mgr = SprintManager()
        self.arch_board = ArchitectureBoard()
        self.eng_mgr = EngineeringManager()
        self.hiring_mgr = HiringManager()
        self.finance_mgr = FinanceManager()
        self.support_center = SupportCenter()
        self.analytics = BusinessAnalytics()
        self.dashboard = ExecutiveDashboard()
        self.release_train = ReleaseTrain()
        self.governance_mgr = GovernanceManager()
        self.company_brain = CompanyBrain()

        # Connect Support Center auto-conversion hook to Engineering Manager
        self.support_center.set_engineering_task_hook(self._handle_support_engineering_task)

        # Discrete-event simulator
        self.simulator = CompanySimulator(
            executive_engine=self.executive_engine,
            org_graph=self.org_graph,
            product_mgr=self.product_mgr,
            sprint_mgr=self.sprint_mgr,
            arch_board=self.arch_board,
            eng_mgr=self.eng_mgr,
            hiring_mgr=self.hiring_mgr,
            finance_mgr=self.finance_mgr,
            support_center=self.support_center,
            analytics=self.analytics,
            dashboard=self.dashboard,
            release_train=self.release_train,
            governance_mgr=self.governance_mgr,
            company_brain=self.company_brain,
        )

        logger.info(f"🏛️ {self.company_name} fully initialized with 15 C-Suite roles & 8 engineering teams.")

    def _handle_support_engineering_task(self, task_info: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        """Internal callback when a customer support ticket triggers an engineering task."""
        team_str = task_info.get("team", TeamType.CORE_SERVICES.value)
        try:
            team = TeamType(team_str)
        except ValueError:
            team = TeamType.CORE_SERVICES

        self.eng_mgr.assign_task(
            task_id=task_info["task_id"],
            team=team,
            title=task_info["title"],
            story_points=3,
        )

    def run_enterprise_lifecycle(
        self,
        strategic_goal: str,
        target_version: str = "3.0.0",
        budget_usd: float = 250000.0,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Executes the entire end-to-end enterprise software lifecycle autonomously:
        1. CEO Strategy & Executive Decision
        2. Product Vision -> Epics -> Features -> User Stories (RICE scored)
        3. Sprint Planning & Capacity Allocation
        4. Architecture Review Board Evaluation (SOLID, DDD, Scalability)
        5. Engineering Workload Distribution across 8 Teams
        6. Quality Assurance, Automated Testing & Security Scan
        7. Release Train Quality Gates Verification & Multi-Executive Signoffs
        8. Production Deployment to General Availability (GA)
        9. Customer Support Triage & Feedback Ingestion
        10. Business Analytics (DORA Metrics) & C-Suite Executive Briefing
        """
        with self._lock:
            start_ts = time.time()
            lifecycle_log: List[str] = []

            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            # Stage 1: CEO Strategic Vision & Executive Decision
            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            decision = self.executive_engine.propose_decision(
                title=f"Strategic Initiative: {strategic_goal}",
                description=f"Executive mandate to deliver {strategic_goal} for version {target_version}",
                proposer_role=ExecutiveRole.CEO,
                required_signoffs=[ExecutiveRole.CTO, ExecutiveRole.VP_PRODUCT, ExecutiveRole.VP_ENGINEERING, ExecutiveRole.DIRECTOR_FINANCE],
                budget_impact_usd=budget_usd,
                strategic_alignment_score=98.0,
                risk_score=15.0,
            )
            # Gather executive signoffs
            for role in [ExecutiveRole.CTO, ExecutiveRole.VP_PRODUCT, ExecutiveRole.VP_ENGINEERING, ExecutiveRole.DIRECTOR_FINANCE]:
                self.executive_engine.signoff_decision(decision.decision_id, role, approved=True)

            self.governance_mgr.log_audit_event(
                action="EXECUTIVE_DECISION_APPROVED",
                actor="Elena Rostova (CEO)",
                target_entity=decision.decision_id,
                department=DepartmentType.EXECUTIVE,
                details={"title": decision.title, "budget_usd": budget_usd},
            )
            lifecycle_log.append(f"Stage 1 [CEO]: Executive Decision [{decision.decision_id}] approved by C-Suite.")

            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            # Stage 2: Product Management Breakdown
            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            epic = self.product_mgr.create_epic(
                title=f"Epic: {strategic_goal}",
                description=f"End-to-end product delivery of {strategic_goal}",
                strategic_theme="Autonomous Enterprise Scaling",
                target_quarter="Q1",
            )
            feature = self.product_mgr.create_feature(
                epic_id=epic.epic_id,
                name=f"Enterprise Subsystem {target_version}",
                description=f"Core architectural functionality for {strategic_goal}",
                reach=5000,
                impact=3.0,
                confidence=0.9,
                effort=8.0,
            )
            story = self.product_mgr.create_user_story(
                feature_id=feature.feature_id,
                title=f"Implement {strategic_goal}",
                user_role="Enterprise Customer",
                action="operate complete autonomous organization",
                benefit="achieve 100x engineering velocity without manual intervention",
                story_points=13,
                priority=PriorityLevel.CRITICAL,
            )
            self.product_mgr.add_acceptance_criterion(
                story.story_id,
                given="an enterprise workload with multi-department requirements",
                when="submitted to AutoDev 3.0",
                then="all C-Suite, Sprint, Architecture, and QA gates execute deterministically",
            )
            lifecycle_log.append(f"Stage 2 [Product]: Created Epic [{epic.epic_id}], Feature (RICE: {feature.rice_score}), Story [{story.story_id}].")

            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            # Stage 3: Sprint Planning & Capacity Allocation
            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            sprint_id = f"SPRINT-{int(time.time())}"
            sprint = self.sprint_mgr.plan_sprint(
                sprint_id=sprint_id,
                sprint_number=1,
                goal=f"Deliver {strategic_goal}",
                candidate_stories=[story],
                capacity_points=40,
            )
            self.sprint_mgr.start_sprint(sprint_id)
            lifecycle_log.append(f"Stage 3 [Sprint]: Sprint [{sprint_id}] started with {sprint.committed_points} committed points.")

            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            # Stage 4: Architecture Review Board (ARB) Evaluation
            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            arch_proposal = self.arch_board.submit_proposal(
                title=f"Architecture Specification for {target_version}",
                author="Marcus Vance (CTO)",
                system_component="EnterpriseOrchestrator",
                changes_summary="Standard library architecture adhering to SOLID, DDD, and Clean Architecture principles.",
                adr_markdown=f"# ADR: {strategic_goal}\n\nApproved architecture for {target_version}.",
            )
            lifecycle_log.append(
                f"Stage 4 [Architecture]: Architecture Score {arch_proposal.scorecard.composite_architecture_score}/100 ({arch_proposal.review_status.value})."
            )

            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            # Stage 5: Engineering Department Execution
            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            self.eng_mgr.assign_task(
                task_id=f"ENG-TASK-{story.story_id}",
                team=TeamType.BACKEND,
                title=story.title,
                story_points=story.story_points,
            )
            self.eng_mgr.record_work_completed(TeamType.BACKEND, story.story_points)
            self.finance_mgr.record_expense(
                category=ExpenseCategory.ENGINEERING_SALARIES,
                amount_usd=25000.0,
                description=f"Sprint engineering delivery for {strategic_goal}",
                department=DepartmentType.ENGINEERING,
            )
            story.status = "DONE"
            self.sprint_mgr.complete_sprint(
                sprint_id,
                retrospective_notes=[f"Flawless execution of {strategic_goal}"],
            )
            lifecycle_log.append("Stage 5 [Engineering]: Delivered engineering tasks across specialized teams.")

            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            # Stage 6: QA Automation & Security Verification
            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            self.finance_mgr.record_expense(
                category=ExpenseCategory.TESTING_QA,
                amount_usd=5000.0,
                description="Automated pytest regression verification",
                department=DepartmentType.QA,
            )
            lifecycle_log.append("Stage 6 [QA & Security]: Automated test suites passed; 0 security vulnerabilities.")

            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            # Stage 7: Release Train & Quality Gate Signoffs
            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            rc = self.release_train.create_release_candidate(
                target_version=target_version,
                stage=ReleaseStage.RELEASE_CANDIDATE,
                epics=[epic.epic_id],
                features=[feature.name],
            )
            self.release_train.set_gate_status(rc.release_id, "unit_tests_pass", True)
            self.release_train.set_gate_status(rc.release_id, "integration_tests_pass", True)
            self.release_train.set_gate_status(rc.release_id, "security_scan_clean", True)
            self.release_train.set_gate_status(rc.release_id, "performance_sla_met", True)
            self.release_train.set_gate_status(rc.release_id, "docs_updated", True)

            # Executive Approvals
            self.release_train.signoff_release(rc.release_id, ExecutiveRole.CTO)
            self.release_train.signoff_release(rc.release_id, ExecutiveRole.VP_ENGINEERING)
            self.release_train.signoff_release(rc.release_id, ExecutiveRole.DIRECTOR_QA)
            self.release_train.signoff_release(rc.release_id, ExecutiveRole.DIRECTOR_SECURITY)

            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            # Stage 8: Production Deployment (General Availability)
            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            ga_release = self.release_train.promote_to_general_availability(rc.release_id)
            self.analytics.record_deployment(lead_time_hours=1.8, success=True)
            lifecycle_log.append(f"Stage 8 [Release]: Successfully deployed {ga_release.version} to GENERAL_AVAILABILITY.")

            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            # Stage 9: Customer Support & Feedback Loop
            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            ticket = self.support_center.submit_ticket(
                customer_id="enterprise_client_001",
                ticket_type=TicketType.INQUIRY,
                priority=TicketPriority.P3_LOW,
                title=f"Confirmation of {target_version} rollout",
                description="Client confirmed seamless upgrade and zero downtime.",
            )
            self.support_center.resolve_ticket(
                ticket.ticket_id,
                resolution_notes="Customer upgrade verified successfully.",
                csat_score=5,
            )
            lifecycle_log.append(f"Stage 9 [Support]: Customer verified {target_version} with CSAT 5/5.")

            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            # Stage 10: Institutional Memory & Executive Dashboard
            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            self.company_brain.store_knowledge(
                title=f"Architecture & Release Record: {target_version}",
                category=KnowledgeCategory.ARCHITECTURE_ADR,
                content=f"AutoDev Version {target_version} successfully deployed under strategic initiative '{strategic_goal}'.",
                tags=["release", "adr", target_version, "enterprise"],
                author="Elena Rostova (CEO)",
                department=DepartmentType.EXECUTIVE,
            )

            briefing = self.dashboard.generate_daily_briefing(
                engineering_kpis={"active_sprints": 0, "deployments_today": 1, "open_bugs": 0, "dora_tier": self.analytics.get_dora_metrics().dora_tier},
                finance_kpis={"cash_reserve_usd": self.finance_mgr.get_cash_reserve_usd(), "runway_months": self.finance_mgr.calculate_runway_months()},
                support_kpis=self.support_center.get_metrics(),
                security_kpis={"open_cves": 0, "compliance_score": 100.0},
            )
            lifecycle_log.append("Stage 10 [Analytics & BI]: Executive briefing generated; knowledge indexed in Company Brain.")

            total_duration_ms = round((time.time() - start_ts) * 1000, 2)
            return {
                "status": "SUCCESS",
                "strategic_goal": strategic_goal,
                "deployed_version": ga_release.version,
                "lifecycle_log": lifecycle_log,
                "architecture_score": arch_proposal.scorecard.composite_architecture_score,
                "dora_tier": self.analytics.get_dora_metrics().dora_tier,
                "csat_average": self.support_center.get_average_csat(),
                "cash_reserve_usd": self.finance_mgr.get_cash_reserve_usd(),
                "duration_ms": total_duration_ms,
            }

    def get_company_overview(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Returns comprehensive real-time company operational status."""
        with self._lock:
            return {
                "company_name": self.company_name,
                "active_version": self.release_train.get_current_version(),
                "executives_count": len(self.executive_engine.list_executives()),
                "employees_count": len(self.hiring_mgr.list_employees()),
                "total_spending_usd": self.finance_mgr.get_total_spend_usd(),
                "cash_reserve_usd": self.finance_mgr.get_cash_reserve_usd(),
                "runway_months": self.finance_mgr.calculate_runway_months(),
                "dora_metrics": self.analytics.get_dora_metrics().to_dict(),
                "support_metrics": self.support_center.get_metrics(),
                "knowledge_items_count": len(self.company_brain._items),
                "compliance_valid": self.governance_mgr.verify_audit_trail_integrity()[0],
            }

"""
executive_dashboard.py - C-Suite Executive Business Intelligence Dashboard for AutoDev (v3.0)

Synthesizes high-level corporate metrics into daily briefings, weekly operational reviews,
monthly scorecards, and quarterly business reviews (QBR) across Engineering, Finance,
Support, Security, Infrastructure, Product, and Quality.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import logging
import threading
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

logger = logging.getLogger("AutoDev.Enterprise.ExecutiveDashboard")


class ExecutiveDashboard:
    """
    C-Suite Executive Dashboard and Business Intelligence Hub.
    Aggregates cross-departmental KPIs, risk matrices, and strategic goal telemetry.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._cached_reports: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}

    def generate_daily_briefing(
        self,
        engineering_kpis: Dict[str, Any],
        finance_kpis: Dict[str, Any],
        support_kpis: Dict[str, Any],
        security_kpis: Dict[str, Any],
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Generates the CEO/Executive daily briefing report."""
        with self._lock:
            report = {
                "report_type": "DAILY_EXECUTIVE_BRIEFING",
                "timestamp": time.time(),
                "summary": "Daily enterprise operations are running smoothly with high system health.",
                "engineering": {
                    "active_sprints": engineering_kpis.get("active_sprints", 1),
                    "deployments_today": engineering_kpis.get("deployments_today", 3),
                    "open_bugs": engineering_kpis.get("open_bugs", 2),
                    "dora_tier": engineering_kpis.get("dora_tier", "ELITE"),
                },
                "finance": {
                    "cash_reserve_usd": finance_kpis.get("cash_reserve_usd", 10000000.0),
                    "daily_burn_usd": finance_kpis.get("daily_burn_usd", 15000.0),
                    "runway_months": finance_kpis.get("runway_months", 36.0),
                },
                "customer_support": {
                    "open_tickets": support_kpis.get("open_tickets", 4),
                    "avg_csat": support_kpis.get("avg_csat", 4.9),
                    "sla_compliance_pct": support_kpis.get("sla_compliance_pct", 98.5),
                },
                "security": {
                    "open_cves": security_kpis.get("open_cves", 0),
                    "compliance_score": security_kpis.get("compliance_score", 100.0),
                    "branch_protection_enforced": security_kpis.get("branch_protection_enforced", True),
                },
                "risks": self._evaluate_risks(engineering_kpis, finance_kpis, support_kpis, security_kpis),
            }
            self._cached_reports["daily"] = report
            return report

    def generate_weekly_report(
        self,
        engineering_kpis: Dict[str, Any],
        finance_kpis: Dict[str, Any],
        support_kpis: Dict[str, Any],
        product_kpis: Dict[str, Any],
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Generates weekly operational review scorecard."""
        with self._lock:
            report = {
                "report_type": "WEEKLY_OPERATIONAL_REVIEW",
                "timestamp": time.time(),
                "highlights": [
                    "Sprint velocity tracking on target",
                    "Customer CSAT maintained above 4.8",
                    "Budget burn within quarterly allocation",
                ],
                "engineering_velocity": {
                    "points_delivered": engineering_kpis.get("points_delivered", 38),
                    "pr_reviews_completed": engineering_kpis.get("pr_reviews_completed", 42),
                    "lead_time_hours": engineering_kpis.get("lead_time_hours", 2.5),
                },
                "financial_health": {
                    "weekly_spend_usd": finance_kpis.get("weekly_spend_usd", 85000.0),
                    "quarter_budget_used_pct": finance_kpis.get("quarter_budget_used_pct", 24.5),
                },
                "product_progress": {
                    "active_epics": product_kpis.get("active_epics", 3),
                    "features_completed": product_kpis.get("features_completed", 8),
                },
            }
            self._cached_reports["weekly"] = report
            return report

    def generate_quarterly_business_review(
        self,
        strategic_goals_progress: List[Dict[str, Any]],
        finance_summary: Dict[str, Any],
        product_summary: Dict[str, Any],
        dora_summary: Dict[str, Any],
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Generates Quarterly Business Review (QBR) executive deck."""
        with self._lock:
            report = {
                "report_type": "QUARTERLY_BUSINESS_REVIEW",
                "timestamp": time.time(),
                "executive_summary": "AutoDev QBR: Strategic objectives accomplished with positive ROI.",
                "strategic_goals": strategic_goals_progress,
                "financials": finance_summary,
                "product_deliverables": product_summary,
                "dora_scorecard": dora_summary,
                "outlook_next_quarter": {
                    "priorities": ["Expand autonomous agent capabilities", "Scale enterprise governance"],
                    "projected_revenue_growth_pct": 35.0,
                },
            }
            self._cached_reports["qbr"] = report
            return report

    def _evaluate_risks(
        self,
        engineering: Dict[str, Any],
        finance: Dict[str, Any],
        support: Dict[str, Any],
        security: Dict[str, Any],
    ) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
        """Evaluates corporate risks across all business pillars."""
        risks = []
        if finance.get("runway_months", 24) < 12:
            risks.append({"category": "FINANCE", "level": "HIGH", "detail": "Runway below 12 months threshold."})
        if security.get("open_cves", 0) > 0:
            risks.append({"category": "SECURITY", "level": "CRITICAL", "detail": "Unresolved CVE vulnerabilities detected."})
        if support.get("sla_compliance_pct", 100) < 95.0:
            risks.append({"category": "SUPPORT", "level": "MEDIUM", "detail": "Customer SLA compliance dipped below 95%."})
        if not risks:
            risks.append({"category": "OVERALL", "level": "LOW", "detail": "All key risk indicators in healthy green zone."})
        return risks

    def get_latest_report(self, report_type: str = "daily") -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Retrieves most recent cached report."""
        with self._lock:
            return copy.deepcopy(self._cached_reports.get(report_type))

             ["Headcount Planning", "Hiring Execution", "Performance Reviews"], ["COMPENSATION", "PROMOTIONS"], 400000.0, 0.4),
            (ExecutiveRole.LEGAL_COUNSEL, "General Legal Counsel", "Evelyn Cross", DepartmentType.LEGAL,
             ["Regulatory Compliance", "IP Protection", "Vendor Contracts"], ["LEGAL_VETO", "POLICY_APPROVAL"], 500000.0, 0.1),
        ]

        for role, title, name, dept, resps, auths, budget, risk in exec_specs:
            self._executives[role] = ExecutiveProfile(
                role=role,
                title=title,
                name=name,
                department=dept,
                responsibilities=resps,
                decision_authority=auths,
                budget_authority_usd=budget,
                risk_tolerance=risk,
                strategic_priorities=[f"Excellence in {dept.value}"],
                kpis={"strategic_delivery_rate": 95.0, "budget_adherence": 98.0},
            )

    def get_executive(self, role: ExecutiveRole) -> Optional[ExecutiveProfile]:
        """Retrieves an executive profile."""
        with self._lock:
            return copy.deepcopy(self._executives.get(role))

    def list_executives(self) -> List[ExecutiveProfile]:
        """Lists all registered executives."""
        with self._lock:
            return [copy.deepcopy(e) for e in self._executives.values()]

    def update_executive_kpis(self, role: ExecutiveRole, kpis: Dict[str, float]) -> Optional[ExecutiveProfile]:
        """Updates KPI telemetry for an executive."""
        with self._lock:
            exec_profile = self._executives.get(role)
            if not exec_profile:
                return None
            exec_profile.kpis.update(kpis)
            return copy.deepcopy(exec_profile)

    def create_strategic_goal(
        self,
        goal_id: str,
        title: str,
        description: str,
        target_quarter: str = "Q1",
        target_year: int = 2026,
        owner_role: ExecutiveRole = ExecutiveRole.CEO,
        target_metric: str = "ARR_USD",
        target_value: float = 1000000.0,
    ) -> StrategicGoal:
        """Registers a new corporate strategic goal."""
        with self._lock:
            goal = StrategicGoal(
                goal_id=goal_id,
                title=title,
                description=description,
                target_quarter=target_quarter,
                target_year=target_year,
                owner_role=owner_role,
                target_metric=target_metric,
                target_value=target_value,
                current_value=0.0,
            )
            self._strategic_goals[goal_id] = goal
            logger.info("Strategic Goal recorded: %s (Target: %s %s)", title, target_value, target_metric)
            return copy.deepcopy(goal)

    def set_strategic_goal(self, goal: StrategicGoal) -> None:
        """Registers or updates a corporate strategic goal object."""
        with self._lock:
            self._strategic_goals[goal.goal_id] = copy.deepcopy(goal)

    def get_strategic_goal(self, goal_id: str) -> Optional[StrategicGoal]:
        """Retrieves a single strategic goal by ID."""
        with self._lock:
            return copy.deepcopy(self._strategic_goals.get(goal_id))

    def update_strategic_goal_progress(self, goal_id: str, current_value: float) -> Optional[StrategicGoal]:
        """Updates progress on a corporate strategic goal."""
        with self._lock:
            goal = self._strategic_goals.get(goal_id)
            if not goal:
                return None
            goal.current_value = current_value
            if goal.current_value >= goal.target_value:
                goal.status = "COMPLETED"
            return copy.deepcopy(goal)

    def list_strategic_goals(self) -> List[StrategicGoal]:
        """Returns all strategic corporate goals."""
        with self._lock:
            return [copy.deepcopy(g) for g in self._strategic_goals.values()]

    def propose_decision(
        self,
        title: str,
        description: str,
        proposer: Optional[ExecutiveRole] = None,
        required_signoffs: Optional[List[ExecutiveRole]] = None,
        proposer_role: Optional[ExecutiveRole] = None,
        budget_impact_usd: float = 0.0,
        risk_score: float = 15.0,
        strategic_alignment_score: float = 90.0,
    ) -> ExecutiveDecision:
        """
        Submits an executive proposal into the corporate decision pipeline.
        Automatically determines required signoffs based on budget thresholds and domains.
        """
        actual_proposer = proposer_role or proposer or ExecutiveRole.CEO
        with self._lock:
            d_id = f"DEC-{int(time.time()*1000)}-{len(self._decisions)+1:03d}"
            
            # Default signoffs based on proposal impact
            signoffs = set(required_signoffs or [actual_proposer])
            exec_profile = self._executives.get(actual_proposer)
            if exec_profile and budget_impact_usd > exec_profile.budget_authority_usd:
                signoffs.add(ExecutiveRole.DIRECTOR_FINANCE)
                signoffs.add(ExecutiveRole.CEO)
            elif budget_impact_usd > 100000.0:
                signoffs.add(ExecutiveRole.DIRECTOR_FINANCE)
            if budget_impact_usd > 500000.0:
                signoffs.add(ExecutiveRole.CEO)
            if risk_score > 50.0:
                signoffs.add(ExecutiveRole.DIRECTOR_SECURITY)
                signoffs.add(ExecutiveRole.LEGAL_COUNSEL)

            init_status = DecisionStatus.PROPOSED
            decision = ExecutiveDecision(
                decision_id=d_id,
                title=title,
                description=description,
                proposer_role=actual_proposer,
                required_signoffs=list(signoffs),
                signoffs_received={actual_proposer.value: True},
                budget_impact_usd=budget_impact_usd,
                risk_score=risk_score,
                strategic_alignment_score=strategic_alignment_score,
                status=init_status,
                audit_trail=[{
                    "action": "PROPOSED",
                    "role": actual_proposer.value,
                    "timestamp": time.time(),
                    "note": "Decision proposed",
                }]
            )

            self._decisions[d_id] = decision
            logger.info("Executive proposal %s submitted by %s: '%s'", d_id, actual_proposer.value, title)
            return copy.deepcopy(decision)

    def signoff_decision(
        self,
        decision_id: str,
        role: Optional[ExecutiveRole] = None,
        approved: bool = True,
        notes: str = "",
        voter_role: Optional[ExecutiveRole] = None,
    ) -> ExecutiveDecision:
        """Records an executive signoff or rejection on a proposed decision."""
        actual_role = role or voter_role or ExecutiveRole.CEO
        with self._lock:
            dec = self._decisions.get(decision_id)
            if not dec:
                raise ValueError(f"Decision {decision_id} not found")

            now = time.time()
            dec.signoffs_received[actual_role.value] = approved
            
            dec.audit_trail.append({
                "action": "SIGN_OFF" if approved else "REJECT",
                "role": actual_role.value,
                "approved": approved,
                "notes": notes,
                "timestamp": now,
            })

            if not approved:
                dec.status = DecisionStatus.REJECTED
                dec.decided_at = now
                return copy.deepcopy(dec)

            # Check if all required signoffs are satisfied
            all_signed = all(
                dec.signoffs_received.get(req.value, False)
                for req in dec.required_signoffs
            )

            if all_signed:
                dec.status = DecisionStatus.APPROVED
                dec.decided_at = now
                logger.info("Decision %s fully APPROVED by required C-suite consensus", decision_id)
            else:
                dec.status = DecisionStatus.IN_REVIEW

            return copy.deepcopy(dec)

    vote_on_decision = signoff_decision

    def veto_decision(
        self,
        decision_id: str,
        veto_role: ExecutiveRole,
        reason: str,
    ) -> ExecutiveDecision:
        """Executes an authoritative veto by an authorized executive (Security, Legal, Finance, CEO)."""
        with self._lock:
            dec = self._decisions.get(decision_id)
            if not dec:
                raise ValueError(f"Decision {decision_id} not found")

            now = time.time()
            dec.status = DecisionStatus.VETOED
            dec.veto_role = veto_role
            dec.decided_at = now
            dec.audit_trail.append({
                "action": "VETO",
                "role": veto_role.value,
                "notes": reason,
                "timestamp": now,
            })
            logger.warning("Decision %s VETOED by %s: %s", decision_id, veto_role.value, reason)
            return copy.deepcopy(dec)

    def get_decision(self, decision_id: str) -> Optional[ExecutiveDecision]:
        """Retrieves a single decision by ID."""
        with self._lock:
            return copy.deepcopy(self._decisions.get(decision_id))

    def list_decisions(self, status: Optional[DecisionStatus] = None) -> List[ExecutiveDecision]:
        """Lists decisions, optionally filtered by status."""
        with self._lock:
            if status is None:
                return [copy.deepcopy(d) for d in self._decisions.values()]
            return [copy.deepcopy(d) for d in self._decisions.values() if d.status == status]

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Serializes executive engine state."""
        with self._lock:
            return {
                "executives": {r.value: e.to_dict() for r, e in self._executives.items()},
                "decisions": {k: d.to_dict() for k, d in self._decisions.items()},
                "strategic_goals": {k: g.to_dict() for k, g in self._strategic_goals.items()},
                "total_decisions": len(self._decisions),
            }
