"""
AutoDev Failure Classifier (v2.6)
Evidence-based classifier mapping error output, stack traces, and exit codes
to structured FailureTypes, with environmental distinction and flaky-test detection.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

from core.test_result_models import (
    FailureType,
    SingleTestResult,
    TestStatus,
    TestSuiteResult,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class FailureClassifier:
    """Classifies test failures based on deterministic regex rules and evidence patterns."""

    # Deterministic pattern matchers in priority order
    CLASSIFICATION_RULES = [
        # Syntax & parsing
        (
            FailureType.SYNTAX_ERROR,
            [
                re.compile(r"SyntaxError:\s*.+", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"IndentationError:\s*.+", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"TabError:\s*.+", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"invalid syntax", re.IGNORECASE),
            ],
        ),
        # Import & module resolution
        (
            FailureType.IMPORT_FAILURE,
            [
                re.compile(r"ModuleNotFoundError:\s*No module named ['\"]?([^'\"\n]+)['\"]?", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"ImportError:\s*cannot import name ['\"]?([^'\"\n]+)['\"]?", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"ImportError:\s*.+", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"cannot find module ['\"]?([^'\"\n]+)['\"]?", re.IGNORECASE),
            ],
        ),
        # Compilation & build
        (
            FailureType.COMPILATION_FAILURE,
            [
                re.compile(r"(?:javac|rustc|gcc|g\+\+|clang|tsc)\s*error", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"Compilation failed", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"Build failed with an exception", re.IGNORECASE),
            ],
        ),
        # Dependency resolution
        (
            FailureType.DEPENDENCY_RESOLUTION_FAILURE,
            [
                re.compile(r"ResolutionImpossible", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"npm ERR! code ERESOLVE", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"DependencyResolutionException", re.IGNORECASE),
            ],
        ),
        # Test discovery
        (
            FailureType.TEST_DISCOVERY_FAILURE,
            [
                re.compile(r"PytestCollectionWarning", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"Failed to collect test", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"collected 0 items", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"no tests were found", re.IGNORECASE),
            ],
        ),
        # Network & external services
        (
            FailureType.NETWORK_DEPENDENCY_FAILURE,
            [
                re.compile(r"ConnectionRefusedError:\s*.+", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"ECONNREFUSED", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"getaddrinfo failed", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"Max retries exceeded with url", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"could not connect to server", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"socket\.timeout", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"NewConnectionError", re.IGNORECASE),
            ],
        ),
        # Environment & configuration
        (
            FailureType.ENVIRONMENT_FAILURE,
            [
                re.compile(r"KeyError:\s*['\"](?:DATABASE_URL|REDIS_URL|API_KEY|ENV|PORT)['\"]", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"EnvironmentError:\s*.+", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"Missing required environment variable", re.IGNORECASE),
            ],
        ),
        # Resource exhaustion
        (
            FailureType.RESOURCE_EXHAUSTION,
            [
                re.compile(r"MemoryError", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"OutOfMemoryError", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"No space left on device", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"ResourceExhausted", re.IGNORECASE),
            ],
        ),
        # Permission violation
        (
            FailureType.PERMISSION_VIOLATION,
            [
                re.compile(r"PermissionError:\s*.+", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"EACCES", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"AccessDeniedException", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"Operation not permitted", re.IGNORECASE),
            ],
        ),
        # Timeout
        (
            FailureType.TEST_TIMEOUT,
            [
                re.compile(r"TimeoutExpired", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"timed out after \d+ seconds", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"pytest-timeout", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"Execution timed out", re.IGNORECASE),
            ],
        ),
        # Type checking
        (
            FailureType.TYPE_CHECKING_FAILURE,
            [
                re.compile(r"TypeError:\s*.+", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"Argument \d+ to [^\s]+ has incompatible type", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"Incompatible return value type", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"mypy error", re.IGNORECASE),
            ],
        ),
        # Assertions
        (
            FailureType.ASSERTION_FAILURE,
            [
                re.compile(r"AssertionError:\s*.+", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"assert\s+.+", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"Expected\s*:\s*.+\s*Actual\s*:\s*.+", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"Expected .+ to equal .+", re.IGNORECASE),
            ],
        ),
        # General runtime exception
        (
            FailureType.RUNTIME_EXCEPTION,
            [
                re.compile(r"\b(?:AttributeError|IndexError|KeyError|ValueError|ZeroDivisionError|UnboundLocalError|NotImplementedError|RuntimeError):\s*.+", re.IGNORECASE),
                re.compile(r"Traceback \(most recent call last\):", re.IGNORECASE),
            ],
        ),
    ]

    @classmethod
    def classify(
        cls,
        message: str,
        stack_trace: str = "",
        stdout: str = "",
        stderr: str = "",
        exit_code: int = 0,
    ) -> Tuple[FailureType, float, str]:
        """
        Classifies failure based on extracted logs and stack trace.
        Returns: (FailureType, confidence_score [0.0 - 1.0], reason_summary)
        """
        if exit_code == 124:
            return FailureType.TEST_TIMEOUT, 1.0, "Process exited with timeout code 124"

        combined = f"{message}\n{stack_trace}\n{stderr}\n{stdout}"

        for ftype, patterns in cls.CLASSIFICATION_RULES:
            for pattern in patterns:
                match = pattern.search(combined)
                if match:
                    evidence = match.group(0).strip()
                    confidence = 0.95 if ftype in (FailureType.SYNTAX_ERROR, FailureType.IMPORT_FAILURE, FailureType.ASSERTION_FAILURE) else 0.85
                    return ftype, confidence, f"Matched pattern '{pattern.pattern}' with evidence: '{evidence}'"

        if exit_code != 0:
            return FailureType.UNKNOWN_FAILURE, 0.40, f"Unrecognized failure output with non-zero exit code {exit_code}"

        return FailureType.UNKNOWN_FAILURE, 0.10, "No failure detected"

    @classmethod
    def is_environmental(cls, failure_type: FailureType) -> bool:
        """Determines if the failure is likely due to external environment rather than code defect."""
        return failure_type in (
            FailureType.NETWORK_DEPENDENCY_FAILURE,
            FailureType.ENVIRONMENT_FAILURE,
            FailureType.RESOURCE_EXHAUSTION,
            FailureType.PERMISSION_VIOLATION,
            FailureType.INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE,
        )

    @classmethod
    def classify_test_result(cls, test: SingleTestResult, full_stdout: str = "", full_stderr: str = "") -> SingleTestResult:
        """Enriches a SingleTestResult with deterministic failure classification if not already classified."""
        if test.status in (TestStatus.PASSED, TestStatus.SKIPPED):
            test.failure_type = None
            return test

        ftype, _, _ = cls.classify(
            message=test.message,
            stack_trace=test.stack_trace,
            stdout=full_stdout or test.stdout_bounded,
            stderr=full_stderr or test.stderr_bounded,
        )
        test.failure_type = ftype
        return test


class FlakyTestDetector:
    """Evaluates test stability over bounded retries to identify non-deterministic failures."""

    def __init__(self, max_retries: int = 3):
        self.max_retries = max(2, min(max_retries, 5))

    def evaluate_test(
        self,
        runner_fn,  # Callable[[], SingleTestResult or bool]
        test_id: str,
    ) -> Tuple[bool, float, List[TestStatus]]:
        """
        Executes a test repeatedly to check for outcome variations.
        Returns: (is_flaky, pass_rate, list_of_statuses)
        """
        statuses: List[TestStatus] = []
        for _ in range(self.max_retries):
            res = runner_fn()
            if isinstance(res, SingleTestResult):
                statuses.append(res.status)
            elif isinstance(res, bool):
                statuses.append(TestStatus.PASSED if res else TestStatus.FAILED)
            else:
                statuses.append(TestStatus.PASSED if getattr(res, "success", False) else TestStatus.FAILED)

        passed_count = sum(1 for s in statuses if s == TestStatus.PASSED)
        pass_rate = passed_count / len(statuses)
        # Flaky if there is a mix of PASSED and FAILED/ERROR
        has_pass = any(s == TestStatus.PASSED for s in statuses)
        has_fail = any(s in (TestStatus.FAILED, TestStatus.ERROR, TestStatus.TIMEOUT) for s in statuses)
        is_flaky = has_pass and has_fail

        return is_flaky, pass_rate, statuses

core/failure_evidence.py.content:
"""
AutoDev Failure Evidence Collector (v2.6)
Extracts, structures, and bounds failure context from test outcomes,
stack traces, symbol graphs, impact analyses, and workspace source code.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import linecache
import logging
import os
import re
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Set

from core.diagnostic_models import FailureEvidence, StackFrameEvidence
from core.test_result_models import SingleTestResult, bound_log_text, redact_secrets

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class FailureEvidenceCollector:
    """Collects structured evidence from failing tests, stack traces, ASTs, and symbol graphs."""

    def __init__(self, workspace_path: str):
        self.workspace_path = os.path.realpath(os.path.abspath(workspace_path))

    def parse_stack_trace(self, stack_text: str) -> List[StackFrameEvidence]:
        """Parses standard Python traceback text into structured StackFrameEvidence."""
        frames: List[StackFrameEvidence] = []
        if not stack_text:
            return frames

        # Python traceback format: File "path/to/file.py", line 123, in func_name
        frame_pattern = re.compile(r'File\s+["\']([^"\']+)["\'],\s+line\s+(\d+)(?:,\s+in\s+([^\n\r]+))?')
        
        lines = stack_text.splitlines()
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            match = frame_pattern.search(line)
            if match:
                raw_file = match.group(1).strip()
                line_no = int(match.group(2))
                func_name = match.group(3).strip() if match.group(3) else "<module>"
                
                # Check next line for code snippet
                code_line = ""
                if i + 1 < len(lines) and not lines[i + 1].strip().startswith("File "):
                    code_line = lines[i + 1].strip()

                # Normalize and check workspace containment
                abs_file = os.path.realpath(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(self.workspace_path, raw_file)))
                is_in_ws = abs_file.startswith(self.workspace_path + os.sep) or abs_file == self.workspace_path
                
                rel_path = raw_file
                if is_in_ws:
                    try:
                        rel_path = os.path.relpath(abs_file, self.workspace_path)
                    except Exception:
                        rel_path = raw_file

                frames.append(
                    StackFrameEvidence(
                        file_path=rel_path,
                        line_number=line_no,
                        function_name=func_name,
                        code_line=code_line,
                        is_in_workspace=is_in_ws,
                    )
                )
        return frames

    def extract_source_context(
        self,
        rel_file_path: str,
        target_line: int,
        context_radius: int = 5,
    ) -> List[str]:
        """Extracts source lines surrounding a target line in the workspace."""
        abs_path = os.path.join(self.workspace_path, rel_file_path)
        if not os.path.isfile(abs_path):
            return []

        try:
            with open(abs_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
                lines = f.readlines()

            start = max(0, target_line - context_radius - 1)
            end = min(len(lines), target_line + context_radius)
            
            snippet = []
            for idx in range(start, end):
                prefix = ">>" if (idx + 1) == target_line else "  "
                snippet.append(f"{prefix} {idx + 1:4d}: {lines[idx].rstrip()}")
            return snippet
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Could not read source context from {abs_path}: {e}")
            return []

    def extract_affected_symbols(self, rel_file_path: str, line_no: int) -> List[str]:
        """Finds functions and classes enclosing the line number using AST analysis."""
        abs_path = os.path.join(self.workspace_path, rel_file_path)
        if not os.path.isfile(abs_path) or not abs_path.endswith(".py"):
            return []

        try:
            with open(abs_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
                tree = ast.parse(f.read(), filename=abs_path)

            enclosing_symbols = []
            for node in ast.walk(tree):
                if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)):
                    start = getattr(node, "lineno", 0)
                    end = getattr(node, "end_lineno", start + 50)
                    if start <= line_no <= end:
                        kind = "class" if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) else "def"
                        enclosing_symbols.append(f"{kind} {node.name} (L{start}-L{end})")
            return enclosing_symbols
        except Exception:
            return []

    def collect_evidence(
        self,
        test_result: SingleTestResult,
        recently_changed_files: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        recent_diffs: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
        impact_summary: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        journal_events: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
    ) -> FailureEvidence:
        """Assembles a bounded, complete FailureEvidence bundle for diagnosis."""
        raw_stack = f"{test_result.stack_trace}\n{test_result.message}"
        sanitized_stack = redact_secrets(raw_stack)
        frames = self.parse_stack_trace(sanitized_stack)

        # Focus on the most recent in-workspace frame
        ws_frames = [f for f in frames if f.is_in_workspace]
        primary_frame = ws_frames[-1] if ws_frames else (frames[-1] if frames else None)

        failing_lines = []
        affected_symbols: List[str] = []
        if primary_frame and primary_frame.is_in_workspace:
            failing_lines = self.extract_source_context(primary_frame.file_path, primary_frame.line_number)
            affected_symbols = self.extract_affected_symbols(primary_frame.file_path, primary_frame.line_number)

        evidence = FailureEvidence(
            test_id=test_result.test_id,
            test_name=test_result.test_name,
            test_file=test_result.test_file,
            failure_message=redact_secrets(test_result.message),
            stack_trace=bound_log_text(sanitized_stack, max_bytes=8192),
            stack_frames=frames[:15],  # Bound to top 15 frames
            failing_source_lines=failing_lines,
            affected_symbols=affected_symbols,
            recently_changed_files=recently_changed_files or [],
            recent_diffs=recent_diffs or {},
            impact_analysis_summary=impact_summary or {},
            journal_events=journal_events or [],
            is_environmental=False,
            is_flaky=test_result.flaky,
            redacted=True,
        )
        return evidence

core/global_metrics.py.content:
"""
global_metrics.py - Enterprise Global Analytics & Executive Dashboard Engine (AutoDev Version 3.5)

Synthesizes macroscopic executive analytics across the entire enterprise ecosystem:
- Multi-company consolidated velocity, defect rate, health, and delivery confidence
- Innovation Score (derived from AI research, model checkpoints, and knowledge publication)
- Knowledge Reuse Rate (cross-company knowledge sharing & adoption ratio)
- Enterprise Technical Debt & Architecture Health across companies
- Security Index & Cross-Company Zero Trust Compliance
- Budgetary burn rate, variance, and financial runway
- 100% Python Standard Library.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import threading
import time
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

logger = logging.getLogger("AutoDev.Federation.Metrics")


@dataclass
class GlobalEnterpriseDashboard:
    """Master executive analytics dashboard covering the entire enterprise group."""
    timestamp: float
    enterprise_name: str
    total_companies: int
    active_companies: int
    total_projects: int
    active_projects: int
    consolidated_velocity: float
    global_defect_rate_pct: float
    enterprise_health_score: float
    enterprise_security_score: float
    global_delivery_confidence: float
    innovation_score: float
    knowledge_reuse_rate_pct: float
    total_technical_debt_hours: float
    total_allocated_budget_usd: float
    total_spent_budget_usd: float
    net_budget_variance_usd: float
    monthly_burn_rate_usd: float
    company_breakdown: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    summary_headline: str = ""

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


class GlobalMetricsCalculator:
    """
    Computes unified enterprise analytics from registry, portfolio, security, and knowledge engines.
    """

    def __init__(self, enterprise_name: str = "AutoDev Global Enterprise") -> None:
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self.enterprise_name = enterprise_name

    def calculate_global_dashboard(
        self,
        companies: Dict[str, Any],
        portfolio_summary: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        security_dashboard: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        knowledge_analytics: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        marketplace_summary: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        governance_summary: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> GlobalEnterpriseDashboard:
        """
        Synthesizes macro metrics across companies, portfolio, security, and knowledge bases.
        """
        with self._lock:
            now = time.time()
            total_companies = len(companies)

            # 1. Company-level aggregations
            active_companies = 0
            health_scores = []
            total_budget = 0.0
            total_spent = 0.0
            company_breakdown: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
            tech_debt_hours = 0.0
            velocity_sum = 0.0

            for cid, comp in companies.items():
                if hasattr(comp, "to_dict"):
                    c_dict = comp.to_dict()
                elif hasattr(comp, "get_status_report"):
                    c_dict = comp.get_status_report()
                elif isinstance(comp, dict):
                    c_dict = comp
                else:
                    c_dict = {}

                status = str(c_dict.get("status", "ACTIVE"))
                if "ACTIVE" in status:
                    active_companies += 1

                health = float(c_dict.get("health_score", 100.0))
                health_scores.append(health)

                b_alloc = float(c_dict.get("allocated_budget_usd", c_dict.get("budget", 500000.0)))
                b_spent = float(c_dict.get("spent_budget_usd", c_dict.get("spent_budget", 0.0)))
                total_budget += b_alloc
                total_spent += b_spent

                # Estimate technical debt if available
                debt = float(c_dict.get("technical_debt_hours", 12.0))
                tech_debt_hours += debt

                # Velocity
                vel = float(c_dict.get("velocity", 25.0))
                velocity_sum += vel

                company_breakdown[cid] = {
                    "company_name": c_dict.get("company_name", cid),
                    "status": status,
                    "health_score": round(health, 1),
                    "allocated_budget_usd": b_alloc,
                    "spent_budget_usd": b_spent,
                    "headcount": c_dict.get("headcount", 50),
                }

            avg_health = (sum(health_scores) / max(1, len(health_scores))) if health_scores else 95.0

            # 2. Portfolio Metrics
            p_dash = portfolio_summary or {}
            total_projects = p_dash.get("total_projects", 0)
            active_projects = p_dash.get("active_projects", 0)
            portfolio_conf = float(p_dash.get("average_delivery_confidence", 0.85))

            # 3. Security Metrics
            sec_dash = security_dashboard or {}
            quarantined = len(sec_dash.get("quarantined_companies", []))
            sec_audit_valid = sec_dash.get("audit_chain_valid", True)
            known_threats = sec_dash.get("known_threats_count", 0)

            sec_score = 100.0 - (quarantined * 25.0) - (known_threats * 10.0)
            if not sec_audit_valid:
                sec_score -= 30.0
            sec_score = max(10.0, min(100.0, round(sec_score, 1)))

            # 4. Knowledge & Innovation Metrics
            know_dash = knowledge_analytics or {}
            total_nodes = know_dash.get("total_nodes", 0)
            total_reuses = know_dash.get("total_reuses", 0)
            research_count = know_dash.get("nodes_by_category", {}).get("RESEARCH", 0)

            reuse_rate = round((total_reuses / max(1, total_nodes)) * 100.0, 1) if total_nodes > 0 else 0.0
            # Innovation score: derived from research nodes, model registrations, and active projects
            innovation_score = min(100.0, round((research_count * 15.0) + (reuse_rate * 0.4) + (active_projects * 2.5), 1))

            # 5. Global Defect Rate
            defect_rate = max(1.0, min(15.0, round((100.0 - avg_health) * 0.25, 2)))

            # 6. Global Delivery Confidence
            delivery_conf = round(
                (avg_health / 100.0) * 0.35
                + (sec_score / 100.0) * 0.30
                + (portfolio_conf) * 0.25
                + ((100.0 - defect_rate) / 100.0) * 0.10,
                3,
            )

            variance = total_budget - total_spent
            headline = (
                f"{self.enterprise_name}: {active_companies}/{total_companies} Companies Active | "
                f"Health: {avg_health:.1f}/100 | Security: {sec_score:.1f}/100 | "
                f"Confidence: {delivery_conf*100:.1f}% | Innovation: {innovation_score:.1f}/100"
            )

            return GlobalEnterpriseDashboard(
                timestamp=now,
                enterprise_name=self.enterprise_name,
                total_companies=total_companies,
                active_companies=active_companies,
                total_projects=total_projects,
                active_projects=active_projects,
                consolidated_velocity=round(velocity_sum, 1),
                global_defect_rate_pct=defect_rate,
                enterprise_health_score=round(avg_health, 1),
                enterprise_security_score=sec_score,
                global_delivery_confidence=delivery_conf,
                innovation_score=innovation_score,
                knowledge_reuse_rate_pct=reuse_rate,
                total_technical_debt_hours=round(tech_debt_hours, 1),
                total_allocated_budget_usd=round(total_budget, 2),
                total_spent_budget_usd=round(total_spent, 2),
                net_budget_variance_usd=round(variance, 2),
                monthly_burn_rate_usd=round(total_spent / 3.0, 2),  # Estimated monthly burn
                company_breakdown=company_breakdown,
                summary_headline=headline,
            )

core/grpc_worker_client.py.content:
"""
grpc_worker_client.py - Remote Worker Client Channel & Execution Agent for AutoDev (v2.3)

Connects to the AutoDev coordinator over mTLS, handles registration, maintains
heartbeat liveness, polls assigned operations, executes them inside sandboxes,
and submits verified task results and artifact metadata.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import ssl
import threading
import time
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple, Union

from core.certificate_manager import CertificateInfo, CertificateManager
from core.container_runtime import ContainerRuntimeDetector, ContainerRuntimeInfo, ContainerRuntimeType
from core.container_sandbox import ContainerSandbox, ExecutionBackend
from core.remote_worker_transport import TransportConfig, TransportConnectionError, TransportSecurityError
from core.worker_agent import WorkerAgent
from core.worker_protocol import (
    PROTOCOL_VERSION,
    TaskAssignmentPayload,
    TaskResultPayload,
    WorkerCapabilities,
    WorkerHeartbeat,
    WorkerRegistrationRequest,
    WorkerRegistrationResponse,
    WorkerStatus,
)

logger = logging.getLogger("AutoDev.GrpcWorkerClient")


class GrpcWorkerClient:
    """
    Remote worker agent client communicating with coordinator over mTLS.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        worker_id: str,
        worker_name: Optional[str] = None,
        workspace_root: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
        coordinator_host: str = "127.0.0.1",
        coordinator_port: int = 50051,
        config: Optional[TransportConfig] = None,
        capabilities: Optional[WorkerCapabilities] = None,
        cert_manager: Optional[CertificateManager] = None,
        certificate_manager: Optional[CertificateManager] = None,
        client_cert_info: Optional[CertificateInfo] = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        self.worker_id = worker_id
        self.worker_name = worker_name or worker_id
        self.workspace_root = Path(workspace_root or "projects").resolve()
        self.config = config or TransportConfig(host=coordinator_host, port=coordinator_port)
        if coordinator_host != "127.0.0.1" or coordinator_port != 50051:
            self.config.host = coordinator_host
            self.config.port = coordinator_port
        self.capabilities = capabilities or WorkerCapabilities()
        self.cert_manager = certificate_manager or cert_manager or CertificateManager()
        self.client_cert_info = client_cert_info

        self._sock: Optional[socket.socket] = None
        self._rfile: Optional[Any] = None
        self._wfile: Optional[Any] = None
        self._req_id = 0
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._is_connected = False
        self._is_running = False
        self._heartbeat_thread: Optional[threading.Thread] = None

        # Sandbox agent for local task execution
        self.worker_agent = WorkerAgent(
            worker_id=self.worker_id,
            workspace_root=self.workspace_root,
        )

    @property
    def is_connected(self) -> bool:
        return self._is_connected

    def connect(self) -> bool:
        """Establishes TCP/mTLS connection with coordinator and registers worker."""
        with self._lock:
            if self._is_connected:
                return True

            try:
                raw_sock = socket.create_connection(
                    (self.config.host, self.config.port),
                    timeout=self.config.request_timeout_seconds,
                )

                if self.client_cert_info:
                    ssl_ctx = self.cert_manager.create_client_ssl_context(self.client_cert_info)
                    self._sock = ssl_ctx.wrap_socket(raw_sock, server_hostname="localhost")
                elif self.config.use_tls and self.config.ca_cert_path and self.config.client_cert_path and self.config.client_key_path:
                    ssl_ctx = self.cert_manager.create_client_ssl_context(
                        ca_cert_path=self.config.ca_cert_path,
                        client_cert_path=self.config.client_cert_path,
                        client_key_path=self.config.client_key_path,
                    )
                    self._sock = ssl_ctx.wrap_socket(raw_sock, server_hostname="localhost")
                else:
                    self._sock = raw_sock

                self._rfile = self._sock.makefile("r", encoding="utf-8")
                self._wfile = self._sock.makefile("w", encoding="utf-8")
                self._is_connected = True
                logger.info("Connected to coordinator at %s:%d (mTLS=%s)", self.config.host, self.config.port, bool(self.client_cert_info))
                return True

            except Exception as e:
                logger.error("Failed to connect to coordinator at %s:%d: %s", self.config.host, self.config.port, e)
                self._is_connected = False
                return False

    def disconnect(self) -> None:
        """Closes RPC connection and stops background heartbeat loop."""
        with self._lock:
            self._is_running = False
            self._is_connected = False
            try:
                if self._rfile:
                    self._rfile.close()
                if self._wfile:
                    self._wfile.close()
                if self._sock:
                    self._sock.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
            logger.info("Disconnected from coordinator.")

    def _call_rpc(self, method: str, params: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Sends line-delimited JSON-RPC call and receives response."""
        with self._lock:
            if not self._is_connected and not self.connect():
                raise TransportConnectionError("Not connected to coordinator.")

            self._req_id += 1
            payload = {
                "id": self._req_id,
                "method": method,
                "params": params,
            }

            try:
                self._wfile.write(json.dumps(payload) + "\n")
                self._wfile.flush()

                line = self._rfile.readline()
                if not line:
                    raise TransportConnectionError("Coordinator closed connection.")

                resp = json.loads(line.strip())
                if "error" in resp and resp["error"]:
                    raise TransportSecurityError(resp["error"])
                return resp.get("result", {})

            except Exception as e:
                self.disconnect()
                raise TransportConnectionError(f"RPC call '{method}' failed: {e}") from e

    def register(self) -> WorkerRegistrationResponse:
        """Registers this worker with the coordinator."""
        req = WorkerRegistrationRequest(
            worker_id=self.worker_id,
            worker_name=self.worker_name,
            protocol_version=PROTOCOL_VERSION,
            capabilities=self.capabilities,
        )
        res_data = self._call_rpc("RegisterWorker", req.to_dict())
        return WorkerRegistrationResponse.from_dict(res_data)

    def send_heartbeat(
        self,
        status: WorkerStatus = WorkerStatus.IDLE,
        active_tasks: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    ) -> Any:
        """Sends heartbeat update to coordinator."""
        hb = WorkerHeartbeat(
            worker_id=self.worker_id,
            status=status,
            active_task_ids=active_tasks or [],
            concurrency_used=len(active_tasks or []),
        )
        res_data = self._call_rpc("Heartbeat", hb.to_dict())
        from core.worker_protocol import WorkerHeartbeatResponse
        return WorkerHeartbeatResponse.from_dict(res_data)

    def poll_task(self) -> Optional[TaskAssignmentPayload]:
        """Polls coordinator for assigned tasks."""
        res_data = self._call_rpc("PollTask", {"worker_id": self.worker_id})
        if res_data:
            return TaskAssignmentPayload.from_dict(res_data)
        return None

    def submit_task_result(self, result: TaskResultPayload) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Submits executed task result to coordinator."""
        return self._call_rpc("SubmitTaskResult", result.to_dict())

    def execute_and_submit(self, task: TaskAssignmentPayload) -> TaskResultPayload:
        """Executes assigned task using local sandbox worker agent and submits result to coordinator."""
        res_payload = self.worker_agent.execute_assignment(task)
        self.submit_task_result(res_payload)
        return res_payload

    def poll_and_execute_task(self) -> Optional[TaskResultPayload]:
        """Polls for an assigned task, executes it, and submits result if present."""
        task = self.poll_task()
        if task:
            return self.execute_and_submit(task)
        else:
            self.send_heartbeat(status=WorkerStatus.IDLE)
            return None

    def run_worker_loop(self, poll_interval_seconds: float = 1.0) -> None:
        """Main worker daemon polling loop."""
        self._is_running = True
        logger.info("Starting remote worker poll loop for %s", self.worker_id)

        while self._is_running:
            try:
                task = self.poll_task()
                if task:
                    logger.info("Worker %s received task assignment: %s", self.worker_id, task.task_id)
                    # Execute locally via sandbox agent
                    res_payload = self.worker_agent.execute_assignment(task)
                    # Submit results
                    self.submit_task_result(res_payload)
                else:
                    self.send_heartbeat(status=WorkerStatus.IDLE)

                time.sleep(poll_interval_seconds)

            except Exception as e:
                logger.error("Error in worker loop: %s", e)
                time.sleep(poll_interval_seconds * 2)

core/grpc_worker_server.py.content:
"""
grpc_worker_server.py - Coordinator-Side RPC/mTLS Server for Remote Workers (v2.3)

Listens for remote worker connections, enforces mutual TLS certificate validation,
manages worker registrations, dispatches task assignments, receives heartbeats,
and accepts task results and artifact submissions.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import queue
import socket
import ssl
import threading
import time
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple, Union

from core.certificate_manager import CertificateInfo, CertificateManager
from core.remote_worker_transport import TransportConfig, TransportError, TransportSecurityError
from core.task_lease_manager import TaskLeaseManager
from core.worker_auth import (
    AuthenticatedWorkerIdentity,
    WorkerAuthorizer,
    WorkerAuthenticationError,
    WorkerAuthorizationError,
)
from core.worker_protocol import (
    PROTOCOL_VERSION,
    TaskAssignmentPayload,
    TaskResultPayload,
    WorkerCapabilities,
    WorkerHeartbeat,
    WorkerRegistrationRequest,
    WorkerRegistrationResponse,
    WorkerStatus,
)
from core.worker_registry import IncompatibleProtocolError, UnauthorizedWorkerError, WorkerRegistry

logger = logging.getLogger("AutoDev.GrpcWorkerServer")


class GrpcWorkerServer:
    """
    Coordinator-side RPC server handling remote worker connections over TLS/mTLS.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        registry: Optional[WorkerRegistry] = None,
        lease_manager: Optional[TaskLeaseManager] = None,
        config: Optional[TransportConfig] = None,
        authorizer: Optional[WorkerAuthorizer] = None,
        cert_manager: Optional[CertificateManager] = None,
        certificate_manager: Optional[CertificateManager] = None,
        server_cert_info: Optional[CertificateInfo] = None,
        host: str = "127.0.0.1",
        port: int = 50051,
        require_client_cert: bool = True,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        self.registry = registry or WorkerRegistry()
        self.lease_manager = lease_manager or TaskLeaseManager()
        self.config = config or TransportConfig(host=host, port=port)
        if host != "127.0.0.1" or port != 50051:
            self.config.host = host
            self.config.port = port
        self.authorizer = authorizer or WorkerAuthorizer()
        self.cert_manager = certificate_manager or cert_manager or CertificateManager()
        self.server_cert_info = server_cert_info
        self.require_client_cert = require_client_cert

        self._server_sock: Optional[socket.socket] = None
        self._server_thread: Optional[threading.Thread] = None
        self._is_running = False
        self._stopping = False
        self._lock = threading.RLock()

        # Task assignment queues per worker
        self._pending_tasks: Dict[str, queue.Queue[TaskAssignmentPayload]] = {}
        # Task results received
        self._results_received: Dict[str, TaskResultPayload] = {}
        # Authenticated identities per worker_id
        self._authenticated_identities: Dict[str, AuthenticatedWorkerIdentity] = {}

    @property
    def is_running(self) -> bool:
        return self._is_running

    @property
    def port(self) -> int:
        return self.config.port

    def start(self) -> None:
        """Starts the RPC/mTLS listener on a background thread."""
        if self._is_running:
            return

        self._stopping = False
        raw_sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        raw_sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
        raw_sock.bind((self.config.host, self.config.port))
        raw_sock.listen(128)

        self.config.port = raw_sock.getsockname()[1]
        self._server_sock = raw_sock

        self._server_thread = threading.Thread(
            target=self._listen_loop,
            name="AutoDev-WorkerServer",
            daemon=True,
        )
        self._server_thread.start()
        self._is_running = True
        logger.info("GrpcWorkerServer listening on %s:%d (mTLS=%s)", self.config.host, self.config.port, bool(self.server_cert_info))

    def stop(self) -> None:
        """Gracefully shuts down the RPC server."""
        if not self._is_running:
            return

        self._stopping = True
        self._is_running = False
        if self._server_sock:
            try:
                self._server_sock.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
        if self._server_thread and self._server_thread.is_alive():
            self._server_thread.join(timeout=2.0)
        logger.info("GrpcWorkerServer stopped.")

    def queue_task_for_worker(self, worker_id: str, assignment: TaskAssignmentPayload) -> None:
        """Queues a task assignment for the specified worker to poll."""
        with self._lock:
            if worker_id not in self._pending_tasks:
                self._pending_tasks[worker_id] = queue.Queue()
            self._pending_tasks[worker_id].put(assignment)
            logger.info("Queued task %s for remote worker %s", assignment.task_id, worker_id)

    def get_result_for_task(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskResultPayload]:
        """Returns received task result if available."""
        with self._lock:
            return self._results_received.get(task_id)

    def _listen_loop(self) -> None:
        """Accepts incoming TCP/TLS connections and spawns worker client handlers."""
        ssl_ctx: Optional[ssl.SSLContext] = None
        if self.server_cert_info:
            ssl_ctx = self.cert_manager.create_server_ssl_context(
                server_info_or_ca_path=self.server_cert_info,
                require_client_cert=self.require_client_cert,
            )
        elif self.config.use_tls and self.config.ca_cert_path and self.config.server_cert_path and self.config.server_key_path:
            ssl_ctx = self.cert_manager.create_server_ssl_context(
                server_info_or_ca_path=self.config.ca_cert_path,
                server_cert_path=self.config.server_cert_path,
                server_key_path=self.config.server_key_path,
                require_client_cert=self.require_client_cert,
            )

        while not self._stopping:
            try:
                client_sock, addr = self._server_sock.accept()
                if self._stopping:
                    client_sock.close()
                    break

                conn_sock = client_sock
                peer_cert: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
                if ssl_ctx:
                    try:
                        conn_sock = ssl_ctx.wrap_socket(client_sock, server_side=True)
                        peer_cert = conn_sock.getpeercert()
                    except Exception as e:
                        logger.warning("mTLS Handshake failed from %s: %s", addr, e)
                        client_sock.close()
                        continue

                handler = threading.Thread(
                    target=self._handle_client_connection,
                    args=(conn_sock, addr, peer_cert),
                    daemon=True,
                )
                handler.start()

            except (socket.error, OSError):
                break

    def _handle_client_connection(
        self,
        sock: socket.socket,
        addr: Tuple[str, int],
        peer_cert: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
    ) -> None:
        """Processes line-delimited JSON-RPC messages from a connected worker."""
        rfile = sock.makefile("r", encoding="utf-8")
        wfile = sock.makefile("w", encoding="utf-8")
        worker_id: Optional[str] = None

        try:
            for line in rfile:
                if self._stopping:
                    break
                line = line.strip()
                if not line:
                    continue

                try:
                    req = json.loads(line)
                except Exception as e:
                    self._send_rpc_response(wfile, {"error": f"Invalid JSON: {e}"})
                    continue

                method = req.get("method")
                params = req.get("params", {})
                req_id = req.get("id")

                resp_data: Dict[str, Any] = {"id": req_id}

                # 1. Register Worker
                if method == "RegisterWorker":
                    reg_req = WorkerRegistrationRequest.from_dict(params)
                    # Bind certificate identity
                    cert_cn = ""
                    cert_fp = ""
                    if peer_cert:
                        subject = dict(x[0] for x in peer_cert.get("subject", ()))
                        cert_cn = subject.get("commonName", "")

                    identity = AuthenticatedWorkerIdentity(
                        worker_id=reg_req.worker_id,
                        common_name=cert_cn or reg_req.worker_id,
                        certificate_fingerprint=cert_fp,
                        authenticated_via="mTLS" if peer_cert else "PLAINTEXT",
                    )
                    try:
                        self.authorizer.authorize_registration(identity)
                        reg_resp = self.registry.register_worker(reg_req)
                        with self._lock:
                            worker_id = reg_req.worker_id
                            self._authenticated_identities[worker_id] = identity
                            if worker_id not in self._pending_tasks:
                                self._pending_tasks[worker_id] = queue.Queue()
                        resp_data["result"] = reg_resp.to_dict()
                    except Exception as exc:
                        resp_data["error"] = str(exc)

                # 2. Heartbeat
                elif method == "Heartbeat":
                    hb = WorkerHeartbeat.from_dict(params)
                    try:
                        resp = self.registry.record_heartbeat(hb)
                        resp_data["result"] = resp.to_dict()
                    except Exception as exc:
                        resp_data["error"] = str(exc)

                # 3. Poll Assignment
                elif method == "PollTask":
                    w_id = params.get("worker_id", worker_id)
                    assignment: Optional[TaskAssignmentPayload] = None
                    with self._lock:
                        if w_id and w_id in self._pending_tasks:
                            try:
                                assignment = self._pending_tasks[w_id].get_nowait()
                            except queue.Empty:
                                assignment = None
                    resp_data["result"] = assignment.to_dict() if assignment else None

                # 4. Submit Task Result
                elif method == "SubmitTaskResult":
                    res_payload = TaskResultPayload.from_dict(params)
                    task_id = res_payload.task_id
                    with self._lock:
                        self._results_received[task_id] = res_payload
                    resp_data["result"] = {"success": True, "task_id": task_id}

                # Unknown method
                else:
                    resp_data["error"] = f"Unknown method '{method}'"

                self._send_rpc_response(wfile, resp_data)

        except (ConnectionResetError, BrokenPipeError, socket.error):
            pass
        finally:
            if worker_id:
                logger.info("Remote worker %s disconnected from %s", worker_id, addr)
            try:
                rfile.close()
                wfile.close()
                sock.close()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _send_rpc_response(self, wfile: Any, response: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        try:
            wfile.write(json.dumps(response) + "\n")
            wfile.flush()
        except Exception:
            pass

"""
ha_coordinator.py - High Availability Coordinator & Leader Fencing Engine for AutoDev (v2.4)

Implements consensus-backed leader election, quorum verification, monotonically increasing
fencing token generation, failover reconciliation, and fail-closed state protection.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import random
import threading
import time
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple

from core.consensus_protocol import (
    ConsensusHeartbeat,
    CoordinatorNode,
    CoordinatorRole,
    FencingToken,
    VoteRequest,
    VoteResponse,
)

logger = logging.getLogger("AutoDev.HACoordinator")


class HAError(Exception):
    """Base exception for high availability and consensus operations."""
    pass


class NotLeaderError(HAError):
    """Raised when a non-leader coordinator attempts a protected mutation."""
    pass


class StaleLeaderError(HAError):
    """Raised when a coordinator loses leadership or possesses an expired fencing token."""
    pass


class FencingViolationError(HAError):
    """Raised when an operation is attempted with an outdated fencing generation token."""
    pass


class QuorumLostError(HAError):
    """Raised when an HA cluster cannot achieve majority quorum."""
    pass


class LeaderFencingValidator:
    """
    Guards protected mutations by verifying that the coordinator holds active,
    authoritative leadership and a valid fencing generation token.
    """

    def __init__(self, ha_coordinator: HACoordinator) -> None:
        self.ha_coordinator = ha_coordinator

    def assert_active_leader(self, operation_name: str = "mutation") -> FencingToken:
        """
        Validates active leadership. If leadership is stale, revoked, or expired,
        raises FencingViolationError or NotLeaderError immediately (fail-closed).
        """
        if not self.ha_coordinator.is_leader:
            raise NotLeaderError(
                f"Coordinator '{self.ha_coordinator.coordinator_id}' (role: {self.ha_coordinator.role.value}) "
                f"cannot execute protected operation '{operation_name}' because it is not the active leader."
            )

        token = self.ha_coordinator.fencing_token
        if not token or token.is_expired:
            self.ha_coordinator.step_down("Fencing token expired")
            raise StaleLeaderError(
                f"Coordinator '{self.ha_coordinator.coordinator_id}' fencing token is expired or missing. "
                f"Operation '{operation_name}' rejected."
            )

        return token

    def validate_fencing_token(self, token: Optional[FencingToken], minimum_generation: int = 0) -> bool:
        """Validates that a provided fencing token is active and matches minimum generation."""
        if not token or token.is_expired:
            return False
        return token.fencing_generation >= minimum_generation


class HACoordinator:
    """
    Multi-node High Availability coordinator participating in leader election,
    fencing token issuance, quorum monitoring, and failover reconciliation.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        coordinator_id: str,
        peers: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
        peer_ids: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        store: Optional[Any] = None,
        host: str = "127.0.0.1",
        port: int = 50051,
        election_timeout_range: Tuple[float, float] = (1.5, 3.0),
        heartbeat_interval_seconds: float = 0.5,
        lease_duration_seconds: float = 5.0,
        transport_call: Optional[Callable[[str, str, Dict[str, Any]], Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
        consensus_provider: Optional[Any] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.coordinator_id = coordinator_id
        self.host = host
        self.port = port
        self.store = store
        self.election_timeout_range = election_timeout_range
        self.heartbeat_interval_seconds = heartbeat_interval_seconds
        self.lease_duration_seconds = lease_duration_seconds
        self.transport_call = transport_call
        self.consensus_provider = consensus_provider

        self.role: CoordinatorRole = CoordinatorRole.STARTING
        self.current_term: int = 0
        self.current_generation: int = 0
        self.voted_for: Optional[str] = None
        self.leader_id: Optional[str] = None
        self.fencing_token: Optional[FencingToken] = None
        self._consensus_lease: Optional[Any] = None

        self._peers: Dict[str, CoordinatorNode] = {}
        all_peers = list(peers or [])
        if peer_ids:
            all_peers.extend(peer_ids)

        for p in all_peers:
            if isinstance(p, str):
                if p != self.coordinator_id:
                    self._peers[p] = CoordinatorNode(coordinator_id=p)
            elif isinstance(p, CoordinatorNode):
                if p.coordinator_id != self.coordinator_id:
                    self._peers[p.coordinator_id] = p

        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._is_running = False
        self._last_heartbeat_received_ts = time.time()
        self._election_timeout = random.uniform(*self.election_timeout_range)
        self._bg_thread: Optional[threading.Thread] = None
        self._on_role_change_callbacks: List[Callable[[CoordinatorRole], None]] = []

    @property
    def is_leader(self) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            return self.role == CoordinatorRole.LEADER and bool(self.fencing_token and not self.fencing_token.is_expired)

    @property
    def total_cluster_size(self) -> int:
        with self._lock:
            return len(self._peers) + 1

    @property
    def quorum_size(self) -> int:
        return (self.total_cluster_size // 2) + 1

    def register_peer(self, peer: CoordinatorNode) -> None:
        """Registers a new peer coordinator node in the cluster."""
        with self._lock:
            if peer.coordinator_id != self.coordinator_id:
                self._peers[peer.coordinator_id] = peer

    def deregister_peer(self, peer_id: str) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._peers.pop(peer_id, None)

    def on_role_change(self, callback: Callable[[CoordinatorRole], None]) -> None:
        self._on_role_change_callbacks.append(callback)

    def _set_role(self, new_role: CoordinatorRole) -> None:
        old_role = self.role
        self.role = new_role
        if old_role != new_role:
            logger.info("Coordinator '%s' transitioned role from %s to %s (term: %d)", self.coordinator_id, old_role.value, new_role.value, self.current_term)
            for cb in self._on_role_change_callbacks:
                try:
                    cb(new_role)
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.warning("Error in on_role_change callback: %s", e)

    def start(self) -> None:
        """Starts background election and heartbeat loops."""
        with self._lock:
            if self._is_running:
                return
            self._is_running = True
            self._set_role(CoordinatorRole.FOLLOWER)
            self._last_heartbeat_received_ts = time.time()
            self._election_timeout = random.uniform(*self.election_timeout_range)

            # Single-node cluster automatically assumes leadership
            if not self._peers:
                self._assume_leadership()

            self._bg_thread = threading.Thread(
                target=self._run_loop,
                name=f"HA-Coordinator-{self.coordinator_id}",
                daemon=True,
            )
            self._bg_thread.start()

    def stop(self) -> None:
        """Gracefully steps down and stops background loops."""
        with self._lock:
            self._is_running = False
            self.step_down("Coordinator shutting down")
            self._set_role(CoordinatorRole.STOPPING)

    def _assume_leadership(self) -> None:
        """Transitions this node to LEADER and issues a new FencingToken."""
        if self.consensus_provider:
            try:
                lease = self.consensus_provider.acquire_leadership(
                    coordinator_id=self.coordinator_id,
                    term=self.current_term,
                    ttl_seconds=self.lease_duration_seconds,
                )
                self._consensus_lease = lease
                self.current_term = lease.term
                self.current_generation = lease.generation
                self.leader_id = self.coordinator_id
                self.fencing_token = FencingToken(
                    term=lease.term,
                    leader_id=self.coordinator_id,
                    fencing_generation=lease.generation,
                    expires_at_timestamp=lease.expires_at,
                )
                self._set_role(CoordinatorRole.LEADER)
                logger.info(
                    "Coordinator '%s' acquired external consensus leadership for term %d (generation %d)",
                    self.coordinator_id,
                    self.current_term,
                    self.current_generation,
                )
                return
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning("Failed to acquire external consensus lease: %s", e)
                self.step_down(f"Consensus acquire failed: {e}")
                return

        self.current_generation += 1
        self.leader_id = self.coordinator_id
        self.fencing_token = FencingToken(
            term=self.current_term,
            leader_id=self.coordinator_id,
            fencing_generation=self.current_generation,
            expires_at_timestamp=time.time() + self.lease_duration_seconds,
        )
        self._set_role(CoordinatorRole.LEADER)
        logger.info(
            "Coordinator '%s' acquired leadership for term %d (generation %d)",
            self.coordinator_id,
            self.current_term,
            self.current_generation,
        )

    def step_down(self, reason: str = "") -> None:
        """Relinquishes leadership and invalidates current fencing token."""
        with self._lock:
            if self.role == CoordinatorRole.LEADER:
                logger.warning("Leader '%s' stepping down. Reason: %s", self.coordinator_id, reason)
            if self.consensus_provider and self._consensus_lease:
                try:
                    self.consensus_provider.release_leadership(self._consensus_lease)
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.debug("Error releasing consensus lease on step_down: %s", e)
                self._consensus_lease = None
            self.fencing_token = None
            if self._is_running:
                self._set_role(CoordinatorRole.FOLLOWER)
            else:
                self._set_role(CoordinatorRole.UNAVAILABLE)

    def start_election(self) -> bool:
        """
        Initiates a new election term, votes for self, and requests votes from peers.
        Returns True if leadership quorum was acquired.
        """
        with self._lock:
            self.current_term += 1
            self._set_role(CoordinatorRole.CANDIDATE)
            self.voted_for = self.coordinator_id
            self.leader_id = None
            self.fencing_token = None
            self._last_heartbeat_received_ts = time.time()
            self._election_timeout = random.uniform(*self.election_timeout_range)

            votes_granted = 1  # Vote for self
            req = VoteRequest(
                term=self.current_term,
                candidate_id=self.coordinator_id,
            )

            # In single node cluster, immediately win
            if not self._peers:
                self._assume_leadership()
                return True

            for peer_id, peer in list(self._peers.items()):
                resp = self._send_vote_request(peer_id, req)
                if resp and resp.vote_granted:
                    votes_granted += 1
                elif resp and resp.term > self.current_term:
                    self.current_term = resp.term
                    self.step_down(f"Peer {peer_id} reported higher term {resp.term}")
                    return False

            if votes_granted >= self.quorum_size:
                self._assume_leadership()
                return True
            else:
                logger.info("Election failed for term %d (got %d votes, needed %d)", self.current_term, votes_granted, self.quorum_size)
                self._set_role(CoordinatorRole.FOLLOWER)
                return False

    def _send_vote_request(self, peer_id: str, request: VoteRequest) -> Optional[VoteResponse]:
        if self.transport_call:
            try:
                res = self.transport_call(peer_id, "RequestVote", request.to_dict())
                return VoteResponse.from_dict(res)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.debug("Failed to send RequestVote to peer %s: %s", peer_id, e)
                return None
        return None

    def receive_vote_request(self, request: VoteRequest) -> VoteResponse:
        """Handles incoming VoteRequest from candidate peer."""
        with self._lock:
            # If candidate term is higher, update local term and step down
            if request.term > self.current_term:
                self.current_term = request.term
                self.voted_for = None
                self.step_down(f"Higher term {request.term} received in vote request")

            # Vote granting rules
            vote_granted = False
            reason = ""
            if request.term == self.current_term and (self.voted_for is None or self.voted_for == request.candidate_id):
                vote_granted = True
                self.voted_for = request.candidate_id
                self._last_heartbeat_received_ts = time.time()
                reason = "Vote granted"
            else:
                reason = f"Already voted for {self.voted_for} in term {self.current_term}"

            return VoteResponse(
                term=self.current_term,
                vote_granted=vote_granted,
                voter_id=self.coordinator_id,
                reason=reason,
            )

    def receive_heartbeat(self, heartbeat: ConsensusHeartbeat) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Handles periodic heartbeat from cluster leader."""
        with self._lock:
            if heartbeat.term < self.current_term:
                return {"success": False, "term": self.current_term, "reason": "Heartbeat term outdated"}

            if heartbeat.term > self.current_term:
                self.current_term = heartbeat.term
                self.voted_for = None

            self.leader_id = heartbeat.leader_id
            self._last_heartbeat_received_ts = time.time()
            if self.role != CoordinatorRole.FOLLOWER:
                self._set_role(CoordinatorRole.FOLLOWER)

            return {"success": True, "term": self.current_term}

    def renew_leader_lease(self) -> bool:
        """Leader refreshes its lease and fencing token expiration."""
        with self._lock:
            if self.role != CoordinatorRole.LEADER:
                return False
            if self.consensus_provider and self._consensus_lease:
                try:
                    renewed = self.consensus_provider.renew_leadership(
                        self._consensus_lease, ttl_seconds=self.lease_duration_seconds
                    )
                    self._consensus_lease = renewed
                    if self.fencing_token:
                        self.fencing_token.expires_at_timestamp = renewed.expires_at
                        self.fencing_token.fencing_generation = renewed.generation
                    return True
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.warning("Consensus lease renewal failed: %s", e)
                    self.step_down(f"Consensus renewal failed: {e}")
                    return False

            if self.fencing_token:
                self.fencing_token.expires_at_timestamp = time.time() + self.lease_duration_seconds
            return True

    def _broadcast_heartbeat(self) -> None:
        """Leader broadcasts heartbeat to all registered peers."""
        hb = ConsensusHeartbeat(
            term=self.current_term,
            leader_id=self.coordinator_id,
            fencing_generation=self.current_generation,
            lease_ttl_seconds=self.lease_duration_seconds,
        )
        self.renew_leader_lease()

        if not self.transport_call:
            return

        acked = 1
        for peer_id in list(self._peers.keys()):
            try:
                res = self.transport_call(peer_id, "Heartbeat", hb.to_dict())
                if res and res.get("success"):
                    acked += 1
                elif res and res.get("term", 0) > self.current_term:
                    self.current_term = res["term"]
                    self.step_down("Heartbeat response indicated higher term")
                    return
            except Exception:
                pass

        # Quorum loss check
        if acked < self.quorum_size and len(self._peers) > 0:
            logger.warning("Leader '%s' lost quorum (%d/%d acked). Entering DEGRADED mode.", self.coordinator_id, acked, self.quorum_size)
            self._set_role(CoordinatorRole.DEGRADED)
            self.fencing_token = None

    def _run_loop(self) -> None:
        """Background thread monitoring election timeouts or sending leader heartbeats."""
        while self._is_running:
            time.sleep(self.heartbeat_interval_seconds)
            with self._lock:
                if not self._is_running:
                    break

                now = time.time()
                if self.role == CoordinatorRole.LEADER:
                    self._broadcast_heartbeat()
                else:
                    # Check election timeout
                    elapsed = now - self._last_heartbeat_received_ts
                    if elapsed > self._election_timeout:
                        logger.info("Election timeout elapsed (%.2fs > %.2fs). Starting election...", elapsed, self._election_timeout)
                        self.start_election()

    def reconcile_failover(
        self,
        active_transactions: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
        lease_manager: Optional[Any] = None,
        journal: Optional[Any] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Reconciles in-flight transactions and task leases after this node becomes leader.
        Identifies orphaned leases, checks journal integrity, and safely resumes work.
        """
        fencing = LeaderFencingValidator(self).assert_active_leader("reconcile_failover")

        report: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "leader_id": self.coordinator_id,
            "term": self.current_term,
            "fencing_generation": fencing.fencing_generation,
            "status": "reconciled",
            "reconciled_by": self.coordinator_id,
            "current_term": self.current_term,
            "reconciled_transactions": 0,
            "orphaned_leases_revoked": 0,
            "recovery_required_transactions": [],
        }

        with self._lock:
            # 1. Prune expired or stale task leases
            if lease_manager and hasattr(lease_manager, "prune_expired_leases"):
                expired = lease_manager.prune_expired_leases()
                report["orphaned_leases_revoked"] = len(expired)

            # 2. Inspect active transactions
            for tx in (active_transactions or []):
                report["reconciled_transactions"] += 1
                # Mark transactions with ambiguous state for verification
                if hasattr(tx, "status") and str(tx.status).endswith("RUNNING"):
                    # Record adoption event in journal
                    if journal and hasattr(journal, "append_event"):
                        journal.append_event(
                            event_type="ha.transaction_adopted",
                            transaction_id=tx.transaction_id,
                            payload={
                                "new_leader_id": self.coordinator_id,
                                "term": self.current_term,
                                "fencing_generation": fencing.fencing_generation,
                            },
                        )

        logger.info("Failover reconciliation completed by leader '%s': %s", self.coordinator_id, report)
        return report

"""
core/hypothesis_engine.py - Autonomous Scientific Hypothesis Generation & Tracking Engine (AutoDev Version 3.6)
Strictly 100% Python Standard Library. Zero external dependencies.
"""

import enum
import hashlib
import re
import threading
import time
import uuid
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set

from core.reasoning_cache import ReasoningCache


class HypothesisStatus(str, enum.Enum):
    """Lifecycle state of a scientific research hypothesis."""
    PROPOSED = "PROPOSED"
    UNDER_TEST = "UNDER_TEST"
    IN_EXPERIMENTATION = "IN_EXPERIMENTATION"
    CONFIRMED = "CONFIRMED"
    VALIDATED = "VALIDATED"
    FALSIFIED = "FALSIFIED"
    REFUTED = "REFUTED"
    RETIRED = "RETIRED"
    ABANDONED = "ABANDONED"
    ACCEPTED = "ACCEPTED"


class HypothesisPriority(str, enum.Enum):
    """Urgency and expected strategic impact of the hypothesis."""
    LOW = "LOW"
    MEDIUM = "MEDIUM"
    HIGH = "HIGH"
    CRITICAL = "CRITICAL"


@dataclass
class ResearchHypothesis:
    """Scientific research hypothesis formulation with evaluation criteria and lifecycle state."""
    hypothesis_id: str
    statement: str = ""
    rationale: str = ""
    metric_target: str = ""
    expected_effect_direction: str = ""
    target_effect_size: float = 0.0
    priority: HypothesisPriority = HypothesisPriority.MEDIUM
    status: HypothesisStatus = HypothesisStatus.PROPOSED
    p_value: Optional[float] = None
    effect_size: Optional[float] = None
    evidence: str = ""
    rejection_reason: str = ""

    # Extended / backwards-compatible attributes
    title: str = ""
    description: str = ""
    expected_outcome: str = ""
    affected_modules: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    evaluation_metric: str = ""
    target_improvement_pct: float = 0.0
    confidence: float = 0.70
    dependencies: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    author: str = "ChiefScientist"
    created_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    validated_at: Optional[float] = None
    experiment_ids: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    evidence_summary: str = ""
    tags: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not self.statement and self.title:
            self.statement = self.title
        if not self.title and self.statement:
            self.title = self.statement
        if not self.description and self.rationale:
            self.description = self.rationale
        if not self.rationale and self.description:
            self.rationale = self.description
        if not self.evaluation_metric and self.metric_target:
            self.evaluation_metric = self.metric_target
        if not self.metric_target and self.evaluation_metric:
            self.metric_target = self.evaluation_metric

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "hypothesis_id": self.hypothesis_id,
            "statement": self.statement,
