"""
core/patent_generator.py - Autonomous Intellectual Property & Patent Application Generator (AutoDev Version 3.6)
Strictly 100% Python Standard Library. Zero external dependencies.
"""

import threading
import time
import uuid
import enum
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional


class PatentClaimType(str, enum.Enum):
    """Legacy independent/dependent claim classification."""

    INDEPENDENT = "INDEPENDENT"
    DEPENDENT = "DEPENDENT"


@dataclass
class PatentClaim:
    """An individual independent or dependent patent claim."""
    claim_number: int
    is_independent: bool
    text: str
    depends_on: Optional[int] = None

    @property
    def claim_type(self) -> PatentClaimType:
        return PatentClaimType.INDEPENDENT if self.is_independent else PatentClaimType.DEPENDENT

    @property
    def claim_text(self) -> str:
        return self.text

    def format_text(self) -> str:
        if self.is_independent:
            return f"{self.claim_number}. A computer-implemented system and method comprising: {self.text.strip()}"
        return f"{self.claim_number}. The method of claim {self.depends_on}, further comprising: {self.text.strip()}"


@dataclass
class PatentApplication:
    """Formal intellectual property patent disclosure document."""
    patent_id: str
    title: str
    inventors: List[str]
    abstract: str
    technical_field: str
    background: str
    summary: str
    detailed_description: str
    claims: List[PatentClaim]
    advantages: str
    industrial_applications: str
    created_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time)

    @property
    def application_id(self) -> str:
        return self.patent_id

    @property
    def field_of_invention(self) -> str:
        return self.technical_field

    def to_markdown(self) -> str:
        """Renders the patent specification into standardized legal patent draft Markdown."""
        inventors_str = ", ".join(self.inventors)
        date_str = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d", time.gmtime(self.created_at))

        claims_lines = [c.format_text() for c in self.claims]
        claims_formatted = "\n\n".join(claims_lines)

        return f"""# PATENT APPLICATION SPECIFICATION

UNITED STATES PATENT AND TRADEMARK OFFICE

**TITLE:** {self.title}  
**DOCKET / PATENT ID:** `{self.patent_id}`  
**FILING DATE:** {date_str}  
**INVENTORS:** {inventors_str}  

---

## ABSTRACT
{self.abstract.strip()}

---

## TECHNICAL FIELD
{self.technical_field.strip()}

## BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION
{self.background.strip()}

## BRIEF SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION
{self.summary.strip()}

## DETAILED DESCRIPTION OF THE PREFERRED EMBODIMENTS
{self.detailed_description.strip()}

## ADVANTAGES OF THE INVENTION
{self.advantages.strip()}

## INDUSTRIAL APPLICABILITY
{self.industrial_applications.strip()}

## CLAIMS
What is claimed is:

{claims_formatted}
"""

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "patent_id": self.patent_id,
            "application_id": self.application_id,
            "title": self.title,
            "inventors": list(self.inventors),
            "abstract": self.abstract,
            "technical_field": self.technical_field,
            "field_of_invention": self.field_of_invention,
            "background": self.background,
            "summary": self.summary,
            "detailed_description": self.detailed_description,
            "claims": [
                {
                    "claim_number": claim.claim_number,
                    "claim_type": claim.claim_type.value,
                    "claim_text": claim.claim_text,
                    "depends_on": claim.depends_on,
                }
                for claim in self.claims
            ],
            "advantages": self.advantages,
            "industrial_applications": self.industrial_applications,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
        }


class PatentGenerator:
    """
    Autonomous patent generator drafting complete intellectual property applications
    from newly discovered algorithms, architectures, and empirical breakthroughs.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._patents: Dict[str, PatentApplication] = {}

    def draft_patent(
        self,
        title: str,
        inventors: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        abstract: str = "",
        technical_field: str = "",
        background: str = "",
        summary: str = "",
        detailed_description: str = "",
        claims: Optional[List[PatentClaim]] = None,
        advantages: str = "",
        industrial_applications: str = "",
        field_of_invention: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> PatentApplication:
        """Assembles a formal patent application."""
        with self._lock:
            pid = f"PAT-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8].upper()}"
            patent = PatentApplication(
                patent_id=pid,
                title=title,
                inventors=list(inventors or []),
                abstract=abstract,
                technical_field=field_of_invention or technical_field,
                background=background,
                summary=summary,
                detailed_description=detailed_description,
                claims=list(claims or []),
                advantages=advantages,
                industrial_applications=industrial_applications,
            )
            self._patents[pid] = patent
            return patent

    def add_claim(
        self,
        application_id: str,
        claim_type: PatentClaimType,
        claim_text: str,
        depends_on: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> PatentClaim:
        with self._lock:
            application = self._patents.get(application_id)
            if application is None:
                raise KeyError(f"Patent application {application_id!r} not found")
            kind = PatentClaimType(claim_type)
            if kind is PatentClaimType.DEPENDENT and depends_on is None:
                raise ValueError("Dependent claims must specify depends_on.")
            claim = PatentClaim(
                claim_number=len(application.claims) + 1,
                is_independent=kind is PatentClaimType.INDEPENDENT,
                text=claim_text,
                depends_on=depends_on,
            )
            application.claims.append(claim)
            return claim

    def get_application(self, application_id: str) -> Optional[PatentApplication]:
        return self.get_patent(application_id)

    def get_all_applications(self) -> List[PatentApplication]:
        with self._lock:
            return list(self._patents.values())

    def render_specification(self, application_id: str) -> str:
        application = self.get_patent(application_id)
        if application is None:
            raise KeyError(f"Patent application {application_id!r} not found")
        return application.to_markdown()

    def synthesize_from_algorithm(
        self,
        algorithm_name: str,
        inventors: List[str],
        algorithm_domain: str,
        specification_text: str,
        performance_gain_description: str,
    ) -> PatentApplication:
        """Synthesizes a complete patent disclosure from an algorithm record."""
        title = f"SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR {algorithm_name.upper()} IN AUTONOMOUS COMPUTING ECOSYSTEMS"
        abstract = (
            f"An autonomous computing system and computer-implemented method for {algorithm_name}. "
            f"The system provides deterministic optimization in the {algorithm_domain} domain by "
            f"dynamically scheduling resources and executing specialized algorithms. The invention "
            f"achieves substantial performance advantages, specifically {performance_gain_description}."
        )

        tech_field = (
            f"The present disclosure relates generally to autonomous multi-agent computing environments, "
            f"and more specifically to algorithmic optimization systems and computer-implemented methods for {algorithm_domain}."
        )

        bg = (
            f"Conventional automated engineering frameworks suffer from severe latency bottlenecks, non-deterministic "
            f"execution stalls, and excessive resource consumption when scaled. Existing methods fail to provide "
            f"deterministic, tamper-evident optimization without external third-party dependencies. "
            f"Therefore, an improved mechanism for {algorithm_name} is urgently needed."
        )

        summ = (
            f"To overcome the deficiencies of the prior art, the present invention discloses an autonomous system "
            f"executing {algorithm_name}. The system introduces novel state indexing, cryptographic payload verification, "
            f"and adaptive priority routing to ensure deterministic execution within strict mathematical bounds."
        )

        det_desc = (
            f"In accordance with exemplary embodiments, the system comprises a plurality of processing agents "
            f"communicating via an authenticated bus. The algorithm executes according to the following logic:\n\n"
            f"```\n{specification_text}\n```\n\n"
            f"During operation, in-flight data packets are prioritized according to empirical utility scores, "
            f"achieving bounded algorithmic complexity."
        )

        adv = (
            f"The invention provides several distinct advantages over prior systems: "
            f"(1) eliminates reliance on external runtime orchestration frameworks, "
            f"(2) delivers proven performance improvements including {performance_gain_description}, and "
            f"(3) guarantees deterministic reproducibility across multi-agent threads."
        )

        ind_app = (
            f"The disclosed embodiments are directly applicable to enterprise software development, distributed "
            f"cloud computing, real-time algorithmic arbitration, and autonomous AI infrastructure management."
        )

        claims = [
            PatentClaim(
                claim_number=1,
                is_independent=True,
                text=(
                    f"obtaining operational execution parameters for {algorithm_name}; "
                    f"evaluating a objective function across one or more processing nodes; and "
                    f"dynamically reallocating compute resources to achieve {performance_gain_description}."
                ),
            ),
            PatentClaim(
                claim_number=2,
                is_independent=False,
                depends_on=1,
                text="wherein the evaluation is performed using a deterministic Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) surrogate model.",
            ),
            PatentClaim(
                claim_number=3,
                is_independent=False,
                depends_on=1,
                text="wherein communication across said processing nodes is authenticated using SHA-256 cryptographic hashes.",
            ),
        ]

        return self.draft_patent(
            title=title,
            inventors=inventors,
            abstract=abstract,
            technical_field=tech_field,
            background=bg,
            summary=summ,
            detailed_description=det_desc,
            claims=claims,
            advantages=adv,
            industrial_applications=ind_app,
        )

    def get_patent(self, patent_id: str) -> Optional[PatentApplication]:
        with self._lock:
            return self._patents.get(patent_id)

"""
core/peer_review_engine.py - Academic Peer Review & Scientific Consensus Arbitration Engine (AutoDev Version 3.6)
Strictly 100% Python Standard Library. Zero external dependencies.
"""

import enum
import threading
import time
import uuid
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional


class ReviewRecommendation(str, enum.Enum):
    """Formal editorial decision on submitted manuscripts or patent proposals."""
    ACCEPT = "ACCEPT"
    MINOR_REVISION = "MINOR_REVISION"
    MAJOR_REVISION = "MAJOR_REVISION"
    REJECT = "REJECT"


EditorialDecision = ReviewRecommendation


@dataclass
class ReviewRubric:
    """Legacy four-dimension rubric scored on a ten-point scale."""

    novelty_score: float
    soundness_score: float
    clarity_score: float
    empirical_rigor_score: float

    @property
    def overall_score(self) -> float:
        return (
            self.novelty_score
            + self.soundness_score
            + self.clarity_score
            + self.empirical_rigor_score
        ) / 4


@dataclass
class ReviewEvaluation:
    """Legacy review result retaining its submitted rubric."""

    review_id: str
    paper_id: str
    reviewer_name: str
    rubric: ReviewRubric
    comments: str
    recommendation: ReviewRecommendation


@dataclass
class IndividualReview:
    """Rigorous academic assessment from an individual reviewer agent."""
    review_id: str
    paper_id: str
    reviewer: str
    novelty: float                        # Scale 1.0 (trivial) to 5.0 (breakthrough)
    correctness: float                    # Scale 1.0 (fatally flawed) to 5.0 (rigorously proven)
    reproducibility: float                # Scale 1.0 (unreplicable) to 5.0 (deterministically verified)
    experimental_quality: float           # Scale 1.0 (anecdotal) to 5.0 (extensive DoE)
    writing_quality: float                # Scale 1.0 (incomprehensible) to 5.0 (publication grade)
    statistical_soundness: float          # Scale 1.0 (spurious) to 5.0 (proper power & alpha)
    comments: str
    recommendation: ReviewRecommendation
    created_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time)

    @property
    def composite_score(self) -> float:
        return (
            0.20 * self.novelty +
            0.20 * self.correctness +
            0.20 * self.reproducibility +
            0.15 * self.experimental_quality +
            0.10 * self.writing_quality +
            0.15 * self.statistical_soundness
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "review_id": self.review_id,
            "paper_id": self.paper_id,
            "reviewer": self.reviewer,
            "novelty": self.novelty,
            "correctness": self.correctness,
            "reproducibility": self.reproducibility,
            "experimental_quality": self.experimental_quality,
            "writing_quality": self.writing_quality,
            "statistical_soundness": self.statistical_soundness,
            "composite_score": round(self.composite_score, 2),
            "recommendation": self.recommendation.value,
            "comments": self.comments,
        }


@dataclass
class ConsensusReview:
    """Editorial consensus synthesis summarizing multiple peer reviews."""
    paper_id: str
    review_count: int
    mean_composite_score: float
    decision: ReviewRecommendation
    meta_review_summary: str
    individual_reviews: List[IndividualReview] = field(default_factory=list)
    timestamp: float = field(default_factory=time.time)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "paper_id": self.paper_id,
            "review_count": self.review_count,
            "mean_composite_score": round(self.mean_composite_score, 2),
            "decision": self.decision.value,
            "meta_review_summary": self.meta_review_summary,
            "individual_reviews": [r.to_dict() for r in self.individual_reviews],
        }


class PeerReviewEngine:
    """
    Orchestrates the formal peer review process for submitted papers and technical proposals.
    Aggregates reviews across 6 dimensions and synthesizes editorial consensus.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._reviews: Dict[str, List[IndividualReview]] = {}  # paper_id -> reviews
        self._decisions: Dict[str, ConsensusReview] = {}
        self._legacy_reviews: Dict[str, List[ReviewEvaluation]] = {}

    def submit_review(
        self,
        paper_id: str,
        reviewer: Optional[str] = None,
        novelty: Optional[float] = None,
        correctness: Optional[float] = None,
        reproducibility: Optional[float] = None,
        experimental_quality: Optional[float] = None,
        writing_quality: Optional[float] = None,
        statistical_soundness: Optional[float] = None,
        comments: str = "",
        recommendation: Optional[ReviewRecommendation] = None,
        *,
        reviewer_name: Optional[str] = None,
        rubric: Optional[ReviewRubric] = None,
    ) -> IndividualReview | ReviewEvaluation:
        """Records an individual review for a paper."""
        if rubric is not None:
            reviewer_label = reviewer_name or reviewer or "Reviewer"
            selected_recommendation = recommendation or (
                ReviewRecommendation.ACCEPT
                if rubric.overall_score >= 8.0
                else ReviewRecommendation.MINOR_REVISION
                if rubric.overall_score >= 6.0
                else ReviewRecommendation.REJECT
            )
            result = ReviewEvaluation(
                review_id=f"REV-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8].upper()}",
                paper_id=paper_id,
                reviewer_name=reviewer_label,
                rubric=rubric,
                comments=comments,
                recommendation=ReviewRecommendation(selected_recommendation),
            )
            with self._lock:
                self._legacy_reviews.setdefault(paper_id, []).append(result)
            return result
        required_metrics = (
            reviewer,
            novelty,
            correctness,
            reproducibility,
            experimental_quality,
            writing_quality,
            statistical_soundness,
        )
        if any(value is None for value in required_metrics):
            raise TypeError("Numeric review dimensions and reviewer are required.")
        selected_recommendation = recommendation or ReviewRecommendation.MINOR_REVISION
        with self._lock:
            rid = f"REV-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8].upper()}"
            review = IndividualReview(
                review_id=rid,
                paper_id=paper_id,
                reviewer=reviewer,
                novelty=max(1.0, min(5.0, novelty)),
                correctness=max(1.0, min(5.0, correctness)),
                reproducibility=max(1.0, min(5.0, reproducibility)),
                experimental_quality=max(1.0, min(5.0, experimental_quality)),
                writing_quality=max(1.0, min(5.0, writing_quality)),
                statistical_soundness=max(1.0, min(5.0, statistical_soundness)),
                comments=comments,
                recommendation=ReviewRecommendation(selected_recommendation),
            )

            self._reviews.setdefault(paper_id, []).append(review)
            return review

    def determine_editorial_decision(self, paper_id: str) -> ReviewRecommendation:
        with self._lock:
            reviews = self._legacy_reviews.get(paper_id, [])
            if not reviews:
                return self.synthesize_consensus(paper_id).decision
            accepts = sum(review.recommendation is ReviewRecommendation.ACCEPT for review in reviews)
            rejects = sum(review.recommendation is ReviewRecommendation.REJECT for review in reviews)
            if accepts > rejects:
                return ReviewRecommendation.ACCEPT
            if rejects > accepts:
                return ReviewRecommendation.REJECT
            return ReviewRecommendation.MINOR_REVISION

    def conduct_automated_review(
        self,
        paper_id: str,
        reviewer: str = "AutomatedPeerReviewer",
        novelty_score_norm: float = 0.8,         # [0.0 - 1.0] from NoveltyDetector
        reproducible_match: bool = True,
        is_statistically_significant: bool = True,
        sample_size: int = 50,
    ) -> IndividualReview:
        """Automated algorithmic reviewer evaluating objective scientific criteria."""
        novelty = 1.0 + (novelty_score_norm * 4.0)
        correctness = 4.5 if is_statistically_significant else 2.5
        reproducibility = 5.0 if reproducible_match else 1.5
        exp_qual = 4.5 if sample_size >= 30 else 3.0
        writing_qual = 4.5
        stat_soundness = 4.8 if is_statistically_significant else 2.0

        comp = (0.20 * novelty + 0.20 * correctness + 0.20 * reproducibility + 0.15 * exp_qual + 0.10 * writing_qual + 0.15 * stat_soundness)

        if comp >= 4.0 and reproducible_match and is_statistically_significant:
            rec = ReviewRecommendation.ACCEPT
            comm = "High-quality paper with strong statistical evidence and verified reproducibility. Recommended for immediate acceptance."
        elif comp >= 3.0:
            rec = ReviewRecommendation.MINOR_REVISION
            comm = "Promising work but requires minor revisions and expanded ablation experiments."
        elif comp >= 2.0:
            rec = ReviewRecommendation.MAJOR_REVISION
            comm = "Significant methodological questions or borderline statistical significance. Major revision required."
        else:
            rec = ReviewRecommendation.REJECT
            comm = "Fatal flaws in reproducibility or statistical power. Rejected."

        return self.submit_review(
            paper_id=paper_id,
            reviewer=reviewer,
            novelty=novelty,
            correctness=correctness,
            reproducibility=reproducibility,
            experimental_quality=exp_qual,
            writing_quality=writing_qual,
            statistical_soundness=stat_soundness,
            comments=comm,
            recommendation=rec,
        )

    def synthesize_consensus(self, paper_id: str) -> ConsensusReview:
        """Synthesizes editorial meta-review from all submitted reviews for the paper."""
        with self._lock:
            revs = self._reviews.get(paper_id, [])
            if not revs:
                raise ValueError(f"No reviews submitted for paper '{paper_id}'")

            mean_score = sum(r.composite_score for r in revs) / len(revs)

            # Consensus decision
            recommendations = [r.recommendation for r in revs]
            if all(r == ReviewRecommendation.ACCEPT for r in recommendations) or (mean_score >= 4.0 and ReviewRecommendation.REJECT not in recommendations):
                decision = ReviewRecommendation.ACCEPT
                summary = f"Unanimous or overwhelming consensus to ACCEPT based on strong scores (mean={mean_score:.2f}/5.0)."
            elif ReviewRecommendation.REJECT in recommendations and mean_score < 3.0:
                decision = ReviewRecommendation.REJECT
                summary = f"Paper REJECTED due to critical flaws identified by reviewers (mean={mean_score:.2f}/5.0)."
            elif mean_score >= 3.3:
                decision = ReviewRecommendation.MINOR_REVISION
                summary = f"Decision is MINOR REVISION to address reviewer feedback (mean={mean_score:.2f}/5.0)."
            else:
                decision = ReviewRecommendation.MAJOR_REVISION
                summary = f"Decision is MAJOR REVISION due to substantial concerns (mean={mean_score:.2f}/5.0)."

            consensus = ConsensusReview(
                paper_id=paper_id,
                review_count=len(revs),
                mean_composite_score=mean_score,
                decision=decision,
                meta_review_summary=summary,
                individual_reviews=revs,
            )

            self._decisions[paper_id] = consensus
            return consensus

    def get_consensus(self, paper_id: str) -> Optional[ConsensusReview]:
        with self._lock:
            return self._decisions.get(paper_id)

"""
performance_profiler.py - Performance Profiling Framework for AutoDev (v3.6.1)

Benchmarks various subsystems and tracks performance history.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import math
import statistics
import tempfile
import threading
import time
import tracemalloc
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Union

logger = logging.getLogger("AutoDev.PerformanceProfiler")

@dataclass
class PerformanceStats:
    """Statistical metrics for a profiled operation."""
    min: float
    max: float
    mean: float
    median: float
    p95: float
    count: int

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "min": round(self.min, 4),
            "max": round(self.max, 4),
            "mean": round(self.mean, 4),
            "median": round(self.median, 4),
            "p95": round(self.p95, 4),
            "count": self.count
        }

@dataclass
class PerformanceReport:
    """Comprehensive performance report across subsystems."""
    timestamp: float
    subsystems: Dict[str, PerformanceStats]
    memory_usage_bytes: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    cache_statistics: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "timestamp": self.timestamp,
            "subsystems": {
                name: stats.to_dict()
                for name, stats in sorted(self.subsystems.items())
            },
            "memory_usage_bytes": dict(sorted(self.memory_usage_bytes.items())),
            "cache_statistics": self.cache_statistics,
        }

class PerformanceProfiler:
    """
    Benchmarks AutoDev subsystems and manages performance history.
    """

    HISTORY_FILE = Path("memory/benchmarks/history.json")
    REPORT_FILE = Path("memory/benchmarks/performance_report.json")

    def __init__(
        self,
        history_file: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
        report_file: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
        cache_manager: Optional[Any] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.history_file = Path(history_file).resolve() if history_file else self.HISTORY_FILE
        self.report_file = Path(report_file).resolve() if report_file else self.REPORT_FILE
        self.cache_manager = cache_manager
        self.history: Dict[str, List[float]] = {}
        self.memory_usage_bytes: Dict[str, int] = {}
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._load_history()

    def _load_history(self) -> None:
        if self.history_file.exists():
            try:
                self.history = json.loads(self.history_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError) as err:
                logger.warning("Failed to load performance history: %s", err)

    def _save_history(self) -> None:
        self.history_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
            "w", encoding="utf-8", dir=self.history_file.parent, delete=False
        ) as temp_file:
            json.dump(self.history, temp_file, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
            temp_path = Path(temp_file.name)
        temp_path.replace(self.history_file)

    def record_duration(self, subsystem: str, duration: float) -> None:
        """Records a single duration measurement for a subsystem."""
        if not subsystem:
            raise ValueError("Subsystem name must not be empty.")
        if duration < 0:
            raise ValueError("Duration must not be negative.")
        with self._lock:
            self.history.setdefault(subsystem, []).append(float(duration))
            del self.history[subsystem][:-1000]
            self._save_history()

    def record_memory_usage(self, subsystem: str, usage_bytes: int) -> None:
        """Records a non-negative peak memory delta for a subsystem."""
        if usage_bytes < 0:
            raise ValueError("Memory usage must not be negative.")
        with self._lock:
            self.memory_usage_bytes[subsystem] = int(usage_bytes)

    def profile_subsystem(self, name: str):
        """Decorator or context manager to profile a subsystem."""
        class ProfilerContext:
            def __init__(self, profiler: PerformanceProfiler, subsystem: str):
                self.profiler = profiler
                self.subsystem = subsystem
                self.start_time = 0.0
                self._owns_tracemalloc = False
                self._starting_memory = 0

            def __enter__(self):
                self.start_time = time.perf_counter()
                if not tracemalloc.is_tracing():
                    tracemalloc.start()
                    self._owns_tracemalloc = True
                self._starting_memory = tracemalloc.get_traced_memory()[0]
                tracemalloc.reset_peak()
                return self

            def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb):
                duration = time.perf_counter() - self.start_time
                self.profiler.record_duration(self.subsystem, duration)
                peak_memory = max(
                    0,
                    tracemalloc.get_traced_memory()[1] - self._starting_memory,
                )
                self.profiler.record_memory_usage(self.subsystem, peak_memory)
                if self._owns_tracemalloc:
                    tracemalloc.stop()

        return ProfilerContext(self, name)

    def generate_report(self) -> PerformanceReport:
        """Calculates statistics and generates a performance report."""
        stats_map = {}
        for subsystem, durations in sorted(self.history.items()):
            if not durations:
                continue

            sorted_durations = sorted(durations)
            count = len(durations)
            mean = sum(durations) / count
            median = statistics.median(sorted_durations)
            p95 = sorted_durations[max(0, math.ceil(count * 0.95) - 1)]

            stats_map[subsystem] = PerformanceStats(
                min=min(durations),
                max=max(durations),
                mean=mean,
                median=median,
                p95=p95,
                count=count
            )

        cache_stats = self.cache_manager.stats() if self.cache_manager else {}
        return PerformanceReport(
            timestamp=time.time(),
            subsystems=stats_map,
            memory_usage_bytes=dict(sorted(self.memory_usage_bytes.items())),
            cache_statistics=cache_stats,
        )

    def save_report(
        self,
        output_path: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
    ) -> Path:
        """Generates and atomically writes performance_report.json."""
        target = Path(output_path).resolve() if output_path else self.report_file
        report = self.generate_report()
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
            "w", encoding="utf-8", dir=target.parent, delete=False
        ) as temp_file:
            json.dump(report.to_dict(), temp_file, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
            temp_path = Path(temp_file.name)
        temp_path.replace(target)
        return target

    def generate_dashboard(self, output_path: str = "performance_dashboard.json") -> None:
        """Generates a detailed performance dashboard JSON."""
        from core.cache_manager import CacheManager
        cache_manager = CacheManager()
        cache_stats = cache_manager.get_stats()
        
        report = self.generate_report()
        
        dashboard = {
            "version": "3.6.1",
            "generated_at": time.time(),
            "subsystems": report.to_dict()["subsystems"],
            "cache": {
                "total_size_bytes": cache_stats["total_size_bytes"],
                "cache_count": cache_stats["cache_count"],
                "details": cache_stats["caches"]
            },
            "summary": {
                "avg_indexing_time": report.subsystems.get("Indexing", PerformanceStats(0,0,0,0,0,0)).mean if "Indexing" in report.subsystems else 0,
                "avg_warm_indexing_time": report.subsystems.get("Warm_Indexing", PerformanceStats(0,0,0,0,0,0)).mean if "Warm_Indexing" in report.subsystems else 0,
                "hit_ratio_overall": self._calculate_overall_hit_ratio(cache_stats)
            }
        }
        
        Path(output_path).write_text(json.dumps(dashboard, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

    def _calculate_overall_hit_ratio(self, cache_stats: Dict[str, Any]) -> float:
        total_hits = 0
        total_misses = 0
        for cache in cache_stats["caches"].values():
            total_hits += cache.get("hit_count", 0)
            total_misses += cache.get("miss_count", 0)
        
        if (total_hits + total_misses) == 0:
            return 0.0
        return total_hits / (total_hits + total_misses)

"""
portfolio_manager.py - Enterprise Portfolio Management System (AutoDev Version 3.5)

Manages multi-company project portfolios at enterprise scale:
- Tracks hundreds/thousands of concurrent strategic initiatives
- Evaluates ROI, Business Value, Risk, Strategic Alignment, Delivery Confidence
- Calculates Budget Variance, Schedule Variance, and Cost Performance Index (CPI)
- Automated portfolio rebalancing and priority ranking
- 100% Python Standard Library.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import collections
import enum
import logging
import threading
import time
import uuid
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

logger = logging.getLogger("AutoDev.Federation.Portfolio")


class ProjectStatus(str, enum.Enum):
    """Lifecycle status of a portfolio project."""
    PROPOSED = "PROPOSED"
    APPROVED = "APPROVED"
    ACTIVE = "ACTIVE"
    ON_TRACK = "ON_TRACK"
    AT_RISK = "AT_RISK"
    COMPLETED = "COMPLETED"
    CANCELLED = "CANCELLED"


@dataclass
class PortfolioProject:
    """A strategic enterprise project spanning one or more companies."""
    project_id: str
    title: str
    lead_company_id: str
    participating_companies: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    strategic_theme: str = "Digital Transformation"
    estimated_roi: float = 3.5  # e.g., 3.5x return on investment
    business_value_score: float = 85.0  # 0 to 100
    strategic_alignment_score: float = 90.0  # 0 to 100
    risk_score: float = 20.0  # 0 (low risk) to 100 (high risk)
    allocated_budget_usd: float = 250000.0
    spent_budget_usd: float = 0.0
    planned_duration_days: float = 90.0
    actual_days_elapsed: float = 0.0
    delivery_confidence: float = 0.85  # 0.0 to 1.0
    status: ProjectStatus = ProjectStatus.PROPOSED
    milestones_total: int = 5
    milestones_completed: int = 0
    created_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    @property
    def budget_variance_usd(self) -> float:
        """Positive indicates under budget, negative indicates cost overrun."""
        return self.allocated_budget_usd - self.spent_budget_usd

    @property
    def cost_performance_index(self) -> float:
        """Earned Value / Actual Cost ratio."""
        if self.spent_budget_usd <= 0:
            return 1.0
        earned_value = (self.milestones_completed / max(1, self.milestones_total)) * self.allocated_budget_usd
        return round(earned_value / self.spent_budget_usd, 2)

    @property
    def priority_score(self) -> float:
        """Composite priority score for portfolio ranking."""
        risk_factor = max(0.1, (100.0 - self.risk_score) / 100.0)
        return round((self.business_value_score * 0.4 + self.strategic_alignment_score * 0.4 + (self.estimated_roi * 10.0) * 0.2) * risk_factor, 2)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        d = asdict(self)
        d["status"] = self.status.value if hasattr(self.status, "value") else self.status
        d["budget_variance_usd"] = self.budget_variance_usd
        d["cost_performance_index"] = self.cost_performance_index
        d["priority_score"] = self.priority_score
        return d


class PortfolioManager:
    """
    Coordinates global project portfolio across the enterprise federation.
    Tracks ROI, delivery risks, budgets, and strategic execution.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._projects: Dict[str, PortfolioProject] = {}

    def create_project(
        self,
        title: str,
        lead_company_id: str,
        participating_companies: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        strategic_theme: str = "Enterprise Scale",
        estimated_roi: float = 3.0,
        business_value: float = 80.0,
        strategic_alignment: float = 85.0,
        risk_score: float = 25.0,
        budget_usd: float = 200000.0,
        planned_duration_days: float = 60.0,
        milestones_total: int = 5,
        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> PortfolioProject:
        """Creates a new project in the enterprise portfolio."""
        with self._lock:
            pid = f"PRJ-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8].upper()}"
            proj = PortfolioProject(
                project_id=pid,
                title=title,
                lead_company_id=lead_company_id,
                participating_companies=list(participating_companies or [lead_company_id]),
                strategic_theme=strategic_theme,
                estimated_roi=float(estimated_roi),
                business_value_score=float(business_value),
                strategic_alignment_score=float(strategic_alignment),
                risk_score=float(risk_score),
                allocated_budget_usd=float(budget_usd),
                planned_duration_days=float(planned_duration_days),
                milestones_total=max(1, int(milestones_total)),
                metadata=metadata or {},
            )
            self._projects[pid] = proj
            logger.info("Created portfolio project '%s': %s (Lead: %s)", pid, title, lead_company_id)
            return proj

    def update_progress(
        self,
        project_id: str,
        milestones_completed: Optional[int] = None,
        spent_budget_usd: Optional[float] = None,
        days_elapsed: Optional[float] = None,
        delivery_confidence: Optional[float] = None,
        status: Optional[ProjectStatus | str] = None,
    ) -> bool:
        """Updates delivery telemetry for an active project."""
        with self._lock:
            proj = self._projects.get(project_id)
            if not proj:
                return False

            if milestones_completed is not None:
                proj.milestones_completed = min(proj.milestones_total, max(0, milestones_completed))
                if proj.milestones_completed >= proj.milestones_total:
                    proj.status = ProjectStatus.COMPLETED
            if spent_budget_usd is not None:
                proj.spent_budget_usd = max(0.0, float(spent_budget_usd))
            if days_elapsed is not None:
                proj.actual_days_elapsed = max(0.0, float(days_elapsed))
            if delivery_confidence is not None:
                proj.delivery_confidence = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(delivery_confidence)))
            if status is not None:
                proj.status = ProjectStatus(status) if isinstance(status, str) else status

            # Auto-flag AT_RISK if confidence drops or budget heavily overrun
            if proj.delivery_confidence < 0.60 or proj.budget_variance_usd < -50000.0:
                if proj.status not in (ProjectStatus.COMPLETED, ProjectStatus.CANCELLED):
                    proj.status = ProjectStatus.AT_RISK

            return True

    def get_ranked_portfolio(self) -> List[PortfolioProject]:
        """Returns all projects ranked by priority score descending."""
        with self._lock:
            return sorted(self._projects.values(), key=lambda p: -p.priority_score)

    def get_portfolio_dashboard(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Synthesizes high-level executive dashboard across all portfolio projects."""
        with self._lock:
            total_projects = len(self._projects)
            if total_projects == 0:
                return {
                    "total_projects": 0,
                    "active_projects": 0,
                    "total_budget_usd": 0.0,
                    "total_spent_usd": 0.0,
                    "average_roi": 0.0,
                    "average_delivery_confidence": 1.0,
                    "portfolio_risk_index": 0.0,
                }

            total_budget = sum(p.allocated_budget_usd for p in self._projects.values())
            total_spent = sum(p.spent_budget_usd for p in self._projects.values())
            avg_roi = sum(p.estimated_roi for p in self._projects.values()) / total_projects
            avg_conf = sum(p.delivery_confidence for p in self._projects.values()) / total_projects
            avg_risk = sum(p.risk_score for p in self._projects.values()) / total_projects

            status_counts = collections.Counter(
                p.status.value if hasattr(p.status, "value") else str(p.status)
                for p in self._projects.values()
            )

            # Expected portfolio ROI value ($ return)
            expected_total_value = sum(p.allocated_budget_usd * p.estimated_roi for p in self._projects.values())

            return {
                "total_projects": total_projects,
                "active_projects": status_counts.get("ACTIVE", 0) + status_counts.get("ON_TRACK", 0) + status_counts.get("AT_RISK", 0),
                "status_breakdown": dict(status_counts),
                "total_allocated_budget_usd": round(total_budget, 2),
                "total_spent_budget_usd": round(total_spent, 2),
                "net_budget_variance_usd": round(total_budget - total_spent, 2),
                "expected_portfolio_return_usd": round(expected_total_value, 2),
                "average_roi_multiplier": round(avg_roi, 2),
                "average_delivery_confidence": round(avg_conf, 3),
                "portfolio_risk_index": round(avg_risk, 1),
                "top_strategic_projects": [
                    {"project_id": p.project_id, "title": p.title, "priority_score": p.priority_score, "lead": p.lead_company_id}
                    for p in self.get_ranked_portfolio()[:5]
                ],
            }

"""
AutoDev Predictive Quality Engine (v2.7)
Master engine coordinating pre-code-generation quality intelligence,
deterministic complexity analysis, code duplication detection, dependency health,
predictive risk modeling, memory-based historical learning, and quality gate enforcement.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import logging
import os
import time
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Set, Tuple

from core.complexity_analyzer import ComplexityAnalyzer
from core.dependency_health import DependencyHealthAnalyzer
from core.duplication_detector import DuplicationDetector
from core.quality_gate import QualityGate
from core.quality_models import (
    ComplexityMetrics,
    DependencyHealthMetrics,
    DuplicationBlock,
    PredictiveRiskScores,
    QualityAssessmentResult,
    QualityGatePolicy,
    QualityGateResult,
    QualityGateStatus,
    QualityIssue,
    QualityRiskCategory,
    QualitySeverity,
)
from core.quality_report import QualityReportGenerator
from core.quality_rules import DEFAULT_QUALITY_RULES, QualityRule
from core.risk_predictor import RiskPredictor

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class PredictiveQualityEngine:
    """Master engine delivering pre-generation quality intelligence and failure prevention."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        workspace_path: str,
        gate_policy: Optional[QualityGatePolicy] = None,
        memory_manager: Optional[Any] = None,
        rules: Optional[List[QualityRule]] = None,
    ):
        self.workspace_path = os.path.realpath(os.path.abspath(workspace_path))
        self.gate_policy = gate_policy or QualityGatePolicy()
        self.memory_manager = memory_manager
        self.rules = rules or list(DEFAULT_QUALITY_RULES)

        self.complexity_analyzer = ComplexityAnalyzer()
        self.duplication_detector = DuplicationDetector()
        self.dependency_analyzer = DependencyHealthAnalyzer(self.workspace_path)
        self.risk_predictor = RiskPredictor()
        self.quality_gate = QualityGate(self.gate_policy)

        # In-memory cache for incremental analysis: file_path -> (sha256, ComplexityMetrics)
        self._file_cache: Dict[str, Tuple[str, ComplexityMetrics]] = {}
        self._ws_dup_cache: Dict[str, Tuple[List[DuplicationBlock], float]] = {}
        self._ws_dep_cache: Dict[str, Dict[str, DependencyHealthMetrics]] = {}

    def assess_workspace(
        self,
        files_content: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
        task_id: Optional[str] = None,
        project_id: str = "default_project",
        impact_summary: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        modified_files: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    ) -> QualityAssessmentResult:
        """
        Executes full pre-generation quality assessment pipeline over workspace or specified files.
        """
        start_time = time.perf_counter()

        # 1. Gather files content
        files = files_content or self._load_workspace_python_files()
        if not files:
            # Empty workspace fallback
            return QualityAssessmentResult(
                project_id=project_id,
                task_id=task_id,
            )

        # 2. Complexity Analysis (with incremental caching)
        file_complexities: Dict[str, ComplexityMetrics] = {}
        total_loc = 0
        total_sloc = 0
        sum_mi = 0.0
        max_cyclomatic = 1
        max_cognitive = 0
        max_nesting = 0
        max_call_chain = 0

        file_hashes: List[str] = []
        for rel_path, code_str in files.items():
            content_hash = hashlib.sha256(code_str.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
            file_hashes.append(f"{rel_path}:{content_hash}")
            if rel_path in self._file_cache and self._file_cache[rel_path][0] == content_hash:
                metrics = self._file_cache[rel_path][1]
            else:
                metrics = self.complexity_analyzer.analyze_source(code_str, file_path=rel_path)
                self._file_cache[rel_path] = (content_hash, metrics)

            file_complexities[rel_path] = metrics
            total_loc += metrics.loc
            total_sloc += metrics.sloc
            sum_mi += metrics.maintainability_index
            max_cyclomatic = max(max_cyclomatic, metrics.cyclomatic_complexity)
            max_cognitive = max(max_cognitive, metrics.cognitive_complexity)
            max_nesting = max(max_nesting, metrics.max_nesting_depth)
            max_call_chain = max(max_call_chain, metrics.longest_call_chain)

        avg_mi = round(sum_mi / len(files), 2) if files else 100.0

        complexity_summary = ComplexityMetrics(
            cyclomatic_complexity=max_cyclomatic,
            cognitive_complexity=max_cognitive,
            max_nesting_depth=max_nesting,
            longest_call_chain=max_call_chain,
            loc=total_loc,
            sloc=total_sloc,
            maintainability_index=avg_mi,
        )

        ws_hash = hashlib.sha256(";".join(sorted(file_hashes)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

        # 3. Duplication Detection (with workspace-level cache)
        if ws_hash in self._ws_dup_cache:
            duplications, dup_percentage = self._ws_dup_cache[ws_hash]
        else:
            duplications, dup_percentage = self.duplication_detector.scan_files(files)
            self._ws_dup_cache[ws_hash] = (duplications, dup_percentage)

        # 4. Dependency Health Analysis (with workspace-level cache)
        if ws_hash in self._ws_dep_cache:
            dep_health_map = self._ws_dep_cache[ws_hash]
        else:
            dep_health_map = self.dependency_analyzer.analyze_workspace(files)
            self._ws_dep_cache[ws_hash] = dep_health_map
        # Select aggregate/worst metrics
        aggregate_dep_health = self._aggregate_dependency_health(dep_health_map)

        # 5. Query Historical Engineering Memory for Known Defect Patterns
        historical_patterns: List[str] = []
        historical_defect_count = 0
        if self.memory_manager:
            historical_patterns = self._query_historical_memories(modified_files or list(files.keys()))
            historical_defect_count = len(historical_patterns)

        # 6. Evaluate Declarative Quality Rules
        issues: List[QualityIssue] = []
        for rule in self.rules:
            context = {
                "workspace_path": self.workspace_path,
                "files_content": files,
                "file_complexities": file_complexities,
                "dependency_health": dep_health_map,
                "duplications": duplications,
            }
            # Per-file rule evaluation where applicable
            for rel_path, code_str in files.items():
                file_ctx = dict(context)
                file_ctx["file_path"] = rel_path
                file_ctx["source_code"] = code_str
                issues.extend(rule.evaluate(file_ctx))

        # Deduplicate issues by (rule_id, location)
        unique_issues: List[QualityIssue] = []
        seen_issue_keys: Set[str] = set()
        for issue in issues:
            loc_key = f"{issue.location.file_path}:{issue.location.start_line}" if issue.location else "ws"
            key = f"{issue.rule_id}:{loc_key}"
            if key not in seen_issue_keys:
                seen_issue_keys.add(key)
                unique_issues.append(issue)

        total_debt = sum(i.technical_debt_minutes for i in unique_issues)

        # 7. Predictive Risk Scores
        risk_scores = self.risk_predictor.predict_risks(
            complexity=complexity_summary,
            dependency_health=aggregate_dep_health,
            issues=unique_issues,
            impact_summary=impact_summary,
            historical_defects_count=historical_defect_count,
            modified_files=modified_files or list(files.keys()),
        )

        # 8. Quality Gate Evaluation
        gate_result = self.quality_gate.evaluate(
            complexity=complexity_summary,
            dependency_health=aggregate_dep_health,
            risk_scores=risk_scores,
            issues=unique_issues,
            duplication_percentage=dup_percentage,
        )

        # 9. Generate Heatmap Data (file_path -> risk_score)
        heatmap_data: Dict[str, float] = {}
        for f, m in file_complexities.items():
            f_issues = [i for i in unique_issues if i.location and i.location.file_path == f]
            f_score = min(
                1.0,
                (m.cyclomatic_complexity / 30.0) * 0.4
                + (1.0 - (m.maintainability_index / 100.0)) * 0.3
                + (len(f_issues) * 0.15),
            )
            heatmap_data[f] = round(f_score, 2)

        assessment = QualityAssessmentResult(
            project_id=project_id,
            task_id=task_id,
            analyzed_files_count=len(files),
            total_loc=total_loc,
            total_sloc=total_sloc,
            overall_maintainability_index=avg_mi,
            total_technical_debt_minutes=total_debt,
            complexity_summary=complexity_summary,
            dependency_health=aggregate_dep_health,
            duplications=duplications,
            duplication_percentage=dup_percentage,
            issues=unique_issues,
            risk_scores=risk_scores,
            gate_result=gate_result,
            historical_patterns_found=historical_patterns,
            heatmap_data=heatmap_data,
        )

        return assessment

    def assess_code(
        self,
        code_str: str,
        file_path: str = "snippet.py",
        task_id: Optional[str] = None,
        project_id: str = "snippet_project",
    ) -> QualityAssessmentResult:
        """Assesses a single source code snippet."""
        files = {file_path: code_str}
        return self.assess_workspace(files_content=files, task_id=task_id, project_id=project_id)

    def _load_workspace_python_files(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
        """Loads all Python source files in the workspace (excluding tests, venv, git)."""
        files: Dict[str, str] = {}
        for root, dirs, filenames in os.walk(self.workspace_path):
            # Prune hidden and virtual environment directories
            dirs[:] = [
                d
                for d in dirs
                if not d.startswith(".")
                and d not in ("venv", "env", "node_modules", "__pycache__", "build", "dist")
            ]
            for fname in filenames:
                if fname.endswith(".py"):
                    abs_p = os.path.join(root, fname)
                    rel_p = os.path.relpath(abs_p, self.workspace_path).replace("\\", "/")
                    try:
                        with open(abs_p, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
                            files[rel_p] = f.read()
                    except Exception as e:
                        logger.warning(f"Could not read {abs_p}: {e}")
        return files

    def _aggregate_dependency_health(
        self, dep_map: Dict[str, DependencyHealthMetrics]
    ) -> DependencyHealthMetrics:
        """Aggregates per-module dependency metrics into workspace-wide metric container."""
        if not dep_map:
            return DependencyHealthMetrics()

        all_cycles = []
        has_cycles = False
        max_ca = 0
        max_ce = 0
        max_instability = 0.0
        max_distance = 0.0
        is_god = False
        is_hub = False
        max_lcom4 = 1
        max_dit = 0

        for m, h in dep_map.items():
            if h.has_circular_dependencies:
                has_cycles = True
                all_cycles.extend(h.circular_dependency_cycles)
            max_ca = max(max_ca, h.afferent_coupling)
            max_ce = max(max_ce, h.efferent_coupling)
            max_instability = max(max_instability, h.instability)
            max_distance = max(max_distance, h.distance_main_sequence)
            if h.is_god_object:
                is_god = True
            if h.is_hub_module:
                is_hub = True
            max_lcom4 = max(max_lcom4, h.lack_of_cohesion_lcom4)
            max_dit = max(max_dit, h.depth_of_inheritance)

        return DependencyHealthMetrics(
            afferent_coupling=max_ca,
            efferent_coupling=max_ce,
            instability=max_instability,
            abstractness=0.0,
            distance_main_sequence=max_distance,
            has_circular_dependencies=has_cycles,
            circular_dependency_cycles=all_cycles,
            is_god_object=is_god,
            is_hub_module=is_hub,
            depth_of_inheritance=max_dit,
            lack_of_cohesion_lcom4=max_lcom4,
        )

    def _query_historical_memories(self, file_paths: Sequence[str]) -> List[str]:
        """Queries MemoryManager for past recorded defects, bugs, and failed repairs."""
        if not self.memory_manager:
            return []

        patterns: List[str] = []
        try:
            for f in file_paths:
                results = self.memory_manager.search(query=f, limit=3)
                for res in results:
                    entry = getattr(res, "entry", res)
                    desc = getattr(entry, "content", getattr(entry, "description", str(entry)))
                    patterns.append(f"Historic defect pattern for {f}: {desc[:100]}")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Memory search failed: {e}")
        return patterns

core/project_environment_detector.py.content:
"""
project_environment_detector.py - Dynamic Project Environment & Stack Detector for AutoDev (v2.3)

Inspects project repository files and dependency manifests (Python, Node.js, Java/Maven/Gradle, Static Web)
to infer the language, runtime versions, build tools, base images, and test suites with zero LLM hallucinations.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from enum import Enum
import hashlib
import json
import logging
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple, Union

logger = logging.getLogger("AutoDev.ProjectEnvironmentDetector")


class ProjectType(str, Enum):
    """Identified project technology stack type."""
    PYTHON = "PYTHON"
    NODE = "NODE"
    JAVA_MAVEN = "JAVA_MAVEN"
    JAVA_GRADLE = "JAVA_GRADLE"
    STATIC_WEB = "STATIC_WEB"
    UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN"


@dataclass
class ProjectEnvironment:
    """Inferred environment, runtime requirements, and build configuration for a project."""
    project_type: ProjectType = ProjectType.PYTHON
    primary_language: str = "python"
    runtime_version: str = "3.12"
    base_image: str = "python:3.12-slim"
    dependency_manifests: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    manifest_hashes: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    detected_languages: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    is_version_explicit: bool = False
    frameworks: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    lockfile_present: bool = False
    lockfile_path: Optional[str] = None
    build_tools: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    test_command: str = "pytest"
    build_command: Optional[str] = None
    confidence: float = 1.0
    assumptions: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    detected_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        res = asdict(self)
        res["project_type"] = self.project_type.value
        return res


ProjectEnvironmentSpec = ProjectEnvironment


class ProjectEnvironmentDetector:
    """
    Scans project directory manifests to detect technology stack and build requirements.
    """

    def __init__(self, workspace_root: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None) -> None:
        self.workspace_root = Path(workspace_root).resolve() if workspace_root else Path(".").resolve()

    def detect(self, workspace_path: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None) -> ProjectEnvironment:
        """
        Inspects project manifests and returns a structured ProjectEnvironment.
        """
        ws = Path(workspace_path).resolve() if workspace_path else self.workspace_root
        detected_languages: Set[str] = set()
        manifests: List[str] = []
        manifest_hashes: Dict[str, str] = {}
        frameworks: Set[str] = set()
        build_tools: Set[str] = set()
        runtime_version: Optional[str] = None
        is_version_explicit = False
        has_lockfile = False
        lockfile_path: Optional[str] = None
        suggested_test_cmd = "pytest"
        suggested_build_cmd: Optional[str] = None
        assumptions: List[str] = []

        if not ws.exists():
            return ProjectEnvironment(
                project_type=ProjectType.UNKNOWN,
                primary_language="unknown",
                runtime_version="unknown",
                base_image="alpine:3.19",
                assumptions=["Workspace directory does not exist."],
                confidence=0.0,
            )

        def _hash_file(p: Path) -> str:
            try:
                return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            except Exception:
                return ""

        # 1. Check Python Manifests
        py_req = ws / "requirements.txt"
        py_proj = ws / "pyproject.toml"
        py_setup = ws / "setup.py"
        py_pipfile_lock = ws / "Pipfile.lock"

        if py_req.exists() or py_proj.exists() or py_setup.exists() or list(ws.glob("*.py")):
            detected_languages.add("python")
            if py_req.exists():
                manifests.append("requirements.txt")
                manifest_hashes["requirements.txt"] = _hash_file(py_req)
            if py_proj.exists():
                manifests.append("pyproject.toml")
                manifest_hashes["pyproject.toml"] = _hash_file(py_proj)
                try:
                    content = py_proj.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                    if "fastapi" in content.lower():
                        frameworks.add("FastAPI")
                    if "django" in content.lower():
                        frameworks.add("Django")
                    if "flask" in content.lower():
                        frameworks.add("Flask")
                    match = re.search(r'requires-python\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']', content)
                    if match:
                        v_str = match.group(1).replace(">=", "").replace("==", "").replace("~=", "").strip()
                        runtime_version = v_str[:4] if len(v_str) >= 4 else v_str
                        is_version_explicit = True
                except Exception:
                    pass
            if py_pipfile_lock.exists():
                has_lockfile = True
                lockfile_path = "Pipfile.lock"
                manifest_hashes["Pipfile.lock"] = _hash_file(py_pipfile_lock)

            build_tools.add("pip")
            suggested_test_cmd = "pytest tests/ -v"

        # 2. Check Node.js / TypeScript Manifests
        pkg_json = ws / "package.json"
        pkg_lock = ws / "package-lock.json"
        yarn_lock = ws / "yarn.lock"
        pnpm_lock = ws / "pnpm-lock.yaml"
        nvmrc = ws / ".nvmrc"

        if pkg_json.exists() or list(ws.glob("*.js")) or list(ws.glob("*.ts")):
            detected_languages.add("javascript")
            if (ws / "tsconfig.json").exists() or list(ws.glob("*.ts")):
                detected_languages.add("typescript")

            if pkg_json.exists():
                manifests.append("package.json")
                manifest_hashes["package.json"] = _hash_file(pkg_json)
                try:
                    data = json.loads(pkg_json.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                    deps = {**data.get("dependencies", {}), **data.get("devDependencies", {})}
                    if "react" in deps:
                        frameworks.add("React")
                    if "next" in deps:
                        frameworks.add("Next.js")
                    if "express" in deps:
                        frameworks.add("Express")
                    if "vue" in deps:
                        frameworks.add("Vue")
                    if "jest" in deps or "mocha" in deps:
                        suggested_test_cmd = "npm test"
                except Exception:
                    pass

            if pkg_lock.exists():
                has_lockfile = True
                lockfile_path = "package-lock.json"
                manifests.append("package-lock.json")
                manifest_hashes["package-lock.json"] = _hash_file(pkg_lock)
                build_tools.add("npm")
            elif yarn_lock.exists():
                has_lockfile = True
                lockfile_path = "yarn.lock"
                manifests.append("yarn.lock")
                manifest_hashes["yarn.lock"] = _hash_file(yarn_lock)
                build_tools.add("yarn")
            elif pnpm_lock.exists():
                has_lockfile = True
                lockfile_path = "pnpm-lock.yaml"
                manifests.append("pnpm-lock.yaml")
                manifest_hashes["pnpm-lock.yaml"] = _hash_file(pnpm_lock)
                build_tools.add("pnpm")
            else:
                build_tools.add("npm")

            if nvmrc.exists():
                runtime_version = nvmrc.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
                is_version_explicit = True
            suggested_build_cmd = "npm run build" if pkg_json.exists() else None

        # 3. Check Java / Maven / Gradle
        pom_xml = ws / "pom.xml"
        build_gradle = ws / "build.gradle"
        build_gradle_kts = ws / "build.gradle.kts"

        if pom_xml.exists() or build_gradle.exists() or build_gradle_kts.exists() or list(ws.glob("*.java")):
            detected_languages.add("java")
            if pom_xml.exists():
                manifests.append("pom.xml")
                manifest_hashes["pom.xml"] = _hash_file(pom_xml)
                build_tools.add("maven")
                suggested_test_cmd = "mvn test"
                suggested_build_cmd = "mvn clean package"
            if build_gradle.exists() or build_gradle_kts.exists():
                g_file = "build.gradle" if build_gradle.exists() else "build.gradle.kts"
                manifests.append(g_file)
                manifest_hashes[g_file] = _hash_file(ws / g_file)
                build_tools.add("gradle")
                suggested_test_cmd = "gradle test"
                suggested_build_cmd = "gradle build"

        # 4. Check Static HTML / Web
        if (ws / "index.html").exists() and not detected_languages:
            detected_languages.add("html/css/javascript")
            manifests.append("index.html")
            manifest_hashes["index.html"] = _hash_file(ws / "index.html")
            suggested_test_cmd = "echo 'Static web assets verified'"

        # Project Type Resolution
        proj_type = ProjectType.UNKNOWN
        primary = "unknown"
        base_img = "alpine:3.19"

        if "python" in detected_languages:
            proj_type = ProjectType.PYTHON
            primary = "python"
            if not runtime_version:
                runtime_version = "3.12"
                assumptions.append("Defaulted Python runtime version to 3.12")
            base_img = f"python:{runtime_version}-slim"
        elif "typescript" in detected_languages or "javascript" in detected_languages:
            proj_type = ProjectType.NODE
            primary = "typescript" if "typescript" in detected_languages else "javascript"
            if not runtime_version:
                runtime_version = "20"
                assumptions.append("Defaulted Node.js runtime version to 20")
            base_img = f"node:{runtime_version}-slim"
        elif "java" in detected_languages:
            if "maven" in build_tools or pom_xml.exists():
                proj_type = ProjectType.JAVA_MAVEN
                base_img = "maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-17"
            else:
                proj_type = ProjectType.JAVA_GRADLE
                base_img = "gradle:8.5-jdk17"
            primary = "java"
            if not runtime_version:
                runtime_version = "17"
                assumptions.append("Defaulted Java runtime version to 17")
        elif "html/css/javascript" in detected_languages:
            proj_type = ProjectType.STATIC_WEB
            primary = "html/css/javascript"
            runtime_version = "static"
            base_img = "alpine:3.19"
        else:
            runtime_version = "unknown"

        confidence = 0.95 if manifests else (0.7 if detected_languages else 0.0)

        return ProjectEnvironment(
            project_type=proj_type,
            primary_language=primary,
            runtime_version=runtime_version,
            base_image=base_img,
            dependency_manifests=manifests,
            manifest_hashes=manifest_hashes,
            detected_languages=sorted(list(detected_languages)),
            is_version_explicit=is_version_explicit,
            frameworks=sorted(list(frameworks)),
            lockfile_present=has_lockfile,
            lockfile_path=lockfile_path,
            build_tools=sorted(list(build_tools)),
            test_command=suggested_test_cmd,
            build_command=suggested_build_cmd,
            confidence=confidence,
            assumptions=assumptions,
        )

"""Project, epic, sprint, and release planning with stable identifiers."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import threading
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Optional

from core.enterprise.enterprise_models import (
    Epic,
    ReleaseCandidate,
    ReleaseStage,
    SprintPlan,
    SprintState,
    UserStory,
)


@dataclass
class ManagedProject:
    project_id: str
    name: str
    description: str = ""
    status: str = "ACTIVE"
    epic_ids: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    sprint_ids: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    release_ids: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    backlog: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "project_id": self.project_id,
            "name": self.name,
            "description": self.description,
            "status": self.status,
            "epic_ids": list(self.epic_ids),
            "sprint_ids": list(self.sprint_ids),
            "release_ids": list(self.release_ids),
            "backlog": copy.deepcopy(self.backlog),
        }


class ProjectManager:
    """Coordinates projects while reusing the established enterprise data models."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._projects: dict[str, ManagedProject] = {}
        self._epics: dict[str, Epic] = {}
        self._sprints: dict[str, SprintPlan] = {}
        self._releases: dict[str, ReleaseCandidate] = {}

    def create_project(
        self,
        name: str,
        description: str = "",
        project_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> ManagedProject:
        if not name.strip():
            raise ValueError("Project name must not be empty.")
        with self._lock:
            resolved_id = project_id or f"PROJECT-{len(self._projects) + 1:04d}"
            if resolved_id in self._projects:
                raise ValueError(f"Project {resolved_id!r} already exists.")
            project = ManagedProject(resolved_id, name, description)
            self._projects[resolved_id] = project
            return copy.deepcopy(project)

    def create_epic(
        self,
        project_id: str,
        title: str,
        description: str = "",
        strategic_theme: str = "Core Platform",
        target_quarter: str = "Q1",
        estimated_roi_multiplier: float = 3.0,
    ) -> Epic:
        with self._lock:
            project = self._require_project(project_id)
            epic_id = f"{project_id}-EPIC-{len(project.epic_ids) + 1:03d}"
            epic = Epic(
                epic_id=epic_id,
                title=title,
                description=description,
                strategic_theme=strategic_theme,
                target_quarter=target_quarter,
                estimated_roi_multiplier=estimated_roi_multiplier,
            )
            self._epics[epic_id] = epic
            project.epic_ids.append(epic_id)
            return copy.deepcopy(epic)

    def create_sprint(
        self,
        project_id: str,
        goal: str,
        candidate_stories: Optional[list[UserStory]] = None,
        capacity_points: int = 40,
        duration_days: int = 14,
    ) -> SprintPlan:
        if capacity_points < 0 or duration_days <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Sprint capacity must be non-negative and duration must be positive.")
        with self._lock:
            project = self._require_project(project_id)
            sprint_number = len(project.sprint_ids) + 1
            sprint_id = f"{project_id}-SPRINT-{sprint_number:03d}"
            stories = copy.deepcopy(candidate_stories or [])
            start_date = (sprint_number - 1) * duration_days * 86400.0
            sprint = SprintPlan(
                sprint_id=sprint_id,
                sprint_number=sprint_number,
                goal=goal,
                start_date=start_date,
                end_date=start_date + duration_days * 86400.0,
                capacity_points=capacity_points,
                committed_points=sum(story.story_points for story in stories),
                stories=stories,
                state=SprintState.PLANNING,
            )
            self._sprints[sprint_id] = sprint
            project.sprint_ids.append(sprint_id)
            return copy.deepcopy(sprint)

    def create_release(
        self,
        project_id: str,
        version: str,
        stage: ReleaseStage = ReleaseStage.RELEASE_CANDIDATE,
        checklist_gates: Optional[dict[str, bool]] = None,
    ) -> ReleaseCandidate:
        with self._lock:
            project = self._require_project(project_id)
            release_id = f"{project_id}-RELEASE-{len(project.release_ids) + 1:03d}"
            resolved_stage = ReleaseStage(stage) if isinstance(stage, str) else stage
            gates = {
                "unit_tests_pass": False,
                "integration_tests_pass": False,
                "security_scan_clean": False,
                "performance_sla_met": False,
                "docs_updated": False,
                "executive_signoff": False,
            }
            if checklist_gates is not None:
                gates.update({str(name): bool(passed) for name, passed in checklist_gates.items()})
            release = ReleaseCandidate(
                release_id=release_id,
                version=version,
                stage=resolved_stage,
                checklist_gates=gates,
                created_at=0.0,
            )
            self._releases[release_id] = release
            project.release_ids.append(release_id)
            return copy.deepcopy(release)

    def add_backlog_item(self, project_id: str, item: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or not item.get("id"):
            raise ValueError("Backlog items must be dictionaries with a non-empty id.")
        with self._lock:
            project = self._require_project(project_id)
            if any(existing["id"] == item["id"] for existing in project.backlog):
                raise ValueError(f"Backlog item {item['id']!r} already exists.")
            project.backlog.append(copy.deepcopy(item))

    def update_backlog_status(self, project_id: str, item_id: str, status: str) -> bool:
        if not status:
            raise ValueError("Backlog status must not be empty.")
        with self._lock:
            project = self._require_project(project_id)
            for item in project.backlog:
                if item["id"] == item_id:
                    item["status"] = status
                    return True
            return False

    def project_dashboard(self, project_id: Optional[str] = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        with self._lock:
            projects = (
                [self._require_project(project_id)]
                if project_id is not None
                else [self._projects[key] for key in sorted(self._projects)]
            )
            return {
                "project_count": len(projects),
                "projects": [
                    {
                        **project.to_dict(),
                        "epics": [self._epics[key].to_dict() for key in project.epic_ids],
                        "sprints": [self._sprints[key].to_dict() for key in project.sprint_ids],
                        "releases": [self._releases[key].to_dict() for key in project.release_ids],
                        "completed_backlog_items": sum(
                            1 for item in project.backlog
                            if str(item.get("status", "")).lower() == "completed"
                        ),
                    }
                    for project in projects
                ],
            }

    def get_project(self, project_id: str) -> Optional[ManagedProject]:
        with self._lock:
            project = self._projects.get(project_id)
            return copy.deepcopy(project) if project else None

    def _require_project(self, project_id: str) -> ManagedProject:
        try:
            return self._projects[project_id]
        except KeyError as exc:
            raise KeyError(f"Project {project_id!r} does not exist.") from exc
