"""
test_telemetry_stream.py - Tests for Real-Time Telemetry Ring Buffer & SSE Formatting (v2.2)
"""

import json
import pytest
from core.telemetry_models import TelemetryEvent, TelemetrySeverity
from core.telemetry_stream import TelemetryStream


def test_publish_and_buffer_events():
    """Verifies publishing events to ring buffer with secret redaction."""
    stream = TelemetryStream(max_buffer_size=10)

    evt1 = stream.publish_event(
        event_type="TRANSACTION_STARTED",
        message="Starting transaction tx-100 with key sk-1234567890abcdef1234567890",
        transaction_id="tx-100",
        metadata={"token": "Bearer secret-auth-token-12345"},
    )

    assert stream.event_count == 1
    assert evt1.event_id == "evt-000001"
    assert "[REDACTED]" in evt1.message
    assert evt1.metadata["token"] == "[REDACTED]"


def test_ring_buffer_bounded_capacity():
    """Verifies ring buffer evicts oldest events when max_buffer_size is exceeded."""
    stream = TelemetryStream(max_buffer_size=3)

    for i in range(5):
        stream.publish_event(event_type=f"EVENT_{i}", message=f"Message {i}")

    assert stream.event_count == 3
    recent = stream.get_recent_events()
    assert len(recent) == 3
    assert recent[0].event_type == "EVENT_2"
    assert recent[2].event_type == "EVENT_4"


def test_subscribe_and_receive_events():
    """Verifies subscriber queues receive broadcast events."""
    stream = TelemetryStream()
    client_q, catchup = stream.subscribe()

    assert len(catchup) == 0

    stream.publish_event(event_type="STAGE_COMPLETED", message="Stage 1 complete")
    evt = client_q.get(timeout=1.0)

    assert evt is not None
    assert evt.event_type == "STAGE_COMPLETED"
    stream.unsubscribe(client_q)


def test_subscribe_catchup_by_last_event_id():
    """Verifies reconnecting with last_event_id replays missed events."""
    stream = TelemetryStream()
    stream.publish_event("E1")
    e2 = stream.publish_event("E2")
    stream.publish_event("E3")
    stream.publish_event("E4")

    # Reconnect after E2
    client_q, catchup = stream.subscribe(last_event_id=e2.event_id)

    assert len(catchup) == 2
    assert catchup[0].event_type == "E3"
    assert catchup[1].event_type == "E4"
    stream.unsubscribe(client_q)


def test_format_sse_wire_protocol():
    """Verifies standard Server-Sent Events wire format output."""
    evt = TelemetryEvent(
        event_id="evt-000099",
        event_type="WORKER_HEARTBEAT",
        message="Worker alive",
        severity=TelemetrySeverity.INFO,
    )
    sse_text = TelemetryStream.format_sse(evt)

    assert sse_text.startswith("id: evt-000099\n")
    assert "event: WORKER_HEARTBEAT\n" in sse_text
    assert "data: {" in sse_text
    assert sse_text.endswith("\n\n")


def test_telemetry_filter_by_transaction_id():
    """Verifies filtering buffered events by transaction_id."""
    stream = TelemetryStream()
    stream.publish_event("E1", transaction_id="tx-A")
    stream.publish_event("E2", transaction_id="tx-B")
    stream.publish_event("E3", transaction_id="tx-A")

    tx_a_events = stream.get_recent_events(transaction_id="tx-A")
    assert len(tx_a_events) == 2
    assert all(e.transaction_id == "tx-A" for e in tx_a_events)


def test_telemetry_multi_subscriber_fanout():
    """Verifies that events are broadcast to all active subscribers."""
    stream = TelemetryStream()
    q1, _ = stream.subscribe()
    q2, _ = stream.subscribe()

    stream.publish_event("BROADCAST_TEST", message="Hello Subscribers")

    e1 = q1.get(timeout=1.0)
    e2 = q2.get(timeout=1.0)

    assert e1.event_type == "BROADCAST_TEST"
    assert e2.event_type == "BROADCAST_TEST"

    stream.unsubscribe(q1)
    stream.unsubscribe(q2)


def test_telemetry_snapshot_model_serialization():
    """Verifies TelemetrySnapshot roundtrip serialization."""
    from core.telemetry_models import TelemetrySnapshot
    snap = TelemetrySnapshot(
        coordinator_status="HEALTHY",
        registered_workers_count=4,
        idle_workers_count=3,
        busy_workers_count=1,
        active_transactions_count=1,
    )
    d = snap.to_dict()
    assert d["coordinator_status"] == "HEALTHY"
    assert d["registered_workers_count"] == 4
    assert d["idle_workers_count"] == 3
    assert d["busy_workers_count"] == 1


def test_telemetry_stream_empty_get_recent_events():
    """Verifies querying an empty stream returns empty list."""
    stream = TelemetryStream()
    assert stream.get_recent_events() == []

"""

Validates:
- Successful pytest execution and metrics capture

- Project type detection rules (pytest.ini, tests/, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt)

import sys

)

def test_parser_various_formats():
    """Unit tests verifying regex parser for multiple pytest summary formats."""
    # 1. Simple passing
    p, f, s, t = parse_pytest_output("=== 5 passed in 0.12s ===")
    assert p == 5 and f == 0 and s == 0 and t == 5

    # 2. Mixed passing, failing, and skipped
    p, f, s, t = parse_pytest_output("=== 3 passed, 2 failed, 1 skipped in 1.45s ===")
    assert p == 3 and f == 2 and s == 1 and t == 6

    # 3. Collection/runtime errors counted as failures
    p, f, s, t = parse_pytest_output("=== 1 passed, 1 error in 0.05s ===")
    assert p == 1 and f == 1 and s == 0 and t == 2

    # 4. No tests ran
    p, f, s, t = parse_pytest_output("=== no tests ran in 0.01s ===")
    assert p == 0 and f == 0 and s == 0 and t == 0

    # 5. Empty or unformatted string
    p, f, s, t = parse_pytest_output("Random logging without summary")
    assert p == 0 and f == 0 and s == 0 and t == 0

def test_skipped_pytest_run(mock_python_project: Path):

"""

Verifies full coordination among:
ChangeExecutionPlan -> ExecutionEngine -> WorkerCoordinator -> ContainerSandbox -> Validation Gates -> TelemetryStream -> Reports
"""

import json
from pathlib import Path
import pytest

from agents.task_planner_agent import Task
from core.change_execution_planner import (

def test_v22_end_to_end_distributed_execution_with_telemetry(tmp_path):
    """
    Verifies full Version 2.2 workflow:
    1. Synthesizes a 2-stage change execution plan.
    2. Coordinates distributed execution across local workers.
    3. Streams real-time events into TelemetryStream.
    4. Validates on-disk file outputs and transaction completion.
    """
    workspace = tmp_path / "workspace"
    workspace.mkdir()
    (workspace / "tests").mkdir()
    (workspace / "tests" / "test_dummy.py").write_text("def test_dummy(): pass\n", encoding="utf-8")

    # 1. Synthesize Change Plan
    planner = ChangeExecutionPlanner()
    task = Task("T-V22-E2E", "Build Core Modules", "Feature")

    op1 = ChangeOperation(
        operation_id="OP-E2E-1",
        operation_type=OperationType.CREATE_FILE.value,
        file="core/auth.py",
        target_content="def login(): return True\n",
    )
    op2 = ChangeOperation(
        operation_id="OP-E2E-2",
        operation_type=OperationType.CREATE_FILE.value,
        file="core/database.py",
        target_content="class Database: pass\n",
    )
    op3 = ChangeOperation(
        operation_id="OP-E2E-3",
        operation_type=OperationType.CREATE_FILE.value,
        file="core/api.py",
        target_content="from core.auth import login\n",
    )

    plan = planner.plan_changes(task=task, operations=[op1, op2, op3])
    assert len(plan.ordered_stages) >= 1

    # 2. Setup Telemetry & Worker Coordinator
    telemetry = TelemetryStream()
    coordinator = WorkerCoordinator(workspace_root=workspace)
    coordinator.spawn_local_workers(count=2)

    # 3. Setup ExecutionEngine
    engine = ExecutionEngine(
        workspace_root=workspace,
        journal_root=tmp_path / "journal",
        report_dir=tmp_path / "reports",
        approval_policy=ApprovalPolicy(require_approval_for_critical_risk=False),
    )

    # 4. Execute Plan in Apply Mode
    report: ExecutionReport = engine.execute_plan(plan, mode="apply", auto_rollback=True)

    # 5. Assertions
    assert report.overall_success is True
    assert report.status == ExecutionStatus.SUCCEEDED
    assert report.operations_completed == 3
    assert (workspace / "core" / "auth.py").exists()
    assert (workspace / "core" / "database.py").exists()
    assert (workspace / "core" / "api.py").exists()


def test_v22_distributed_worker_failure_triggers_verified_rollback(tmp_path):
    """
    Verifies that when a distributed worker fails during execution:
    1. Automatic rollback cleanly restores the workspace baseline.
    2. Telemetry records the failure and rollback.
    """
    workspace = tmp_path / "workspace"
    workspace.mkdir()

    # Create pre-existing file
    existing = workspace / "main.py"
    existing.write_text("INITIAL_VERSION = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")

    op_fail = ChangeOperation(
        operation_id="OP-FAIL-1",
        operation_type=OperationType.MODIFY_FILE.value,
        file="main.py",
        target_content="INITIAL_VERSION = 2\nSYNTAX ERROR :::\n",
    )
    stage = ExecutionStage(
        stage_number=1,
        title="Failing Stage",
        operations=[op_fail],
        validation_gates=[
            ValidationGate(
                gate_id="gate-py-compile",
                gate_type=GateType.COMPILE.value,
                command="python -m py_compile main.py",
                description="Compile verification",
                blocking=True,
            )
        ],
    )
    plan = ChangeExecutionPlan(
        plan_id="CEP-V22-FAIL",
        task_id="T-FAIL",
        ordered_stages=[stage],
    )

    engine = ExecutionEngine(
        workspace_root=workspace,
        journal_root=tmp_path / "journal",
        report_dir=tmp_path / "reports",
    )

    report = engine.execute_plan(plan, mode="apply", auto_rollback=True)

    assert report.overall_success is False
    assert report.status in {ExecutionStatus.ROLLED_BACK, ExecutionStatus.FAILED}
    # Verified rollback restored original content
    assert existing.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "INITIAL_VERSION = 1\n"


def test_v22_multi_stage_disjoint_parallel_execution(tmp_path):
    """
    Verifies multi-stage execution with independent files created in stage 1,
    and modified in stage 2.
    """
    workspace = tmp_path / "workspace"
    workspace.mkdir()

    op1 = ChangeOperation("OP-S1-A", "CREATE_FILE", "pkg/a.py", target_content="VAL = 'A'\n")
    op2 = ChangeOperation("OP-S1-B", "CREATE_FILE", "pkg/b.py", target_content="VAL = 'B'\n")
    stage1 = ExecutionStage(stage_number=1, title="Create Stage", operations=[op1, op2])

    op3 = ChangeOperation("OP-S2-A", "MODIFY_FILE", "pkg/a.py", target_content="VAL = 'A_MOD'\n")
    stage2 = ExecutionStage(stage_number=2, title="Modify Stage", operations=[op3])

    plan = ChangeExecutionPlan(
        plan_id="CEP-MULTI-STAGE",
        task_id="T-MULTI",
        ordered_stages=[stage1, stage2],
    )

    engine = ExecutionEngine(
        workspace_root=workspace,
        journal_root=tmp_path / "journal",
        report_dir=tmp_path / "reports",
    )

    report = engine.execute_plan(plan, mode="apply")
    assert report.overall_success is True
    assert report.operations_completed == 3
    assert (workspace / "pkg" / "a.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "VAL = 'A_MOD'\n"
    assert (workspace / "pkg" / "b.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "VAL = 'B'\n"


def test_v22_telemetry_captures_all_events(tmp_path):
    """
    Verifies that TelemetryStream records events across the execution lifecycle.
    """
    workspace = tmp_path / "workspace"
    workspace.mkdir()

    stream = TelemetryStream()
    op1 = ChangeOperation("OP-TEL-1", "CREATE_FILE", "telemetry_test.py", target_content="print('telemetry')\n")
    stage = ExecutionStage(stage_number=1, title="Telemetry Stage", operations=[op1])
    plan = ChangeExecutionPlan(plan_id="CEP-TEL", task_id="T-TEL", ordered_stages=[stage])

    # Publish events to stream
    stream.publish_event("TRANSACTION_CREATED", transaction_id="tx-tel-1")
    stream.publish_event("STAGE_STARTED", stage_id=1, transaction_id="tx-tel-1")

    engine = ExecutionEngine(workspace_root=workspace, journal_root=tmp_path / "journal")
    report = engine.execute_plan(plan, mode="apply")

    stream.publish_event("TRANSACTION_COMPLETED", transaction_id="tx-tel-1", status=report.status.value)

    assert report.overall_success is True
    assert stream.event_count >= 3
    recent = stream.get_recent_events(transaction_id="tx-tel-1")
    assert len(recent) >= 3
    event_types = [e.event_type for e in recent]
    assert "TRANSACTION_CREATED" in event_types
    assert "STAGE_STARTED" in event_types
    assert "TRANSACTION_COMPLETED" in event_types

def test_v23_e2e_validation_failure_triggers_verified_rollback(e2e_environment):

def test_v23_e2e_hybrid_execution_and_telemetry_flow(e2e_environment):

"""
End-to-End Integration Tests for AutoDev Version 2.4 (Phase 8.5)
Exercises HA coordination, Kubernetes worker provisioning, FastCDC differential artifact sync,
and secure interactive debugging in a unified lifecycle workflow.
"""

import os
import json
import time
import tempfile
import pytest
from pathlib import Path

from core.consensus_protocol import CoordinatorRole, FencingToken
from core.ha_coordinator import HACoordinator, LeaderFencingValidator
from core.coordination_store import MemoryCoordinationStore
from core.worker_scaling_policy import WorkerScalingPolicy
from core.kubernetes_worker_provider import FakeKubernetesClient, KubernetesWorkerProvider
from core.kubernetes_worker_controller import KubernetesWorkerController
from core.artifact_chunker import ArtifactChunker
from core.artifact_chunk_store import ArtifactChunkStore
from core.artifact_sync_protocol import ChunkTransferMessage
from core.artifact_transfer_manager import ArtifactTransferManager
from core.terminal_authorization import TerminalAuthorizer, TerminalSecurityPolicy
from core.interactive_session_manager import InteractiveSessionManager
from core.terminal_gateway import TerminalGateway
from core.orchestrator import Orchestrator


class TestAutoDevV24EndToEndIntegration:
    def test_full_v24_lifecycle(self, tmp_path):
        # 1. HA Coordination: 3-node cluster leader election
        store = MemoryCoordinationStore()
        peers = ["coord-alpha", "coord-beta", "coord-gamma"]
        cluster_map = {}

        def cluster_transport(peer_id, method, payload):
            target = cluster_map.get(peer_id)
            if not target:
                return None
            if method == "RequestVote":
                from core.consensus_protocol import VoteRequest
                req = VoteRequest.from_dict(payload)
                resp = target.receive_vote_request(req)
                return resp.to_dict()
            elif method == "Heartbeat":
                from core.consensus_protocol import ConsensusHeartbeat
                hb = ConsensusHeartbeat.from_dict(payload)
                return target.receive_heartbeat(hb)
            return None

        c_alpha = HACoordinator(coordinator_id="coord-alpha", peer_ids=peers, store=store, transport_call=cluster_transport)
        c_beta = HACoordinator(coordinator_id="coord-beta", peer_ids=peers, store=store, transport_call=cluster_transport)
        c_gamma = HACoordinator(coordinator_id="coord-gamma", peer_ids=peers, store=store, transport_call=cluster_transport)

        cluster_map["coord-alpha"] = c_alpha
        cluster_map["coord-beta"] = c_beta
        cluster_map["coord-gamma"] = c_gamma

        won = c_alpha.start_election()
        assert won is True
        assert c_alpha.role == CoordinatorRole.LEADER

        validator = LeaderFencingValidator(c_alpha)
        validator.assert_active_leader()
        token = c_alpha.fencing_token
        assert token is not None
        assert token.term == 1

        # 2. Kubernetes Worker Orchestration: Reconcile WorkerPool CRD
        k8s_client = FakeKubernetesClient()
        k8s_provider = KubernetesWorkerProvider(k8s_client)
        k8s_controller = KubernetesWorkerController(k8s_client, k8s_provider)

        crd = {
            "apiVersion": "autodev.io/v1alpha1",
            "kind": "AutoDevWorkerPool",
            "metadata": {"name": "ci-workers", "namespace": "autodev-system"},
            "spec": {
                "replicas": 2,
                "minReplicas": 1,
                "maxReplicas": 10,
                "image": "autodev/worker:v2.4.0",
                "scalingPolicy": {"enabled": True, "queueDepthThreshold": 2, "cooldownSeconds": 0},
            }
        }
        k8s_client.create_custom_resource("autodev.io", "v1alpha1", "autodevworkerpools", crd, "autodev-system")
        rec_res = k8s_controller.reconcile_pool("ci-workers", "autodev-system", queue_depth=6, busy_workers=2)
        assert rec_res.status == "Success"
        assert rec_res.desired_replicas > 2

        # 3. Differential Artifact Synchronization: Sender chunks file, Receiver negotiates & reconstructs
        sender_cas = ArtifactChunkStore(storage_root=str(tmp_path / "sender_cas"))
        receiver_cas = ArtifactChunkStore(storage_root=str(tmp_path / "receiver_cas"))
        chunker = ArtifactChunker(min_size=1024, target_size=2048, max_size=4096)

        sender_tm = ArtifactTransferManager(chunk_store=sender_cas, chunker=chunker)
        receiver_tm = ArtifactTransferManager(chunk_store=receiver_cas, chunker=chunker, staging_dir=str(tmp_path / "staging"))

        src_file = tmp_path / "build_output.tar"
        data_payload = b"TAR-CONTAINER-HEADER\n" + (b"BYTE-STREAM-CHUNK-DIFF-DATA-BLOCK\n" * 200)
        src_file.write_bytes(data_payload)

        manifest, _ = sender_tm.create_manifest_for_file(str(src_file), artifact_id="build-artifact-v1", transaction_id="tx-e2e-01")
        neg = receiver_tm.negotiate_incoming_transfer(manifest)

        # Transmit missing chunks
        for d in neg.missing_chunk_digests:
            chunk_bytes = sender_cas.get_chunk(d)
            receiver_tm.receive_chunk(ChunkTransferMessage.from_bytes(
                artifact_id="build-artifact-v1",
                chunk_digest=d,
                chunk_index=0,
                data=chunk_bytes,
            ))

        assert receiver_tm.is_transfer_ready("build-artifact-v1") is True
        target_reconstructed = tmp_path / "final_build_output.tar"
        ack = receiver_tm.reconstruct_artifact("build-artifact-v1", str(target_reconstructed))
        assert ack.status == "completed"
        assert ack.whole_sha256_verified is True
        assert target_reconstructed.read_bytes() == data_payload

        # 4. Secure Interactive Debugging: Authorize session & route frames
        auth = TerminalAuthorizer(TerminalSecurityPolicy(allowed_principals={"developer"}))
        sess_mgr = InteractiveSessionManager(authorizer=auth)
        gateway = TerminalGateway(session_manager=sess_mgr)

        # Authorized session creation
        create_resp = gateway.handle_client_message(json.dumps({
            "action": "create",
            "principal_id": "developer",
            "transaction_id": "tx-e2e-01",
            "sandbox_id": "sandbox-k8s-pod-01",
            "is_coordinator_host": False,
        }))
        assert create_resp["type"] == "created"
        debug_sid = create_resp["session_id"]

        # Terminal IO
        gateway.handle_client_message(json.dumps({
            "action": "input",
            "session_id": debug_sid,
            "data": "echo Debugging Complete\n"
        }))
        gateway.handle_client_message(json.dumps({
            "action": "terminate",
            "session_id": debug_sid,
        }))

        # 5. Coordinator Failover Simulation: Alpha crashes, Beta takes over
        c_alpha.role = CoordinatorRole.UNAVAILABLE
        c_beta.start_election()
        assert c_beta.role == CoordinatorRole.LEADER
        assert c_beta.current_term == 2
        beta_token = c_beta.fencing_token
        assert beta_token is not None
        assert beta_token.term == 2

        # Verify old leader Alpha cannot make protected mutations
        validator_alpha = LeaderFencingValidator(c_alpha)
        with pytest.raises(Exception):
            validator_alpha.assert_active_leader()

        # Beta reconciles failover
        reconcile_summary = c_beta.reconcile_failover()
        assert reconcile_summary["status"] == "reconciled"
        assert reconcile_summary["current_term"] == 2

"""
Comprehensive End-to-End Integration Test for AutoDev Version 2.5:
- External consensus & leader fencing
- OS/runtime isolation with eBPF security monitoring
- Fleet-scale differential P2P artifact distribution
- WebRTC interactive remote debugging
"""

import os
import sys
import time
import hashlib
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
import pytest

from core.consensus_provider import MemoryConsensusProvider
from core.ha_coordinator import HACoordinator, LeaderFencingValidator
from core.isolation_provider import (
    LocalProcessIsolationProvider,
    PROFILE_STANDARD,
    IsolationPolicy,
)
from core.ebpf_isolation_backend import EBPFIsolationBackend
from core.artifact_chunk_store import ArtifactChunkStore
from core.artifact_sync_protocol import ChunkManifest, ChunkMetadata
from core.artifact_manifest import ArtifactManifest
from core.artifact_peer_registry import ArtifactPeerRegistry
from core.artifact_peer_transport import ArtifactPeerClient
from core.artifact_distribution_planner import ArtifactDistributionPlanner
from core.terminal_transport import WebSocketTerminalTransport
from core.webrtc_terminal_transport import WebRTCTerminalTransport
from core.prompt_builder import PromptBuilder
from core.telemetry_models import TelemetryEvent, TelemetryEventType, TelemetrySeverity


def test_v25_complete_autonomous_lifecycle(tmp_path):
    # =========================================================================
    # 1. Consensus & Leader Election with Authoritative Fencing
    # =========================================================================
    consensus = MemoryConsensusProvider()
    coord = HACoordinator(
        coordinator_id="coord-primary-v25",
        consensus_provider=consensus,
        lease_duration_seconds=10.0,
    )
    coord.start()
    assert coord.is_leader is True

    validator = LeaderFencingValidator(coord)
    token = validator.assert_active_leader("plan_execution")
    assert token.leader_id == "coord-primary-v25"
    assert token.term >= 0
    assert token.fencing_generation >= 1

    # =========================================================================
    # 2. Worker Execution Contract Prompt Synthesis
    # =========================================================================
    prompt_builder = PromptBuilder()
    contract_prompt = prompt_builder.synthesize_worker_execution_contract(
        transaction_id="tx-v25-001",
        task_id="TASK-V25-ORCH",
        worker_id="worker-agent-42",
        runtime_profile="standard",
        authorized_paths=[str(tmp_path / "src"), str(tmp_path / "tests")],
        expected_artifacts=["dist/bundle.js", "reports/test_results.xml"],
        validation_gates=["pytest", "flake8", "manifest_sha256"],
        fencing_term=token.term,
        fencing_generation=token.fencing_generation,
        chunk_sync_enabled=True,
        debug_session_id="dbg-session-99",
        p2p_distribution_enabled=True,
        ebpf_monitoring_active=True,
    )

    assert "DISTRIBUTED WORKER EXECUTION CONTRACT (AutoDev v2.5)" in contract_prompt
    assert "Generation `1`" in contract_prompt or "Generation `" in contract_prompt
    assert "P2P Fleet Artifact Exchange" in contract_prompt

    # =========================================================================
    # 3. Runtime Isolation & eBPF Security Monitoring
    # =========================================================================
    ebpf_backend = EBPFIsolationBackend(simulate_mode=True)
    ebpf_backend.attach_policy_hooks()

    isolation_provider = LocalProcessIsolationProvider(eBPF_backend=ebpf_backend)
    workspace_dir = tmp_path / "workspace"
    workspace_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    sandbox_handle = isolation_provider.create_sandbox(
        workspace_dir=str(workspace_dir),
        profile=PROFILE_STANDARD,
        policy=IsolationPolicy(
            allowed_workspace_paths=[str(workspace_dir)],
            prohibited_commands=["visudo", "reboot"],
        ),
    )
    assert sandbox_handle.is_active is True

    # Execute safe worker command inside sandbox
    exec_result = isolation_provider.execute_in_sandbox(
        handle=sandbox_handle,
        command=[sys.executable, "-c", "print('AutoDev v2.5 Execution Successful')"],
    )
    assert exec_result.exit_code == 0
    assert "AutoDev v2.5 Execution Successful" in exec_result.stdout

    # Record eBPF probe observation
    ebpf_event = ebpf_backend.record_probe_event("process_exec", pid=1001, comm="python", target=sys.executable)
    assert ebpf_event.is_violation is False

    # =========================================================================
    # 4. Peer-to-Peer Artifact Distribution & Differential Verification
    # =========================================================================
    worker_store_dir = tmp_path / "worker_store"
    coordinator_store_dir = tmp_path / "coord_store"
    worker_store = ArtifactChunkStore(storage_root=str(worker_store_dir))
    coord_store = ArtifactChunkStore(storage_root=str(coordinator_store_dir))

    # Produce artifact chunks
    block_a = b"function computeMetrics() { return 42; }\n"
    block_b = b"export default computeMetrics;\n"
    hash_a = hashlib.sha256(block_a).hexdigest()
    hash_b = hashlib.sha256(block_b).hexdigest()

    coord_store.put_chunk(digest=hash_a, data=block_a)
    coord_store.put_chunk(digest=hash_b, data=block_b)

    # Peer registry
    peer_registry = ArtifactPeerRegistry()
    peer_registry.register_peer("peer-node-alpha", endpoint="http://10.20.1.1:8090")
    peer_registry.heartbeat("peer-node-alpha", possessed_chunks=[hash_a, hash_b])

    # Artifact manifest
    manifest = ChunkManifest(
        artifact_id="art-bundle-001",
        whole_sha256=hashlib.sha256(block_a + block_b).hexdigest(),
        total_size_bytes=len(block_a) + len(block_b),
        chunks=[
            ChunkMetadata(digest=hash_a, size_bytes=len(block_a), offset=0, index=0),
            ChunkMetadata(digest=hash_b, size_bytes=len(block_b), offset=len(block_a), index=1),
        ],
    )

    p2p_planner = ArtifactDistributionPlanner(peer_registry=peer_registry)
    plan = p2p_planner.plan_fetch(manifest, worker_store)
    assert plan.missing_chunks_count == 2

    # Execute fetch plan
    def p2p_mock_transport(endpoint: str, digest: str) -> bytes:
        if digest == hash_a:
            return block_a
        elif digest == hash_b:
            return block_b
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown chunk {digest}")

    peer_client = ArtifactPeerClient(chunk_store=worker_store)
    fetch_result = p2p_planner.execute_fetch_plan(
        plan=plan,
        peer_client=peer_client,
        local_chunk_store=worker_store,
        transport_mock=p2p_mock_transport,
    )
    assert fetch_result["success"] is True
    assert fetch_result["p2p_chunks_downloaded"] == 2
    assert worker_store.has_chunk(hash_a) is True
    assert worker_store.has_chunk(hash_b) is True

    # =========================================================================
    # 5. WebRTC Remote Debugging Transport Verification
    # =========================================================================
    webrtc_transport = WebRTCTerminalTransport(
        session_id="dbg-session-99",
        sandbox_id=sandbox_handle.sandbox_id,
        auth_principal="developer-alice",
        is_container_sandbox=True,
    )
    answer = webrtc_transport.process_sdp_offer("v=0\r\no=alice 100 0 IN IP4 0.0.0.0\r\ns=dbg\r\n")
    assert answer["type"] == "answer"

    terminal_logs = []
    webrtc_transport.on_output(lambda msg: terminal_logs.append(msg))
    webrtc_transport.send_output("[v2.5] worker container ready.\n")
    assert "[v2.5] worker container ready.\n" in terminal_logs

    # Clean teardown
    webrtc_transport.close()
    isolation_provider.destroy_sandbox(sandbox_handle)
    coord.stop()

"""
End-to-End acceptance test scenarios for AutoDev v2.6 Self-Healing Engine.
Covers Scenarios A, B, C, D, and E from Section 14.5 of the engineering specification.
"""

import os
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

from core.diagnostic_models import FailureCategory
from core.patch_validator import PatchValidator
from core.repair_models import CandidatePatch, FilePatch, PatchStatus, RepairMode, RepairPolicy, ValidationGateStatus
from core.repair_recovery import RepairJournal, RepairRecoveryManager
from core.repair_transaction import RepairState, RepairTransaction
from core.self_healing_engine import SelfHealingEngine
from core.self_healing_orchestrator import SelfHealingOrchestrator
from core.test_execution_engine import PytestTestRunner, TestExecutionEngine
from core.test_result_models import FailureType, SingleTestResult, TestRunnerType, TestStatus


class TestV26EndToEndScenarios(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scenario_a_successful_repair(self):
        """Scenario A: Successful end-to-end defect repair and verification."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
            # 1. Create project with defect
            math_py = os.path.join(tmpdir, "math_lib.py")
            with open(math_py, "w") as f:
                f.write("def compute_total(items):\n    return sum(items) - 1  # BUG\n")

            test_dir = os.path.join(tmpdir, "tests")
            os.makedirs(test_dir)
            test_math = os.path.join(test_dir, "test_math_lib.py")
            with open(test_math, "w") as f:
                f.write(
                    "import math_lib\n\n"
                    "def test_compute_total():\n"
                    "    assert math_lib.compute_total([10, 20]) == 30\n"
                )

            # 2. Run orchestrator to fix the bug
            orchestrator = SelfHealingOrchestrator(tmpdir)
            fixed_code = "def compute_total(items):\n    return sum(items)\n"

            summary = orchestrator.run_self_healing_workflow(
                failing_test_id="tests/test_math_lib.py",
                file_modifications={"math_lib.py": fixed_code},
            )

            # 3. Assertions
            self.assertTrue(summary.success)
            self.assertEqual(summary.final_state, RepairState.ACCEPTED.value)
            self.assertEqual(summary.validation_gates.get("gate_1_patch_validation"), ValidationGateStatus.PASSED.value)
            self.assertEqual(summary.validation_gates.get("gate_2_syntax_check"), ValidationGateStatus.PASSED.value)
            self.assertEqual(summary.validation_gates.get("gate_3_primary_test"), ValidationGateStatus.PASSED.value)

            with open(math_py, "r") as f:
                self.assertEqual(f.read(), fixed_code)

    def test_scenario_b_repair_rejected_and_rolled_back(self):
        """Scenario B: Candidate patch fails validation gate -> rollback to baseline."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
            math_py = os.path.join(tmpdir, "math_lib.py")
            orig_code = "def compute_total(items):\n    return sum(items) - 5\n"
            with open(math_py, "w") as f:
                f.write(orig_code)

            test_dir = os.path.join(tmpdir, "tests")
            os.makedirs(test_dir)
            test_math = os.path.join(test_dir, "test_math_lib.py")
            with open(test_math, "w") as f:
                f.write(
                    "import math_lib\n\n"
                    "def test_compute_total():\n"
                    "    assert math_lib.compute_total([10, 20]) == 30\n"
                )

            orchestrator = SelfHealingOrchestrator(tmpdir)
            # Candidate patch is also broken
            bad_fixed_code = "def compute_total(items):\n    return sum(items) + 999\n"

            summary = orchestrator.run_self_healing_workflow(
                failing_test_id="tests/test_math_lib.py",
                file_modifications={"math_lib.py": bad_fixed_code},
            )

            self.assertFalse(summary.success)
            self.assertEqual(summary.final_state, RepairState.ROLLED_BACK.value)
            self.assertTrue(summary.rollback_performed)

            # Verify file content is strictly restored to original code
            with open(math_py, "r") as f:
                self.assertEqual(f.read(), orig_code)

    def test_scenario_c_ambiguous_environmental_failure(self):
        """Scenario C: Environmental failure stops without code changes."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
            src_file = os.path.join(tmpdir, "db.py")
            orig_content = "# Database connection logic\n"
            with open(src_file, "w") as f:
                f.write(orig_content)

            orchestrator = SelfHealingOrchestrator(tmpdir)
            test_res = SingleTestResult(
                test_id="test_db_connect",
                test_name="test_db_connect",
                status=TestStatus.FAILED,
                failure_type=FailureType.NETWORK_DEPENDENCY_FAILURE,
                message="psycopg2.OperationalError: could not connect to server: Connection refused",
            )

            summary = orchestrator.run_self_healing_workflow(initial_test_result=test_res)
            self.assertFalse(summary.success)
            self.assertEqual(summary.final_state, RepairState.REJECTED.value)

            with open(src_file, "r") as f:
                self.assertEqual(f.read(), orig_content)

    def test_scenario_d_security_violation_rejection(self):
        """Scenario D: Patch attempting path traversal or test weakening is rejected."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
            validator = PatchValidator(tmpdir, RepairPolicy())
            # Malicious patch removing assertions from test
            fp = FilePatch(
                file_path="tests/test_auth.py",
                original_content="def test_auth(): assert check_token() is True\n",
                new_content="def test_auth(): pass\n",
            )
            patch = CandidatePatch(file_patches=[fp])
            val_res = validator.validate(patch)

            self.assertFalse(val_res.is_valid)
            self.assertFalse(val_res.anti_weakening_ok)

    def test_scenario_e_interrupted_recovery(self):
        """Scenario E: Crash recovery safely reconciles interrupted transactions on startup."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
            src_file = os.path.join(tmpdir, "module.py")
            orig_code = "INITIAL_STATE = 1\n"
            with open(src_file, "w") as f:
                f.write(orig_code)

            journal_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, "repair_journal.jsonl")
            journal = RepairJournal(journal_path)

            # Record interrupted transaction
            tx = RepairTransaction(
                repair_id="rep_interrupted_99",
                state=RepairState.VERIFYING,
                file_snapshots={"module.py": orig_code},
            )
            journal.append_entry(tx)

            # Mutate file to dirty candidate state
            with open(src_file, "w") as f:
                f.write("INITIAL_STATE = 999_DIRTY\n")

            # Initialize orchestrator which triggers startup recovery
            orchestrator = SelfHealingOrchestrator(tmpdir, journal_path=journal_path)

            # Verify file was rolled back to initial state safely
            with open(src_file, "r") as f:
                self.assertEqual(f.read(), orig_code)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""
tests/test_v27_edge_cases.py - Deep Edge Cases and Resilience Tests for AutoDev v2.7

import pytest
from core.complexity_analyzer import ComplexityAnalyzer

def test_empty_workspace_assessment(tmp_path):
    """Assessing an empty workspace yields zero technical debt and clean scores."""

    result = engine.assess_workspace(files_content={})

    assert result.analyzed_files_count == 0

def test_deeply_nested_comprehension():
    """Analyzer computes nested comprehension complexity without crashing."""
    code = """
def nested_comp(data):
    return [
        x * y * z
        for sublist in data
        if sublist is not None
        for x in sublist
        if x > 0
        for y in range(x)
        if y % 2 == 0
        for z in [y, y + 1]
    ]
"""
    analyzer = ComplexityAnalyzer()
    metrics = analyzer.analyze_source(code)
    assert metrics.cyclomatic_complexity >= 4
    assert metrics.cognitive_complexity >= 4


def test_god_object_with_disjoint_lcom4():
    """Class with disconnected method clusters gets flagged for high LCOM4."""

    code = """
class MultiConcernService:

        self.auth_token = "abc"
        self.db_conn = "sql"

"""

def test_strict_quality_gate_mode():

def test_extreme_duplication_workspace(tmp_path):
    """Workspace with 100% duplicate modules is caught with high duplication density."""

def process_data_block(items):

def test_multi_level_diamond_inheritance():

    code = """
class BaseRoot:
    pass

class LeftBranch(BaseRoot):
    pass

def test_memory_manager_no_match_graceful(tmp_path):

def test_multi_risk_convergence_and_bounding():
    """Predictor bounds all composite risk scores between 0.0 and 1.0 (or 0-100)."""
    predictor = RiskPredictor()
    worst_complexity = ComplexityMetrics(
        cyclomatic_complexity=150,
        cognitive_complexity=200,
        max_nesting_depth=12,
        longest_call_chain=15,
        maintainability_index=5.0,
    )
    worst_dep_health = DependencyHealthMetrics(
        instability=1.0,
        has_circular_dependencies=True,
        is_god_object=True,
    )
    critical_issues = [
        QualityIssue(
            rule_id="SEC-001",
            category=QualityRiskCategory.SECURITY_VULNERABILITY,
            severity=QualitySeverity.CRITICAL,
        ),
        QualityIssue(
            rule_id="RACE-001",
            category=QualityRiskCategory.THREAD_SAFETY_RACE,
            severity=QualitySeverity.HIGH,
        ),
    ]

    scores = predictor.predict_risks(
        complexity=worst_complexity,
        dependency_health=worst_dep_health,
        issues=critical_issues,
        duplication_count=20,
        historical_defects_count=5,
    )

    assert 0.0 <= scores.regression_probability <= 1.0
    assert 0.0 <= scores.overall_risk_score <= 1.0
    assert 0.0 <= scores.composite_risk_score <= 100.0
    assert scores.security_confidence <= 0.35
    assert scores.concurrency_race_risk > 0.50


def test_heatmap_generation_nested_hierarchy(tmp_path):
    """Engine computes risk heatmap across multi-directory trees."""
    engine = PredictiveQualityEngine(workspace_path=str(tmp_path))
    files = {
        "core/engine.py": "def heavy_work():\n" + "    if True:\n" * 5 + "        return 1\n",
        "utils/helpers.py": "def quick(): return 42\n",
        "api/v1/endpoints.py": "def endpoint(): return 'ok'\n",
    }
    result = engine.assess_workspace(files_content=files)
    assert len(result.heatmap_data) == 3
    # engine.py has higher complexity, thus higher risk weight
    assert result.heatmap_data["core/engine.py"] >= result.heatmap_data["utils/helpers.py"]


def test_quality_gate_policy_serialization_roundtrip():
    """QualityGatePolicy serializes to dict/JSON and deserializes correctly."""
    policy = QualityGatePolicy(
        max_cyclomatic_complexity=12,
        min_maintainability_index=55.0,
        allow_circular_dependencies=False,
    )
    data = policy.to_dict()
    assert data["max_cyclomatic_complexity"] == 12
    assert data["min_maintainability_index"] == 55.0
    assert data["disallow_circular_dependencies"] is True

    json_str = json.dumps(data)
    loaded_data = json.loads(json_str)
    recreated_policy = QualityGatePolicy(**{k: v for k, v in loaded_data.items() if k != "allow_circular_dependencies"})
    assert recreated_policy.max_cyclomatic_complexity == 12
    assert recreated_policy.min_maintainability_index == 55.0

"""
tests/test_v27_integration_scale.py - Large-Scale & End-to-End Integration Tests for AutoDev v2.7

Validates:
- High symbol count scalability (10,000+ symbols across 250+ synthetic modules)
- Incremental caching latency reduction (10x+ speedup on warm cache)
- End-to-end integration: RequirementPlanner -> PredictiveQualityEngine -> PromptBuilder -> Orchestrator
- Quality gate rejection and prompt injection in real workflows
"""

import time
import pytest
from core.complexity_analyzer import ComplexityAnalyzer
from core.dependency_health import DependencyHealthAnalyzer
from core.predictive_quality_engine import PredictiveQualityEngine
from core.prompt_builder import PromptBuilder

    QualityGateStatus,

def test_large_scale_repository_analysis(tmp_path):
    """Evaluates predictive quality analysis on a 250-module repository with thousands of functions."""
    files = {}
    total_funcs = 0

    for m in range(250):
        lines = [f"# Module {m}"]
        for f in range(40):
            lines.append(f"""
def func_{m}_{f}(param_a, param_b):
    if param_a > param_b:
        return param_a * {f}
    return param_b + {m}
""")
            total_funcs += 1
        files[f"pkg/module_{m}.py"] = "\n".join(lines)

    assert total_funcs == 10000

    engine = PredictiveQualityEngine(workspace_path=str(tmp_path))

    # Measure cold run
    start_cold = time.perf_counter()
    res_cold = engine.assess_workspace(files_content=files)
    cold_duration = time.perf_counter() - start_cold

    assert res_cold.aggregate_complexity.cyclomatic_complexity >= 2
    assert res_cold.aggregate_complexity.sloc > 20000

    # Measure warm run (incremental cache)
    start_warm = time.perf_counter()
    res_warm = engine.assess_workspace(files_content=files)
    warm_duration = time.perf_counter() - start_warm

    # Warm run should be significantly faster due to SHA-256 caching
    assert warm_duration <= cold_duration
    assert res_cold.aggregate_complexity.sloc == res_warm.aggregate_complexity.sloc

"""
test_v34_comprehensive_matrix.py - AutoDev Version 3.4
Additional comprehensive test suite verifying:
- Department task priority sorting and dependency graphs
- Decision Engine tie-breaking under equal authority weights
- Conflict Resolver multi-party edge cases and escalation paths
- Communication Bus thread correlation and response timeouts
- Meeting minutes action item lifecycle (PENDING -> IN_PROGRESS -> COMPLETED)
- Metric sensitivity under varying lead times and defect ratios
- CEO, CTO, and Executive governance edge cases
"""

import pytest
import time
from pathlib import Path
from core.communication_bus import CommunicationBus, MessagePriority, OrgMessage, OrgMessageType
from core.conflict_resolver import ConflictResolver, ConflictType, ConflictStatus
from core.decision_engine import DecisionDomain, DecisionEngine

from core.organization import EnterpriseOrganization
from core.organization_metrics import OrganizationMetricsCalculator

# 1. Department Task Priority & Dependency Tests
@pytest.mark.parametrize("priority_val", [1, 2, 3, 4, 5])
def test_department_task_priority_levels(priority_val):
    dept = Department("Backend", DepartmentRole.BACKEND)
    task = dept.assign_task(f"T-PRIO-{priority_val}", "Title", "Desc", "EM", priority=priority_val)
    assert task.priority == priority_val


def test_department_dependencies_tracking():
    dept = Department(
        name="Backend",
        role=DepartmentRole.BACKEND,
        dependencies=["Architecture", "ProductManager"],
    )
    assert "Architecture" in dept.dependencies
    assert "ProductManager" in dept.dependencies
    rep = dept.get_status_report()
    assert len(rep["dependencies"]) == 2


def test_department_budget_boundary():
    dept = Department("QA", DepartmentRole.QA, budget=1000.0)
    # Exactly spend budget
    assert dept.spend_budget(1000.0) is True
    assert dept.spent_budget == 1000.0
    # Over budget by $1
    assert dept.spend_budget(1.0) is False


def test_department_multiple_block_reasons():
    dept = Department("Frontend", DepartmentRole.FRONTEND)
    t1 = dept.assign_task("T-1", "T1", "D", "EM")
    dept.block_task("T-1", reason="Waiting for Figma design")
    rep = dept.get_status_report()
    assert rep["blocked_task_reasons"]["T-1"] == "Waiting for Figma design"


# 2. Decision Engine Multi-Option & Tie-Breaking Tests
@pytest.mark.parametrize("option_count", [2, 3, 4, 5])
def test_decision_engine_n_options(option_count, tmp_path):
    state = OrganizationState(storage_dir=tmp_path / f"dec_{option_count}", auto_persist=False)
    engine = DecisionEngine(state=state)
    options = [f"Option_{i}" for i in range(option_count)]

    pid = engine.create_proposal("Choice", DecisionDomain.ARCHITECTURE_CHOICE, options, "Arch")
    # Cast vote for the last option
    engine.cast_vote(pid, "CTO", options[-1], confidence=0.99)
    res = engine.evaluate_decision(pid)
    assert res["winning_option"] == options[-1]


def test_decision_engine_equal_votes_tie_break(tmp_path):
    state = OrganizationState(storage_dir=tmp_path / "dec_tie", auto_persist=False)
    engine = DecisionEngine(state=state)

    pid = engine.create_proposal("Tie Choice", DecisionDomain.PRIORITY, ["A", "B"], "EM")
    # Equal weight votes
    engine.cast_vote(pid, "Voter1", "A", confidence=0.8, custom_weight=2.0)
    engine.cast_vote(pid, "Voter2", "B", confidence=0.8, custom_weight=2.0)

    res = engine.evaluate_decision(pid)
    # Must deterministically select one without crashing
    assert res["winning_option"] in ("A", "B")
    assert res["status"] == "RESOLVED"


# 3. Conflict Resolver Complex Chains
def test_conflict_resolver_same_authority_tie():
    resolver = ConflictResolver()
    # Backend (35) and Frontend (35) have identical authority precedence!
    rec = resolver.register_conflict(
        conflict_type=ConflictType.OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT,
        parties_involved=["Backend", "Frontend"],
        description="Who owns GraphQL schema definition",
        competing_proposals={"Backend": "BE", "Frontend": "FE"},
    )
    resolved = resolver.resolve_conflict(rec.conflict_id)
    assert resolved.status == ConflictStatus.AUTO_RESOLVED
    assert resolved.resolution_strategy == "AUTHORITY_PRECEDENCE"


def test_conflict_resolver_priority_fallback():
    resolver = ConflictResolver()
    rec = resolver.register_conflict(
        conflict_type=ConflictType.RESOURCE_CONFLICT,
        parties_involved=["QA", "DevOps"],
        description="Shared runner contention",
        competing_proposals={"QA": {"priority": 3}, "DevOps": {"priority": 3}},
    )
    resolved = resolver.resolve_conflict(rec.conflict_id)
    assert resolved.status == ConflictStatus.AUTO_RESOLVED


# 4. Communication Bus In-Depth Queries
def test_bus_query_limit():
    bus = CommunicationBus()
    for i in range(20):
        bus.send_message(OrgMessage(sender="A", receiver="B", payload={"i": i}))

    res_10 = bus.query_messages(limit=10)
    assert len(res_10) == 10

    res_5 = bus.query_messages(limit=5)
    assert len(res_5) == 5


def test_bus_empty_receiver_handling():
    bus = CommunicationBus()
    # Query non-existent department
    msgs = bus.get_messages("NonExistentDepartment")
    assert msgs == []


def test_bus_multiple_threads():
    bus = CommunicationBus()
    bus.send_message(OrgMessage(sender="A", receiver="B", thread_id="T1", payload={"msg": 1}))
    bus.send_message(OrgMessage(sender="A", receiver="B", thread_id="T2", payload={"msg": 2}))

    t1_hist = bus.get_thread_history("T1")
    t2_hist = bus.get_thread_history("T2")
    assert len(t1_hist) == 1
    assert len(t2_hist) == 1
    assert t1_hist[0].payload["msg"] == 1
    assert t2_hist[0].payload["msg"] == 2


# 5. Meeting Action Item State Progression
def test_meeting_action_item_model():
    state = OrganizationState(auto_persist=False)
    mm = MeetingManager(state=state)
    m = mm.schedule_and_conduct_meeting(MeetingType.DAILY_STANDUP, "Standup", "EM", ["BE"])

    assert len(m.action_items) >= 1
    item = m.action_items[0]
    assert item.status == "PENDING"

    # Mutate to completed
    item.status = "COMPLETED"
    d = item.to_dict()
    assert d["status"] == "COMPLETED"


# 6. Metric Calculator Extreme Value Sensitivities
@pytest.mark.parametrize("incidents,debt,expected_max_arch", [
    (0, 0, 100.0),
    (1, 2, 85.0),
    (3, 5, 59.0),
    (5, 10, 25.0),

    calc = OrganizationMetricsCalculator()
    dash = calc.calculate_dashboard(
        departments={},
        incidents_count=incidents,
        technical_debt_items=debt,
    )
    assert dash.architecture_health_score <= expected_max_arch


@pytest.mark.parametrize("cves,findings,expected_max_sec", [
    (0, 0, 100.0),
    (1, 0, 75.0),
    (2, 2, 45.0),

def test_metric_security_score_sensitivity(cves, findings, expected_max_sec):
    calc = OrganizationMetricsCalculator()
    dash = calc.calculate_dashboard(
        departments={},
        critical_cves_count=cves,
        security_findings_count=findings,
    )
    assert dash.security_score <= expected_max_sec


# 7. Enterprise Organization Department Lookups
@pytest.mark.parametrize("dept_name", [
    "CEO", "CTO", "EngineeringManager", "Architecture", "Backend",
    "Frontend", "QA", "Security", "DevOps", "ReleaseManager",

    org = EnterpriseOrganization(auto_persist=False)
    d = org.get_department(dept_name)
    assert d is not None

@pytest.mark.parametrize("agent_name", [
    "CEO", "CTO", "EngineeringManager", "Architecture", "Backend",

"""
test_v34_deep_enterprise_scenarios.py - AutoDev Version 3.4
Enterprise lifecycle, real-world corporate scenarios, and end-to-end integration tests:
- Feature intake to release train
- Security vulnerability remediation & release blocking
- Resource starvation & automated workload rebalancing
- Architectural divergence & ADR enforcement
- Blameless incident postmortem & SLA restoration
- Financial budget reallocation & variance audits
- Regulatory compliance certification & audit proof
- Customer feedback loop & CSAT roadmap generation
"""

from pathlib import Path
import pytest
import time
from core.communication_bus import CommunicationBus, MessagePriority, OrgMessage, OrgMessageType
from core.conflict_resolver import ConflictResolver, ConflictType
from core.decision_engine import DecisionDomain, DecisionEngine
from core.department import Department, DepartmentAuthorityLevel, DepartmentRole
from core.meeting_manager import MeetingManager, MeetingType
from core.organization import EnterpriseOrganization
from core.organization_metrics import OrganizationMetricsCalculator
from core.organization_state import OrganizationState
from agents.ceo_agent import CEOAgent
from agents.cto_agent import CTOAgent
from agents.security_manager import SecurityManagerAgent
from agents.qa_manager import QAManagerAgent
from agents.devops_manager import DevOpsManagerAgent
from agents.release_manager import ReleaseManagerAgent
from agents.finance_manager import FinanceManagerAgent
from agents.compliance_manager import ComplianceManagerAgent
from agents.operations_manager import OperationsManagerAgent


@pytest.fixture
def enterprise_org(tmp_path: Path):
    return EnterpriseOrganization(
        company_name="Apex Software Technologies",
        storage_dir=tmp_path / "enterprise_scenarios",
        initial_budget_usd=1000000.0,
        auto_persist=False,
    )


# Scenario 1: Security finding blocks release until remediation verified
def test_scenario_security_blocks_release(enterprise_org: EnterpriseOrganization):
    sec = enterprise_org.get_agent("Security")
    rel = enterprise_org.get_agent("ReleaseManager")

    # Security audits code containing dangerous eval()
    audit_res = sec.audit_code_security(["result = eval(untrusted_payload)"])
    assert audit_res["security_gate_status"] == "BLOCKED"
    assert audit_res["vulnerabilities_found"] == 1

    # Release manager evaluates readiness -> must be NO_GO
    readiness = rel.evaluate_release_readiness(
        qa_gate_passed=True,
        security_score=audit_res["security_score"],
        docs_complete=True,
    )
    assert readiness["decision"] == "NO_GO"

    # Remediation applied: remove eval()
    clean_audit = sec.audit_code_security(["result = json.loads(untrusted_payload)"])
    assert clean_audit["security_gate_status"] == "APPROVED"

    # Now release is approved -> GO
    readiness_post = rel.evaluate_release_readiness(
        qa_gate_passed=True,
        security_score=clean_audit["security_score"],
        docs_complete=True,
    )
    assert readiness_post["decision"] == "GO"


# Scenario 2: Resource starvation triggers workload rebalancing
def test_scenario_workload_rebalancing(enterprise_org: EnterpriseOrganization):
    em = enterprise_org.get_agent("EngineeringManager")
    be = enterprise_org.get_department("Backend")
    fe = enterprise_org.get_department("Frontend")

    # Backend capacity is 20; fill it with 22 tasks -> overload!
    for i in range(22):
        be.assign_task(f"T-BE-{i}", f"Task {i}", "Desc", "EM")

    reports = {
        "Backend": be.get_status_report(),
        "Frontend": fe.get_status_report(),
    }
    balance = em.balance_workloads(reports)
    assert "Backend" in balance["overloaded_teams"]
    assert len(balance["rebalance_actions"]) > 0


# Scenario 3: Architectural dispute escalated to CTO
def test_scenario_architecture_dispute_resolved_by_cto(enterprise_org: EnterpriseOrganization):
    cto = enterprise_org.get_agent("CTO")
    dispute = cto.adjudicate_technical_dispute(
        dispute_topic="State Store",
        proposal_a={"name": "In-Memory Dictionary with Mutex", "testability_score": 95.0, "external_deps": []},
        proposal_b={"name": "Redis External Cluster", "testability_score": 75.0, "external_deps": ["RedisLib"]},
    )
    assert dispute["winning_proposal"] == "Proposal A"
    assert "In-Memory" in dispute["details"]["name"]


# Scenario 4: Production SEV-1 Incident triage to blameless postmortem
def test_scenario_incident_to_postmortem(enterprise_org: EnterpriseOrganization):
    ops = enterprise_org.get_agent("Operations")

    # 1. Incident triggered
    inc = ops.handle_incident(
        incident_title="Memory leak in worker pool",
        severity="SEV-1",
        affected_service="WorkerFleet",
        root_cause_hypothesis="Circular references in task objects",
    )
    assert inc["status"] == "TRIAGED"
    assert len(ops.active_incidents) == 1

    # 2. Postmortem conducted
    pm = ops.conduct_postmortem(
        incident_id=inc["incident_id"],
        timeline=["Detection: 00:00", "Mitigated: 00:05", "Resolved: 00:15"],
        root_cause="Circular references preventing garbage collection",
        preventive_actions=["Break reference cycle via weakref", "Add automated memory regression test"],
    )
    assert len(pm["five_whys"]) == 5
    assert len(ops.active_incidents) == 0


# Scenario 5: Financial budget variance audit
def test_scenario_financial_budget_variance(enterprise_org: EnterpriseOrganization):
    fin = enterprise_org.get_agent("Finance")

    dept_reports = {
        "Backend": {"budget_spent": 35000.0},
        "Frontend": {"budget_spent": 20000.0},
        "QA": {"budget_spent": 15000.0},
    }
    burn = fin.calculate_monthly_burn(dept_reports)
    assert burn["total_monthly_burn_usd"] == 70000.0

    rep = fin.generate_financial_report(total_spent=70000.0, total_budget=100000.0)
    assert rep["financial_health"] == "ON_BUDGET"
    assert rep["remaining_budget_usd"] == 30000.0


# Scenario 6: Regulatory compliance certification
def test_scenario_compliance_certification(enterprise_org: EnterpriseOrganization):
    comp = enterprise_org.get_agent("Compliance")

    audit = comp.audit_compliance({"data_retention_policy_active": True})
    assert audit["compliant"] is True

    cert = comp.generate_compliance_certificate()
    assert cert["status"] == "ATTESTED"
    assert "SOC2_TYPE_II" in cert["frameworks"]


# Scenario 7: Customer feedback loop into product backlog
def test_scenario_customer_feedback_loop(enterprise_org: EnterpriseOrganization):
    cf = enterprise_org.get_agent("CustomerFeedback")
    pm = enterprise_org.get_agent("ProductManager")

    cf.ingest_feedback({"csat_score": 90.0, "feedback": "Fast API response"})
    cf.ingest_feedback({"csat_score": 70.0, "feedback": "Add batch upload capability"})

    recs = cf.export_recommendations_to_pm()
    assert len(recs["top_pain_points"]) >= 1

    features = [
        {"title": "Batch Upload Feature", "reach": 15.0, "impact": 4.0, "confidence": 0.85, "effort_days": 3.0},
    ]
    ranked = pm.prioritize_backlog(features)
    assert ranked[0]["title"] == "Batch Upload Feature"


# Scenario 8: High-frequency message thread interaction
def test_scenario_multi_message_thread_flow(enterprise_org: EnterpriseOrganization):
    bus = enterprise_org.bus

    thread_id = "THREAD-COLLAB-99"
    m1 = OrgMessage(sender="BA", receiver="PM", thread_id=thread_id, payload={"step": "story_ready"})
    m2 = OrgMessage(sender="PM", receiver="Arch", thread_id=thread_id, payload={"step": "design_ready"})
    m3 = OrgMessage(sender="Arch", receiver="Backend", thread_id=thread_id, payload={"step": "adr_ratified"})

    bus.send_message(m1)
    bus.send_message(m2)
    bus.send_message(m3)

    history = bus.get_thread_history(thread_id)
    assert len(history) == 3
    assert [m.payload["step"] for m in history] == ["story_ready", "design_ready", "adr_ratified"]


# Scenario 9: Full meeting cycle with minutes verification
def test_scenario_meeting_cycle(enterprise_org: EnterpriseOrganization):
    standup = enterprise_org.conduct_corporate_meeting(MeetingType.DAILY_STANDUP)
    assert standup["meeting_type"] == "DAILY_STANDUP"
    assert len(standup["decisions_ratified"]) >= 1

    release_mtg = enterprise_org.conduct_corporate_meeting(MeetingType.RELEASE_MEETING)
    assert release_mtg["meeting_type"] == "RELEASE_MEETING"
    assert len(release_mtg["decisions_ratified"]) >= 1


# Scenario 10: Organization metrics dashboard reflection
def test_scenario_metrics_dashboard_reflection(enterprise_org: EnterpriseOrganization):
    dash = enterprise_org.get_organization_dashboard()
    assert dash["architecture_health_score"] >= 80.0
    assert dash["security_score"] >= 90.0
    assert dash["delivery_confidence"] > 0.80
    assert "summary" in dash

"""
test_v34_stress_and_edge_cases.py - AutoDev Version 3.4
Stress, concurrency, robustness, and edge-case testing for Autonomous AI Organization:
- Multi-threaded concurrent message dispatch on CommunicationBus
- High-concurrency task processing and capacity saturation in Departments
- Rapid multi-proposal voting in Decision Engine
- Complex conflict resolution chains and fallback escalation paths
- Simultaneous meeting executions
- Cryptographic hash chain validation under rapid sequential events
- Edge cases: empty payloads, extreme budgets, zero capacities, unknown entities
"""

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
import time
from core.communication_bus import (
    CommunicationBus,
    MessagePriority,
    OrgMessage,
    OrgMessageType,
)
from core.conflict_resolver import ConflictResolver, ConflictType
from core.decision_engine import DecisionDomain, DecisionEngine
from core.department import Department, DepartmentAuthorityLevel, DepartmentRole
from core.meeting_manager import MeetingManager, MeetingType
from core.organization import EnterpriseOrganization
from core.organization_state import OrganizationState


def test_concurrent_message_bus_dispatch():
    bus = CommunicationBus()
    for i in range(10):
        bus.register_entity(f"Dept_{i}")

    def sender_worker(sender_id: int):
        for j in range(25):
            msg = OrgMessage(
                sender=f"Dept_{sender_id}",
                receiver=f"Dept_{(sender_id + 1) % 10}",
                priority=MessagePriority.NORMAL,
                payload={"iter": j},
            )
            bus.send_message(msg)

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=5) as executor:
        futures = [executor.submit(sender_worker, i) for i in range(5)]
        for f in futures:
            f.result()

    telemetry = bus.get_bus_telemetry()
    assert telemetry["total_messages_exchanged"] == 125
    assert bus.clear() is None
    assert bus.get_bus_telemetry()["total_messages_exchanged"] == 0


def test_concurrent_department_task_saturation():
    dept = Department("HeavyBackend", DepartmentRole.BACKEND, capacity=10)

    def worker_assign(tid: int):
        return dept.assign_task(f"TASK-{tid}", f"Title {tid}", "Desc", "EM")

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as executor:
        tasks = list(executor.map(worker_assign, range(20)))

    assert len(tasks) == 20
    # Exactly 10 active tasks and 10 blocked tasks
    assert len(dept.active_tasks) == 10
    assert len(dept.blocked_tasks) == 10
    assert dept.health_score < 50.0

    # Rapid completion of all active tasks
    for i in range(10):
        dept.complete_task(f"TASK-{i}")

    # The 10 blocked tasks should have been unblocked!
    assert len(dept.active_tasks) == 10
    assert len(dept.blocked_tasks) == 0


def test_decision_engine_high_volume_proposals(tmp_path: Path):
    state = OrganizationState(storage_dir=tmp_path / "dec_stress", auto_persist=False)
    engine = DecisionEngine(state=state)

    for i in range(15):
        pid = engine.create_proposal(
            title=f"Proposal {i}",
            domain=DecisionDomain.PRIORITY,
            options=["High", "Low"],
            proposer="ProductManager",
        )
        engine.cast_vote(pid, "CTO", "High", 0.95)
        engine.cast_vote(pid, "Backend", "High" if i % 2 == 0 else "Low", 0.8)
        res = engine.evaluate_decision(pid)
        assert res["winning_option"] == "High"


def test_conflict_resolver_all_seven_types():
    resolver = ConflictResolver()
    conflict_types = [
        ConflictType.RESOURCE_CONFLICT,
        ConflictType.TASK_CONFLICT,
        ConflictType.ARCHITECTURE_CONFLICT,
        ConflictType.MERGE_CONFLICT,
        ConflictType.PRIORITY_CONFLICT,
        ConflictType.OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT,

    ]

    for ct in conflict_types:
        rec = resolver.register_conflict(
            conflict_type=ct,
            parties_involved=["Backend", "QA"],
            description=f"Dispute of type {ct.value}",
            competing_proposals={"Backend": "Option 1", "QA": "Option 2"},
        )
        res = resolver.resolve_conflict(rec.conflict_id)
        assert res.status.value in ("AUTO_RESOLVED", "ESCALATED")


def test_rapid_audit_trail_tamper_detection(tmp_path: Path):
    state = OrganizationState(storage_dir=tmp_path / "audit_stress", auto_persist=False)

    for i in range(50):
        state.record_audit_event(
            actor=f"Agent_{i%5}",
            action=f"ACTION_{i}",
            details={"index": i, "timestamp": time.time()},
        )

    assert len(state.audit_trail) == 50
    assert state.verify_audit_trail_integrity() is True

    # Tamper with the 25th event
    state.audit_trail[25]["details"]["index"] = 9999
    assert state.verify_audit_trail_integrity() is False


def test_simultaneous_all_meetings_and_action_item_tracking(tmp_path: Path):
    state = OrganizationState(storage_dir=tmp_path / "meet_stress", auto_persist=False)
    bus = CommunicationBus()
    mm = MeetingManager(bus=bus, state=state)

    meeting_types = [
        MeetingType.DAILY_STANDUP,
        MeetingType.SPRINT_PLANNING,
        MeetingType.SPRINT_REVIEW,
        MeetingType.ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW,
        MeetingType.INCIDENT_REVIEW,
        MeetingType.SECURITY_REVIEW,
        MeetingType.RELEASE_MEETING,
        MeetingType.EXECUTIVE_REVIEW,
        MeetingType.RETROSPECTIVE,
    ]

    minutes_list = []
    for mt in meeting_types:
        m = mm.schedule_and_conduct_meeting(
            meeting_type=mt,
            title=f"{mt.value} Test Session",
            host="HostAgent",
            attendees=["Backend", "Frontend", "QA"],

"""
test_v35_deep_federation_scenarios.py - Deep Multi-Company Federation Scenario Tests (AutoDev Version 3.5)
"""

import time
import pytest

from core.cross_company_scheduler import CrossCompanyScheduler
from core.enterprise_disaster_recovery import EnterpriseDisasterRecovery, OutageType
from core.enterprise_federation import EnterpriseFederation
from core.enterprise_governance import EnterpriseGovernanceManager
from core.enterprise_knowledge import EnterpriseKnowledgeGraph, KnowledgeCategory, RelationshipType
from core.enterprise_policy_engine import EnterprisePolicyEngine, PolicyAction, PolicyDomain, PolicyScope
from core.enterprise_registry import EnterpriseRegistry, OrganizationStatus
from core.enterprise_router import EnterpriseRouter, RoutingRule
from core.enterprise_security import EnterpriseSecurityManager

    FederationMessage,

    InterCompanyBus,

)
from core.portfolio_manager import PortfolioManager, PortfolioProject, ProjectStatus
from core.resource_marketplace import ResourceMarketplace, ResourceType


def test_scenario_1_multi_company_knowledge_propagation_cascade():
    """AI Research publishes discovery -> 3 companies adopt and link via knowledge graph."""
    fed = EnterpriseFederation()

    # Step 1: AI Research node
    res_node = fed.knowledge_graph.add_knowledge_node(
        category=KnowledgeCategory.RESEARCH,
        title="Zero-Allocation Tensor Parsing",
        content="Parsing tensors without heap fragmentation",
        company_id="COMP-C-AI",
        author="Research Lead",
    )

    # Step 2: Three adopting companies create ADRs
    adopters = ["COMP-A-BACKEND", "COMP-B-FRONTEND", "COMP-E-CLOUD"]
    for adopter in adopters:
        adr_node = fed.knowledge_graph.add_knowledge_node(
            category=KnowledgeCategory.ADR,
            title=f"Adopt Tensor Parsing in {adopter}",
            content="Adopting parsing technique",
            company_id=adopter,
            author="Architect",
        )
        fed.knowledge_graph.link_nodes(adr_node.node_id, res_node.node_id, RelationshipType.IMPLEMENTS)
        fed.knowledge_graph.record_reuse(res_node.node_id)

    assert res_node.reuse_count == 3
    analytics = fed.knowledge_graph.get_knowledge_analytics()
    assert analytics["total_reuses"] == 3


def test_scenario_2_cascading_disaster_recovery_with_rerouting():
    """Company failure triggers automated recovery, heartbeat alert, and router fallback."""
    fed = EnterpriseFederation()

    # Register alternate capability
    fed.registry.add_capability("COMP-A-BACKEND", "ComputeService", "COMPUTE", "Compute service")
    fed.registry.add_capability("COMP-E-CLOUD", "ComputeService", "COMPUTE", "Backup compute service")

    # Mark COMP-A-BACKEND as degraded/offline
    fed.registry.update_company_status("COMP-A-BACKEND", OrganizationStatus.OFFLINE)

    # Message directed to A is automatically rerouted to E
    msg = FederationMessage(
        company_id="COMP-B-FRONTEND",
        target_company_id="COMP-A-BACKEND",
        payload={"required_capability": "ComputeService", "task": "RenderMesh"},
    )
    assert fed.router.route_message(msg) is True
    assert msg.target_company_id == "COMP-E-CLOUD"

    # DR recovers COMP-A-BACKEND
    rec_event = fed.disaster_recovery.recover_company_outage("COMP-A-BACKEND")
    assert rec_event.recovered_successfully is True
    fed.registry.update_company_status("COMP-A-BACKEND", OrganizationStatus.ACTIVE)


def test_scenario_3_cross_company_resource_arbitrage():
    """Company A sells excess engineering hours to Company B and Company C via market."""
    mkt = ResourceMarketplace()

    # Company A has 100 hours at $100/hr
    ask = mkt.place_ask("COMP-A", ResourceType.ENGINEERING_HOURS, units=100.0, price_per_unit_usd=100.0)

    # Company B wants 40 hours at $110/hr
    bid_b = mkt.place_bid("COMP-B", ResourceType.ENGINEERING_HOURS, units=40.0, max_price_per_unit_usd=110.0)
    assert bid_b.status == "FILLED"
    assert ask.remaining_units == 60.0

    # Company C wants 60 hours at $105/hr
    bid_c = mkt.place_bid("COMP-C", ResourceType.ENGINEERING_HOURS, units=60.0, max_price_per_unit_usd=105.0)
    assert bid_c.status == "FILLED"
    assert ask.remaining_units == 0.0
    assert ask.status == "FILLED"

    summary = mkt.get_marketplace_summary()
    assert summary["total_settled_trades"] == 2
    assert summary["total_orders_placed"] == 3


def test_scenario_4_multi_company_critical_path_optimization():
    """8-task pipeline across 4 companies: verifies CPM, slack, and schedule execution."""
    sched = CrossCompanyScheduler()

    # Company A: Foundation (12h)
    sched.add_task("A1", "COMP-A", "API Contracts", 12.0)

    # Company B: UI Mockup (4h), UI Components (10h)
    sched.add_task("B1", "COMP-B", "UI Mockup", 4.0)
    sched.add_task("B2", "COMP-B", "UI Components", 10.0, dependencies=["B1"])

    # Company C: Model Weights (15h)
    sched.add_task("C1", "COMP-C", "Model Training", 15.0)

    # Company D: Integration (6h) - depends on A1, B2, C1
    sched.add_task("D1", "COMP-D", "End-to-End Integration", 6.0, dependencies=["A1", "B2", "C1"])

    res = sched.compute_critical_path()
    # C1 (15h) is longest path before D1 (6h) -> total duration = 21h
    assert res["total_project_duration_hours"] == 21.0
    assert "C1" in res["critical_path_tasks"]
    assert "D1" in res["critical_path_tasks"]


def test_scenario_5_zero_trust_quarantine_containment():
    """Compromised company isolated immediately: all active tokens revoked, messages dropped."""
    fed = EnterpriseFederation()

    ident = fed.security.create_identity("COMP-A-BACKEND", "ENG", "Dev", permissions=["deploy:staging"])
    token = ident.token

    # Authorize before compromise
    ok, _ = fed.security.authorize_action(token, "COMP-B-FRONTEND", "deploy:staging")
    assert ok is True

    # Security event triggers quarantine
    fed.security.propagate_threat("COMP-A-BACKEND", "DATA_LEAK_INTRUSION", ["malicious_ip"])
    assert "COMP-A-BACKEND" in fed.security.get_quarantined_companies()

    # After quarantine: token invalid, actions rejected
    assert fed.security.validate_token(token) is None
    ok_after, reason = fed.security.authorize_action(token, "COMP-B-FRONTEND", "deploy:staging")
    assert ok_after is False

    # Messages from quarantined company blocked by router
    msg = FederationMessage(
        company_id="COMP-A-BACKEND",
        target_company_id="COMP-B-FRONTEND",
        payload={"exploit": "attempt"},
    )
    # Bus accepts message but security check fails if verified
    fed.security.lift_quarantine("COMP-A-BACKEND")
    assert "COMP-A-BACKEND" not in fed.security.get_quarantined_companies()


def test_scenario_6_portfolio_rebalancing_under_budget_pressure():
    """Portfolio manager evaluates 5 competing projects and ranks highest value/ROI first."""
    pm = PortfolioManager()

    pm.create_project("Project 1", "COMP-A", business_value=50.0, strategic_alignment=60.0, estimated_roi=1.5, risk_score=40.0)
    pm.create_project("Project 2", "COMP-A", business_value=95.0, strategic_alignment=90.0, estimated_roi=4.0, risk_score=10.0)
    pm.create_project("Project 3", "COMP-B", business_value=80.0, strategic_alignment=85.0, estimated_roi=3.0, risk_score=20.0)

    ranked = pm.get_ranked_portfolio()
    assert ranked[0].title == "Project 2"
    assert ranked[1].title == "Project 3"
    assert ranked[2].title == "Project 1"


def test_scenario_7_enterprise_governance_scorecard_and_remediation():
    """Company failing 2 standards receives corrective action plan."""
    gov = EnterpriseGovernanceManager()

    failing_ctx = {
        "budget_spent": 150000,
        "budget_allocated": 100000,  # 150% budget overrun -> violates rule 1
        "dependencies": ["python-std-lib"],
        "has_eval_or_exec": False,
        "critical_cves_count": 0,
        "unmasked_pii_detected": False,
        "api_endpoints_count": 5,
        "has_api_docs": False,  # Missing API docs -> violates rule 6
        "qa_pass_rate_pct": 100.0,
    }

    report = gov.audit_target("COMP-OVERRUN", "COMPANY", failing_ctx)
    assert report.is_compliant is False
    assert len(report.violations) == 2
    assert len(report.remediation_actions) == 2


def test_scenario_8_hierarchical_policy_override():
    """Enterprise policy overrides lenient company-level policy."""
    pe = EnterprisePolicyEngine()

    # Enterprise rule: absolutely no eval()
    pe.register_rule("No Eval Enterprise", PolicyDomain.CODING, PolicyScope.ENTERPRISE,
                     condition=lambda ctx: ctx.get("has_eval", False) is True,
                     action=PolicyAction.DENY)

    # Company rule: allows eval() for specific debug mode
    pe.register_rule("Allow Eval Debug", PolicyDomain.CODING, PolicyScope.COMPANY,
                     target_id="COMP-A",
                     condition=lambda ctx: ctx.get("has_eval", False) is False,
                     action=PolicyAction.ALLOW)

    # Context with eval -> must be denied because Enterprise rule matches and denies!
    res = pe.evaluate(PolicyDomain.CODING, {"has_eval": True}, company_id="COMP-A")
    assert res.is_compliant is False
    assert res.action == PolicyAction.DENY


def test_scenario_9_cryptographic_audit_tamper_detection_in_federation():
    """Auditing the SHA-256 chain across multiple corporate operations."""
    sec = EnterpriseSecurityManager()

    for i in range(10):
        sec.issue_certificate(f"COMP-{i}")

    assert sec.verify_audit_chain_integrity() is True

    # Tamper with block 5
    sec._audit_chain[5].details = {"tampered": True}
    assert sec.verify_audit_chain_integrity() is False


def test_scenario_10_end_to_end_ecosystem_simulation_continuity():
    """Ecosystem executes multiple simulation bursts without memory leaks or race conditions."""
    fed = EnterpriseFederation()

    for burst in range(3):
        res = fed.simulate_ecosystem(num_cycles=3, messages_per_cycle=15, trade_resources=True)
        assert res["cycles_executed"] == 3
        assert res["total_messages_routed"] == 45

    dash = fed.get_global_dashboard()
    assert dash.total_companies == 8
    assert dash.consolidated_velocity > 0

# =============================================================================

DEFAULT_COMPANIES = [
    ("COMP-A-BACKEND", "Apex Backend Platform Corp", "Backend Platform", 1500000.0),
    ("COMP-B-FRONTEND", "Vanguard Frontend Products Inc", "Frontend Products", 1200000.0),
    ("COMP-C-AI", "Cognitive AI Research Labs", "AI Research", 2000000.0),
    ("COMP-D-SECURITY", "Sentinel Enterprise Security Ltd", "Security & Defense", 1000000.0),
    ("COMP-E-CLOUD", "Stratus Cloud Infrastructure Systems", "Cloud Infrastructure", 1800000.0),
    ("COMP-F-QA", "Veritas Quality Assurance Services", "QA Services", 800000.0),
    ("COMP-G-DEVOPS", "Continuous DevOps Automation Corp", "DevOps & SRE", 900000.0),
    ("COMP-H-DOCS", "Lexicon Documentation Services", "Technical Documentation", 500000.0),
]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("cid, name, domain, budget", DEFAULT_COMPANIES)
def test_default_company_profiles_and_budgets(cid, name, domain, budget):

    assert prof.company_name == name

    assert prof.allocated_budget_usd == budget

# =============================================================================
# 2. Zero Trust Clearance Matrix (4 User Levels x 4 Resource Levels = 16 Tests)
# =============================================================================

CLEARANCE_LEVELS = ["PUBLIC", "INTERNAL", "CONFIDENTIAL", "RESTRICTED"]
CLEARANCE_RANKS = {"PUBLIC": 1, "INTERNAL": 2, "CONFIDENTIAL": 3, "RESTRICTED": 4}

@pytest.mark.parametrize("user_clearance", CLEARANCE_LEVELS)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("res_clearance", CLEARANCE_LEVELS)
def test_zero_trust_clearance_matrix(user_clearance, res_clearance):
    sec = EnterpriseSecurityManager()
    ident = sec.create_identity(
        company_id="COMP-A",
        department_id="ENG",
        role_name="User",
        clearance_level=user_clearance,
        permissions=["access:data"],
    )

        token=ident.token,
        target_company_id="COMP-B",
        required_permission="access:data",
        resource_clearance=res_clearance,
    )
    expected_allow = CLEARANCE_RANKS[user_clearance] >= CLEARANCE_RANKS[res_clearance]

# =============================================================================

@pytest.mark.parametrize("res_type", list(ResourceType))

# =============================================================================
# 4. Knowledge Graph Tag Query Matrix
# =============================================================================

TAG_TEST_DATA = [
    ("python", ["python", "standard-library", "core"]),
    ("security", ["security", "zero-trust", "ciso"]),
    ("cloud", ["cloud", "infrastructure", "kubernetes"]),
    ("ai", ["ai", "machine-learning", "attention"]),

]

@pytest.mark.parametrize("search_tag, node_tags", TAG_TEST_DATA)
def test_knowledge_graph_tag_matching_matrix(search_tag, node_tags):

    n = kg.add_knowledge_node(
        category=KnowledgeCategory.LIBRARY,
        title=f"Node tagged {search_tag}",
        content=f"Content for {search_tag}",
        company_id="COMP-A",
        author="Agent",
        tags=node_tags,
    )
    results = kg.search(search_tag)
    matched_ids = [node.node_id for node, score in results]
    assert n.node_id in matched_ids


# =============================================================================
# 5. Shared Services Subsystem Matrix (8 Subsystems)
# =============================================================================

@pytest.mark.parametrize("service_name", [
    "artifacts", "models", "prompts", "packages", "licenses", "monitoring", "logging", "notifications"
])
